Open Scope dworklist_scope.

(* ---------- substitution of type variables by types ---------- *)
Fixpoint tsubst_typ (s : list (typvar * typ)) (A : typ) : typ :=
  match s with
  | nil => A
  | (X, T) :: s' => tsubst_typ s' (subst_typ_in_typ T X A)
  end.

Fixpoint tsubst_exp (s : list (typvar * typ)) (e : exp) : exp :=
  match s with
  | nil => e
  | (X, T) :: s' => tsubst_exp s' (subst_typ_in_exp T X e)
  end.

Fixpoint tsubst_conts (s : list (typvar * typ)) (cs : conts) : conts :=
  match s with
  | nil => cs
  | (X, T) :: s' => tsubst_conts s' (subst_typ_in_conts T X cs)
  end
with tsubst_contd (s : list (typvar * typ)) (cd : contd) : contd :=
  match s with
  | nil => cd
  | (X, T) :: s' => tsubst_contd s' (subst_typ_in_contd T X cd)
  end.

Fixpoint tsubst_work (s : list (typvar * typ)) (w : work) : work :=
  match s with
  | nil => w
  | (X, T) :: s' => tsubst_work s' (subst_typ_in_work T X w)
  end.

Fixpoint tsubst_abind (s : list (typvar * typ)) (b : abind) : abind :=
  match s with
  | nil => b
  | (X, T) :: s' => tsubst_abind s' (subst_typ_in_abind T X b)
  end.

Fixpoint aenv_to_denv (s : list (typvar * typ)) (E : aenv) {struct E} : denv :=
  match E with
  | nil => nil
  | (X, abind_tvar_empty) :: E' => X ~ dbind_tvar_empty ++ aenv_to_denv s E'
  | (X, abind_stvar_empty) :: E' => X ~ dbind_stvar_empty ++ aenv_to_denv s E'
  | (X, abind_etvar_empty) :: E' => aenv_to_denv s E'
  | (X, abind_var_typ A) :: E' => X ~ dbind_typ (tsubst_typ s A) ++ aenv_to_denv s E'
  end.

Fixpoint dropv (X : typvar) (s : list (typvar * typ)) : list (typvar * typ) :=
  match s with
  | nil => nil
  | (Y, T) :: s' => if eq_var Y X then dropv X s' else (Y, T) :: dropv X s' end.

Fixpoint names (s : list (typvar * typ)) : list typvar :=
  match s with nil => nil | (X,_)::s' => X :: names s' end.

Definition fresh_sigma (X : typvar) (s : list (typvar * typ)) : Prop :=
  ~ In X (names s).

Lemma aenv_to_denv_app : forall s E1 E2,
  aenv_to_denv s (E1 ++ E2) = aenv_to_denv s E1 ++ aenv_to_denv s E2.
Proof.
  intros s E1. induction E1 as [| [X b] E1 IH]; intros E2; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct b; simpl; rewrite IH; reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ---------- tsubst is a homomorphism on non-variable constructors ---------- *)
Lemma tsubst_unit : forall s, tsubst_typ s typ_unit = typ_unit.
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma tsubst_top : forall s, tsubst_typ s typ_top = typ_top.
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma tsubst_bot : forall s, tsubst_typ s typ_bot = typ_bot.
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma tsubst_varb : forall s n, tsubst_typ s (typ_var_b n) = typ_var_b n.
Proof. intros s n. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma tsubst_arrow : forall s A1 A2,
  tsubst_typ s (typ_arrow A1 A2) =
  typ_arrow (tsubst_typ s A1) (tsubst_typ s A2).
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; intros A1 A2; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma tsubst_all : forall s A,
  tsubst_typ s (typ_all A) = typ_all (tsubst_typ s A).
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; intros A; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma tsubst_union : forall s A1 A2,
  tsubst_typ s (typ_union A1 A2) =
  typ_union (tsubst_typ s A1) (tsubst_typ s A2).
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; intros A1 A2; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma tsubst_inter : forall s A1 A2,
  tsubst_typ s (typ_intersection A1 A2) =
  typ_intersection (tsubst_typ s A1) (tsubst_typ s A2).
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; intros A1 A2; simpl; auto. Qed.

Lemma tsubst_var_fresh : forall s X,
  fresh_sigma X s -> tsubst_typ s (typ_var_f X) = typ_var_f X.
Proof.
  intros s X H. induction s as [|[Y T] s IH]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - simpl in H. assert (Hne : Y <> X) by (intro; subst; apply H; simpl; auto).
    destruct (eq_var X Y) as [e|e]; simpl.
    + exfalso; apply Hne; auto.
    + rewrite IH.
      * reflexivity.
      * intros Hin. apply H. simpl; auto.
Qed.

(* ---------- types with no de Bruijn variables ---------- *)
Fixpoint no_bvar (A : typ) : Prop :=
  match A with
  | typ_unit => True
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_bot => True
  | typ_var_b _ => False
  | typ_var_f _ => True
  | typ_arrow A1 A2 => no_bvar A1 /\ no_bvar A2
  | typ_all A => no_bvar A
  | typ_union A1 A2 => no_bvar A1 /\ no_bvar A2
  | typ_intersection A1 A2 => no_bvar A1 /\ no_bvar A2
  end.

Lemma no_bvar_open_rec : forall A k R, no_bvar A -> open_typ_wrt_typ_rec k R A = A.
Proof.
  intros A. induction A as [| | | n | X | A1 IH1 A2 IH2 | A0 IH0 | A1 IH1 A2 IH2 | A1 IH1 A2 IH2];
    intros k R H; simpl in *.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct H.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. rewrite IH1; auto. rewrite IH2; auto.
  - rewrite IH0; auto.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. rewrite IH1; auto. rewrite IH2; auto.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. rewrite IH1; auto. rewrite IH2; auto.
Qed.

Lemma no_bvar_subst : forall T Y A,
  no_bvar T -> no_bvar A -> no_bvar (subst_typ_in_typ T Y A).
Proof.
  intros T Y A HT. induction A as [| | | n | X | A1 IH1 A2 IH2 | A0 IH0 | A1 IH1 A2 IH2 | A1 IH1 A2 IH2];
    intros HA; simpl in *.
  - constructor.
  - constructor.
  - constructor.
  - destruct HA.
  - destruct (eq_var X Y); simpl; auto.
  - destruct HA as [H1 H2]. constructor.
    + apply IH1; auto.
    + apply IH2; auto.
  - apply IH0; auto.
  - destruct HA as [H1 H2]. constructor.
    + apply IH1; auto.
    + apply IH2; auto.
  - destruct HA as [H1 H2]. constructor.
    + apply IH1; auto.
    + apply IH2; auto.
Qed.

(* ---------- commutation of single substitution and bvar opening ---------- *)
Lemma subst_open_rec_comm : forall T Y k A R,
  no_bvar T -> no_bvar R ->
  subst_typ_in_typ T Y (open_typ_wrt_typ_rec k R A) =
  open_typ_wrt_typ_rec k (subst_typ_in_typ T Y R) (subst_typ_in_typ T Y A).
Proof.
  intros T Y k A. revert k. induction A as [| | | n | X | A1 IH1 A2 IH2 | A0 IH0 | A1 IH1 A2 IH2 | A1 IH1 A2 IH2];
    intros k R HT HR; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - (* var_b *) destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[Hlt|Heq]|Hgt]; reflexivity.
  - (* var_f *) destruct (eq_var X Y); simpl.
    + rewrite no_bvar_open_rec; auto.
    + reflexivity.
  - (* arrow *) rewrite IH1 by auto; rewrite IH2 by auto; reflexivity.
  - (* all *) rewrite IH0 by auto; reflexivity.
  - (* union *) rewrite IH1 by auto; rewrite IH2 by auto; reflexivity.
  - (* intersection *) rewrite IH1 by auto; rewrite IH2 by auto; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma open_tsubst_one : forall T Y A R,
  no_bvar T -> no_bvar R ->
  subst_typ_in_typ T Y (open_typ_wrt_typ A R) =
  open_typ_wrt_typ (subst_typ_in_typ T Y A) (subst_typ_in_typ T Y R).
Proof.
  intros. unfold open_typ_wrt_typ. apply subst_open_rec_comm; auto.
Qed.

Definition nb_sigma (s : list (typvar * typ)) : Prop :=
  forall X T, In (X,T) s -> no_bvar T.

Lemma open_tsubst : forall s A R,
  nb_sigma s -> no_bvar R ->
  tsubst_typ s (open_typ_wrt_typ A R) =
  open_typ_wrt_typ (tsubst_typ s A) (tsubst_typ s R).
Proof.
  intros s A. revert A. induction s as [|[Y T] s' IH]; intros A R Hnb HR.
  - simpl; auto.
  - simpl.
    assert (HT : no_bvar T) by (apply (Hnb Y T); simpl; auto).
    assert (Hnb' : nb_sigma s') by (intros X U Hin; apply (Hnb X U); simpl; auto).
    rewrite (open_tsubst_one T Y A R HT HR).
    assert (HR' : no_bvar (subst_typ_in_typ T Y R)) by (apply no_bvar_subst; auto).
    rewrite (IH (subst_typ_in_typ T Y A) (subst_typ_in_typ T Y R) Hnb' HR').
    reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ---------- monotypes: basic properties ---------- *)
Lemma d_mono_typ_no_bvar : forall Ψ A, d_mono_typ Ψ A -> no_bvar A.
Proof.
  intros Ψ A H. induction H; simpl; auto.
Qed.

Lemma d_mono_typ_wf : forall Ψ A, d_mono_typ Ψ A -> d_wf_typ Ψ A.
Proof.
  intros Ψ A H. induction H.
  - constructor.
  - econstructor; eauto.
  - constructor; auto.
Qed.

Lemma d_mono_typ_lc : forall Ψ A, d_mono_typ Ψ A -> lc_typ A.
Proof.
  intros Ψ A H. induction H.
  - constructor.
  - constructor.
  - constructor; auto.
Qed.

Lemma d_mono_typ_var_inv : forall Ψ X, d_mono_typ Ψ (typ_var_f X) ->
  binds X (dbind_tvar_empty) Ψ.
Proof. intros Ψ X H. inversion H; auto. Qed.

Lemma d_mono_typ_arrow_inv : forall Ψ A B, d_mono_typ Ψ (typ_arrow A B) ->
  d_mono_typ Ψ A /\ d_mono_typ Ψ B.
Proof. intros Ψ A B H. inversion H; subst; auto. Qed.

Lemma d_mono_typ_not_top : forall Ψ, d_mono_typ Ψ typ_top -> False.
Proof. intros Ψ H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma d_mono_typ_not_bot : forall Ψ, d_mono_typ Ψ typ_bot -> False.
Proof. intros Ψ H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma d_mono_typ_not_all : forall Ψ A, d_mono_typ Ψ (typ_all A) -> False.
Proof. intros Ψ A H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma d_mono_typ_not_union : forall Ψ A B, d_mono_typ Ψ (typ_union A B) -> False.
Proof. intros Ψ A B H. inversion H. Qed.
Lemma d_mono_typ_not_inter : forall Ψ A B, d_mono_typ Ψ (typ_intersection A B) -> False.
Proof. intros Ψ A B H. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma d_sub_mono_eq : forall Ψ A B,
  d_mono_typ Ψ A -> d_mono_typ Ψ B -> d_sub Ψ A B -> A = B.
Proof.
  intros Ψ A B HA HB Hsub.
  remember A as A' eqn:EA. remember B as B' eqn:EB.
  revert A B HA HB EA EB.
  induction Hsub; intros A0 B0 HA HB EA EB; subst.
  - exfalso; apply d_mono_typ_not_top in HB; auto.
  - exfalso; apply d_mono_typ_not_bot in HA; auto.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - apply d_mono_typ_arrow_inv in HA; destruct HA as [HA1 HA2].
    apply d_mono_typ_arrow_inv in HB; destruct HB as [HB1 HB2].
    assert (H1 : B1 = A1) by (eapply IHHsub1; eauto).
    assert (H2 : A2 = B2) by (eapply IHHsub2; eauto).
    subst; reflexivity.
  - exfalso; apply d_mono_typ_not_all in HA; auto.
  - exfalso; apply d_mono_typ_not_all in HA; auto.
  - exfalso; apply d_mono_typ_not_inter in HB; auto.
  - exfalso; apply d_mono_typ_not_inter in HA; auto.
  - exfalso; apply d_mono_typ_not_inter in HA; auto.
  - exfalso; apply d_mono_typ_not_union in HB; auto.
  - exfalso; apply d_mono_typ_not_union in HB; auto.
  - exfalso; apply d_mono_typ_not_union in HA; auto.
Qed.

Lemma d_sub_mono_refl : forall Ψ A, d_wf_env Ψ -> d_mono_typ Ψ A -> d_sub Ψ A A.
Proof.
  intros Ψ A Henv H. induction H.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto. constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
Qed.

(* ---------- erasing an aworklist to a dworklist under a substitution ---------- *)
Definition erase_bind (s : list (typvar * typ)) (b : abind) : option dbind :=
  match b with
  | abind_tvar_empty => Some dbind_tvar_empty
  | abind_stvar_empty => Some dbind_stvar_empty
  | abind_etvar_empty => None
  | abind_var_typ A => Some (dbind_typ (tsubst_typ s A))
  end.

Fixpoint eraseσ (s : list (typvar * typ)) (Γ : aworklist) {struct Γ} : dworklist :=
  match Γ with
  | aworklist_empty => dworklist_empty
  | aworklist_cons_var Γ' X b =>
      match erase_bind s b with
      | Some db => dworklist_cons_var (eraseσ s Γ') X db
      | None => eraseσ s Γ'
      end
  | aworklist_cons_work Γ' w =>
      dworklist_cons_work (eraseσ s Γ') (tsubst_work s w)
  end.

Lemma dwl_to_denv_eraseσ : forall s Γ,
  dwl_to_denv (eraseσ s Γ) = aenv_to_denv s (awl_to_aenv Γ).
Proof.
  intros s Γ. induction Γ as [| Γ' IH X b | Γ' IH w].
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct b as [| | | A]; simpl; rewrite IH; reflexivity.
  - simpl. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ---------- syntactic type well-formedness of worklists ---------- *)
Fixpoint tw_exp (Σ : aenv) (e : exp) {struct e} : Prop :=
  match e with
  | exp_unit => True
  | exp_var_b _ => True
  | exp_var_f _ => True
  | exp_abs e' => tw_exp Σ e'
  | exp_app e1 e2 => tw_exp Σ e1 /\ tw_exp Σ e2
  | exp_tabs e' =>
      match e' with
      | exp_anno e'' A => a_wf_typ Σ (typ_all A) /\ tw_exp Σ e''
      | _ => False
      end
  | exp_tapp e' A => tw_exp Σ e' /\ a_wf_typ Σ A
  | exp_anno e' A => tw_exp Σ e' /\ a_wf_typ Σ A
  end.

Fixpoint tw_conts (Σ : aenv) (cs : conts) {struct cs} : Prop :=
  match cs with
  | conts_infabs cd => tw_contd Σ cd
  | conts_inftapp A cs' => a_wf_typ Σ A /\ tw_conts Σ cs'
  | conts_inftappunion A1 A2 cs' => a_wf_typ Σ A1 /\ a_wf_typ Σ A2 /\ tw_conts Σ cs'
  | conts_unioninftapp A cs' => a_wf_typ Σ A /\ tw_conts Σ cs'
  | conts_sub A => a_wf_typ Σ A
  end
with tw_contd (Σ : aenv) (cd : contd) {struct cd} : Prop :=
  match cd with
  | contd_infabsunion A cd' => a_wf_typ Σ A /\ tw_contd Σ cd'
  | contd_infapp e cs => tw_exp Σ e /\ tw_conts Σ cs
  | contd_unioninfabs A B cd' => a_wf_typ Σ (typ_arrow A B) /\ tw_contd Σ cd'
  end.

Fixpoint tw_work (Σ : aenv) (w : work) {struct w} : Prop :=
  match w with
  | work_infer e cs => tw_exp Σ e /\ tw_conts Σ cs
  | work_check e A => tw_exp Σ e /\ a_wf_typ Σ A
  | work_infabs A cd => a_wf_typ Σ A /\ tw_contd Σ cd
  | work_infabsunion A1 B1 A2 cd => a_wf_typ Σ (typ_arrow A1 B1) /\ a_wf_typ Σ A2 /\ tw_contd Σ cd
  | work_infapp A B e cs => a_wf_typ Σ (typ_arrow A B) /\ tw_exp Σ e /\ tw_conts Σ cs
  | work_inftapp A1 A2 cs => a_wf_typ Σ A1 /\ a_wf_typ Σ A2 /\ tw_conts Σ cs
  | work_sub A1 A2 => a_wf_typ Σ A1 /\ a_wf_typ Σ A2
  | work_inftappunion A1 A2 B cs => a_wf_typ Σ A1 /\ a_wf_typ Σ A2 /\ a_wf_typ Σ B /\ tw_conts Σ cs
  | work_unioninftapp A1 A2 cs => a_wf_typ Σ A1 /\ a_wf_typ Σ A2 /\ tw_conts Σ cs
  | work_unioninfabs A1 B1 A2 B2 cd => a_wf_typ Σ (typ_arrow A1 B1) /\ a_wf_typ Σ (typ_arrow A2 B2) /\ tw_contd Σ cd
  | work_applys cs A => a_wf_typ Σ A /\ tw_conts Σ cs
  | work_applyd cd A B => a_wf_typ Σ A /\ a_wf_typ Σ B /\ tw_contd Σ cd
  end.

Fixpoint tw_bind (Σ : aenv) (b : abind) {struct b} : Prop :=
  match b with
  | abind_var_typ A => a_wf_typ Σ A
  | _ => True
  end.

Fixpoint twf (Γ : aworklist) {struct Γ} : Prop :=
  match Γ with
  | aworklist_empty => True
  | aworklist_cons_var Γ' X b => twf Γ' /\ tw_bind (awl_to_aenv Γ') b /\ X `notin` dom (awl_to_aenv Γ')
  | aworklist_cons_work Γ' w => twf Γ' /\ tw_work (awl_to_aenv Γ') w
  end.

Lemma tw_bind_var : forall Σ A, tw_bind Σ (abind_var_typ A) -> a_wf_typ Σ A.
Proof. intros Σ A H. change (a_wf_typ Σ A) in H. exact H. Qed.

Lemma twf_env : forall Γ, twf Γ -> a_wf_env (awl_to_aenv Γ).
Proof.
  intros Γ. induction Γ as [| Γ' IH X b | Γ' IH w]; intros H.
  - simpl. constructor.
  - simpl in H. destruct H as [Ht [Hb Hf]]. simpl.
    destruct b as [| | | A].
    + apply a_wf_env__tvar.
      * apply IH. exact Ht.
      * auto.
    + apply a_wf_env__stvar.
      * apply IH. exact Ht.
      * auto.
    + apply a_wf_env__etvar.
      * apply IH. exact Ht.
      * auto.
    + apply a_wf_env__typ.
      * apply IH. exact Ht.
      * exact (tw_bind_var _ _ Hb).
      * exact Hf.
  - simpl in H. destruct H as [Ht Hw]. simpl. apply IH. exact Ht.
Qed.

(* ---------- environment correspondence under a substitution ---------- *)
Definition Arel (s : list (typvar * typ)) (Σ : aenv) (Ψ : denv) : Prop :=
  nb_sigma s /\
  (forall X, binds X (abind_tvar_empty) Σ -> binds X (dbind_tvar_empty) Ψ) /\
  (forall X, binds X (abind_stvar_empty) Σ -> binds X (dbind_stvar_empty) Ψ) /\
  (forall X, binds X (abind_etvar_empty) Σ -> d_mono_typ Ψ (tsubst_typ s (typ_var_f X))) /\
  (forall X, binds X (abind_etvar_empty) Σ -> In X (names s)) /\
  (forall X, binds X (abind_tvar_empty) Σ -> fresh_sigma X s) /\
  (forall X, binds X (abind_stvar_empty) Σ -> fresh_sigma X s) /\
  (forall x A, binds x (abind_var_typ A) Σ -> binds x (dbind_typ (tsubst_typ s A)) Ψ).

Lemma d_mono_typ_cons : forall Ψ A Z b,
  d_mono_typ Ψ A -> d_mono_typ (Z ~ b ++ Ψ) A.
Proof.
  intros Ψ A Z b H. induction H.
  - constructor.
  - constructor. apply binds_cons_3; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
Qed.

Lemma Arel_tvar_ext : forall s Σ Ψ X,
  Arel s Σ Ψ -> fresh_sigma X s ->
  Arel s (X ~ abind_tvar_empty ++ Σ) (X ~ dbind_tvar_empty ++ Ψ).
Proof.
  intros s Σ Ψ X [Hnb [Ht [Hs [He [Hin [Hft [Hfs Hv]]]]]]] Hf.
  unfold Arel. repeat split.
  - exact Hnb.
  - intros Y Hb. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. apply binds_cons_2; auto.
    + apply binds_cons_3; auto.
  - intros Y Hb. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. discriminate e2.
    + apply binds_cons_3; auto.
  - intros Y Hb. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. discriminate e2.
    + apply d_mono_typ_cons. apply He; auto.
  - intros Y Hb. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. discriminate e2.
    + apply Hin; auto.
  - intros Y Hb. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. auto.
    + apply Hft; auto.
  - intros Y Hb. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. discriminate e2.
    + apply Hfs; auto.
  - intros x A Hb. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. discriminate e2.
    + apply binds_cons_3. apply Hv; auto.
Qed.

Lemma Arel_stvar_ext : forall s Σ Ψ X,
  Arel s Σ Ψ -> fresh_sigma X s ->
  Arel s (X ~ abind_stvar_empty ++ Σ) (X ~ dbind_stvar_empty ++ Ψ).
Proof.
  intros s Σ Ψ X [Hnb [Ht [Hs [He [Hin [Hft [Hfs Hv]]]]]]] Hf.
  unfold Arel. repeat split.
  - exact Hnb.
  - intros Y Hb. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. discriminate e2.
    + apply binds_cons_3; auto.
  - intros Y Hb. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. apply binds_cons_2; auto.
    + apply binds_cons_3; auto.
  - intros Y Hb. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. discriminate e2.
    + apply d_mono_typ_cons. apply He; auto.
  - intros Y Hb. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. discriminate e2.
    + apply Hin; auto.
  - intros Y Hb. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. discriminate e2.
    + apply Hft; auto.
  - intros Y Hb. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. auto.
    + apply Hfs; auto.
  - intros x A Hb. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. discriminate e2.
    + apply binds_cons_3. apply Hv; auto.
Qed.

Lemma Arel_var_ext : forall s Σ Ψ x A,
  Arel s Σ Ψ ->
  Arel s (x ~ abind_var_typ A ++ Σ) (x ~ dbind_typ (tsubst_typ s A) ++ Ψ).
Proof.
  intros s Σ Ψ x A [Hnb [Ht [Hs [He [Hin [Hft [Hfs Hv]]]]]]].
  unfold Arel. repeat split.
  - exact Hnb.
  - intros Y Hb. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. discriminate e2.
    + apply binds_cons_3; auto.
  - intros Y Hb. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. discriminate e2.
    + apply binds_cons_3; auto.
  - intros Y Hb. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. discriminate e2.
    + apply d_mono_typ_cons. apply He; auto.
  - intros Y Hb. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. discriminate e2.
    + apply Hin; auto.
  - intros Y Hb. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. discriminate e2.
    + apply Hft; auto.
  - intros Y Hb. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. discriminate e2.
    + apply Hfs; auto.
  - intros y B Hb. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. injection e2 as eB. subst B. apply binds_cons_2; auto.
    + apply binds_cons_3. apply Hv; auto.
Qed.

Definition names_set (s : list (typvar * typ)) : atoms :=
  fold_right AtomSetImpl.add AtomSetImpl.empty (names s).

Lemma notin_names_set : forall s X,
  X `notin` names_set s -> ~ In X (names s).
Proof.
  intros s. induction s as [|[Y T] s IH]; intros X H Hin.
  - simpl in Hin. contradiction.
  - simpl in H, Hin.
    assert (Hne : X <> Y) by (intro; subst; apply H; apply AtomSetImpl.add_1; reflexivity).
    assert (Hnot : X `notin` names_set s) by (intro Hc; apply H; apply AtomSetImpl.add_2; auto).
    destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
    + subst. apply Hne; reflexivity.
    + exact (IH X Hnot Hin).
Qed.

Definition Pwf (Σ : aenv) (A : typ) : Prop :=
  forall s Ψ, Arel s Σ Ψ -> d_wf_typ Ψ (tsubst_typ s A).

Definition Qsin (Σ : aenv) (A : typ) : Prop :=
  forall X s Ψ, Arel s Σ Ψ -> s_in X A -> fresh_sigma X s ->
    s_in X (tsubst_typ s A).

(* ---------- degree-based metatheory: lc_typ and substitution ---------- *)
Definition lc_sigma (s : list (typvar * typ)) : Prop :=
  forall X T, In (X,T) s -> lc_typ T.

Lemma degree_mono : forall n m A, n <= m -> degree_typ_wrt_typ n A -> degree_typ_wrt_typ m A.
Proof.
  intros n m A Hle H. revert m Hle. induction H; intros m Hle.
  - constructor.
  - constructor.
  - constructor.
  - constructor.
  - constructor. lia.
  - constructor; auto.
  - apply degree_wrt_typ_typ_all. apply IHdegree_typ_wrt_typ. lia.
  - constructor; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
Qed.

Lemma degree_open_rec_fwd : forall n A X,
  degree_typ_wrt_typ n A ->
  forall j k, n = S k -> j <= k -> degree_typ_wrt_typ k X ->
  degree_typ_wrt_typ k (open_typ_wrt_typ_rec j X A).
Proof.
  intros n A X H. induction H; intros j k En Hjk HX.
  - constructor.
  - constructor.
  - constructor.
  - constructor.
  - (* var_b *) simpl. destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n2 j) as [[Hlt|Heq]|Hgt].
    + constructor; lia.
    + exact HX.
    + constructor; lia.
  - (* arrow *) simpl. constructor; eauto.
  - (* all *) simpl. apply degree_wrt_typ_typ_all.
    eapply IHdegree_typ_wrt_typ with (j := S j) (k := S k).
    + lia.
    + lia.
    + apply degree_mono with (n := k); auto; lia.
  - (* union *) simpl. constructor; eauto.
  - (* intersection *) simpl. constructor; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma degree_open_rec_bwd : forall j k A X,
  j <= k -> degree_typ_wrt_typ k X -> degree_typ_wrt_typ k (open_typ_wrt_typ_rec j X A) ->
  degree_typ_wrt_typ (S k) A.
Proof.
  intros j k A. revert j k. induction A as [| | | n | Y | A1 IH1 A2 IH2 | A0 IH0 | A1 IH1 A2 IH2 | A1 IH1 A2 IH2];
    intros j k X Hjk HX Hd; simpl in *.
  - constructor.
  - constructor.
  - constructor.
  - (* var_b *) destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n j) as [[Hlt|Heq]|Hgt].
    + inversion Hd. constructor; lia.
    + subst. constructor; lia.
    + inversion Hd. constructor; lia.
  - constructor.
  - (* arrow *) inversion Hd; subst. constructor; eauto.
  - (* all *) inversion Hd; subst. apply degree_wrt_typ_typ_all.
    eapply IH0 with (j := S j) (k := S k) (X := X).
    + lia.
    + apply degree_mono with (n := k); auto; lia.
    + assumption.
  - (* union *) inversion Hd; subst. constructor; eauto.
  - (* intersection *) inversion Hd; subst. constructor; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma size_open_rec : forall j A X,
  size_typ X = 1 -> size_typ (open_typ_wrt_typ_rec j X A) = size_typ A.
Proof.
  intros j A. revert j.
  induction A as [| | | n | Y | A1 IH1 A2 IH2 | A0 IH0 | A1 IH1 A2 IH2 | A1 IH1 A2 IH2];
    intros j X0 HX; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n j) as [[Hlt|Heq]|Hgt]; simpl.
    + reflexivity.
    + rewrite HX. reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IH1 j X0 HX). rewrite (IH2 j X0 HX). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IH0 (S j) X0 HX). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IH1 j X0 HX). rewrite (IH2 j X0 HX). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IH1 j X0 HX). rewrite (IH2 j X0 HX). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma degree_all_inv : forall k A,
  degree_typ_wrt_typ k (typ_all A) -> degree_typ_wrt_typ (S k) A.
Proof. intros k A H. inversion H; auto. Qed.

Lemma degree_arrow_inv : forall k A B,
  degree_typ_wrt_typ k (typ_arrow A B) ->
  degree_typ_wrt_typ k A /\ degree_typ_wrt_typ k B.
Proof. intros k A B H. inversion H; auto. Qed.

Lemma degree_union_inv : forall k A B,
  degree_typ_wrt_typ k (typ_union A B) ->
  degree_typ_wrt_typ k A /\ degree_typ_wrt_typ k B.
Proof. intros k A B H. inversion H; auto. Qed.

Lemma degree_inter_inv : forall k A B,
  degree_typ_wrt_typ k (typ_intersection A B) ->
  degree_typ_wrt_typ k A /\ degree_typ_wrt_typ k B.
Proof. intros k A B H. inversion H; auto. Qed.

Lemma degree0_lc_aux : forall n A,
  size_typ A <= n -> degree_typ_wrt_typ 0 A -> lc_typ A.
Proof.
  induction n as [| n IH]; intros A Hsize Hd.
  - destruct A; simpl in Hsize; try constructor; try lia.
  - destruct A; simpl in *.
    + constructor. + constructor. + constructor.
    + inversion Hd; lia.
    + constructor.
    + apply lc_typ_arrow; apply IH; try lia.
      * inversion Hd; auto.
      * inversion Hd; auto.
    + apply lc_typ_all. intros Y.
      apply IH.
      { change (size_typ (open_typ_wrt_typ_rec 0 (typ_var_f Y) A) <= n).
        rewrite (size_open_rec 0 A (typ_var_f Y) ltac:(simpl; reflexivity)).
        simpl in Hsize. lia. }
      { pose proof (degree_all_inv _ _ Hd) as Hd1.
        assert (Hopen : degree_typ_wrt_typ 0 (open_typ_wrt_typ_rec 0 (typ_var_f Y) A)).
        { apply (degree_open_rec_fwd 1 A (typ_var_f Y) Hd1 0 0).
          - lia.
          - lia.
          - constructor. }
        exact Hopen. }
    + apply lc_typ_union; apply IH; try lia;
        [inversion Hd; auto|inversion Hd; auto].
    + apply lc_typ_intersection; apply IH; try lia;
        [inversion Hd; auto|inversion Hd; auto].
Qed.

Lemma degree0_lc : forall A, degree_typ_wrt_typ 0 A -> lc_typ A.
Proof. intros A H. eapply degree0_lc_aux; eauto. Qed.

Lemma lc_typ_all_inv : forall A,
  lc_typ (typ_all A) -> forall X, lc_typ (open_typ_wrt_typ A (typ_var_f X)).
Proof. intros A H. inversion H; auto. Qed.

Lemma lc_typ_arrow_inv : forall A B,
  lc_typ (typ_arrow A B) -> lc_typ A /\ lc_typ B.
Proof. intros A B H. inversion H; auto. Qed.

Lemma lc_typ_union_inv : forall A B,
  lc_typ (typ_union A B) -> lc_typ A /\ lc_typ B.
Proof. intros A B H. inversion H; auto. Qed.

Lemma lc_typ_inter_inv : forall A B,
  lc_typ (typ_intersection A B) -> lc_typ A /\ lc_typ B.
Proof. intros A B H. inversion H; auto. Qed.

Lemma lc_degree_aux : forall n A,
  size_typ A <= n -> lc_typ A -> degree_typ_wrt_typ 0 A.
Proof.
  induction n as [| n IH]; intros A Hsize Hlc.
  - destruct A; simpl in Hsize; try constructor; try lia; inversion Hlc.
  - destruct A; simpl in *.
    + constructor. + constructor. + constructor.
    + inversion Hlc.
    + constructor.
    + assert (Hl := lc_typ_arrow_inv _ _ Hlc). destruct Hl as [Hl1 Hl2].
      constructor.
      * apply IH; [lia | exact Hl1].
      * apply IH; [lia | exact Hl2].
    + (* all *)
      assert (Hsin : forall X, lc_typ (open_typ_wrt_typ A (typ_var_f X)))
        by (apply lc_typ_all_inv; exact Hlc).
      assert (Hdeg : degree_typ_wrt_typ 0
                       (open_typ_wrt_typ_rec 0 (typ_var_f (fresh nil)) A)).
      { apply IH.
        - change (size_typ (open_typ_wrt_typ_rec 0 (typ_var_f (fresh nil)) A) <= n).
          rewrite (size_open_rec 0 A (typ_var_f (fresh nil)) ltac:(simpl; reflexivity)).
          simpl in Hsize. lia.
        - apply Hsin. }
      apply degree_wrt_typ_typ_all.
      apply (degree_open_rec_bwd 0 0 A (typ_var_f (fresh nil))).
      * lia.
      * constructor.
      * exact Hdeg.
    + assert (Hl := lc_typ_union_inv _ _ Hlc). destruct Hl as [Hl1 Hl2].
      constructor.
      * apply IH; [lia | exact Hl1].
      * apply IH; [lia | exact Hl2].
    + assert (Hl := lc_typ_inter_inv _ _ Hlc). destruct Hl as [Hl1 Hl2].
      constructor.
      * apply IH; [lia | exact Hl1].
      * apply IH; [lia | exact Hl2].
Qed.

Lemma lc_degree : forall A, lc_typ A -> degree_typ_wrt_typ 0 A.
Proof. intros A H. eapply lc_degree_aux; eauto. Qed.

Lemma degree_subst : forall k A T X,
  degree_typ_wrt_typ k A -> degree_typ_wrt_typ 0 T ->
  degree_typ_wrt_typ k (subst_typ_in_typ T X A).
Proof.
  intros k A. revert k. induction A as [| | | n | Y | A1 IH1 A2 IH2 | A0 IH0 | A1 IH1 A2 IH2 | A1 IH1 A2 IH2];
    intros k T X Hd HT; simpl in *.
  - constructor.
  - constructor.
  - constructor.
  - inversion Hd; auto.
  - destruct (eq_var Y X); simpl.
    + apply (degree_mono 0 k T); [lia | exact HT].
    + constructor.
  - assert (Hda := degree_arrow_inv _ _ _ Hd). destruct Hda as [Hd1 Hd2].
    constructor.
    + apply IH1; auto.
    + apply IH2; auto.
  - apply degree_wrt_typ_typ_all.
    apply IH0 with (T := T) (X := X).
    + pose proof (degree_all_inv _ _ Hd) as Hd1. exact Hd1.
    + exact HT.
  - assert (Hda := degree_union_inv _ _ _ Hd). destruct Hda as [Hd1 Hd2].
    constructor.
    + apply IH1; auto.
    + apply IH2; auto.
  - assert (Hda := degree_inter_inv _ _ _ Hd). destruct Hda as [Hd1 Hd2].
    constructor.
    + apply IH1; auto.
    + apply IH2; auto.
Qed.

Lemma lc_subst : forall T X A,
  lc_typ T -> lc_typ A -> lc_typ (subst_typ_in_typ T X A).
Proof.
  intros T X A HT HA.
  apply degree0_lc.
  apply degree_subst.
  - apply lc_degree; auto.
  - apply lc_degree; auto.
Qed.

Lemma lc_tsubst : forall s A, lc_sigma s -> lc_typ A -> lc_typ (tsubst_typ s A).
Proof.
  intros s A. revert A. induction s as [|[Y T] s' IH]; intros A Hs HA.
  - simpl; auto.
  - simpl. apply IH.
    + intros X U Hin. apply (Hs X U). simpl; auto.
    + apply lc_subst; auto. apply (Hs Y T). simpl; auto.
Qed.

Lemma no_bvar_lc : forall A, no_bvar A -> lc_typ A.
Proof.
  intros A. induction A as [| | | n | X | A1 IH1 A2 IH2 | A0 IH0 | A1 IH1 A2 IH2 | A1 IH1 A2 IH2];
    intros H; simpl in *.
  - constructor.
  - constructor.
  - constructor.
  - destruct H.
  - constructor.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. constructor; auto.
  - apply lc_typ_all. intros Y.
    change (lc_typ (open_typ_wrt_typ_rec 0 (typ_var_f Y) A0)).
    rewrite no_bvar_open_rec; auto.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. constructor; auto.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. constructor; auto.
Qed.

Lemma lc_sigma_of_nb : forall s, nb_sigma s -> lc_sigma s.
Proof.
  intros s Hnb X T Hin. apply no_bvar_lc. apply (Hnb X T). auto.
Qed.


Lemma Arel_nb : forall s Σ Ψ, Arel s Σ Ψ -> nb_sigma s.
Proof. intros s Σ Ψ HA. destruct HA as [H _]. exact H. Qed.
Lemma Arel_tvar : forall s Σ Ψ X, Arel s Σ Ψ -> binds X (abind_tvar_empty) Σ -> binds X (dbind_tvar_empty) Ψ.
Proof. intros s Σ Ψ X HA Hb. destruct HA as [Hnb [Ht _]]. apply Ht. exact Hb. Qed.
Lemma Arel_stvar : forall s Σ Ψ X, Arel s Σ Ψ -> binds X (abind_stvar_empty) Σ -> binds X (dbind_stvar_empty) Ψ.
Proof. intros s Σ Ψ X HA Hb. destruct HA as [Hnb [Ht [Hs _]]]. apply Hs. exact Hb. Qed.
Lemma Arel_etvar : forall s Σ Ψ X, Arel s Σ Ψ -> binds X (abind_etvar_empty) Σ -> d_mono_typ Ψ (tsubst_typ s (typ_var_f X)).
Proof. intros s Σ Ψ X HA Hb. destruct HA as [Hnb [Ht [Hs [He _]]]]. apply He. exact Hb. Qed.
Lemma Arel_etvar_in : forall s Σ Ψ X, Arel s Σ Ψ -> binds X (abind_etvar_empty) Σ -> In X (names s).
Proof. intros s Σ Ψ X HA Hb. destruct HA as [Hnb [Ht [Hs [He [Hin _]]]]]. apply Hin. exact Hb. Qed.
Lemma Arel_fresh_tvar : forall s Σ Ψ X, Arel s Σ Ψ -> binds X (abind_tvar_empty) Σ -> fresh_sigma X s.
Proof. intros s Σ Ψ X HA Hb. destruct HA as [Hnb [Ht [Hs [He [Hin [Hft _]]]]]]. apply Hft. exact Hb. Qed.
Lemma Arel_fresh_stvar : forall s Σ Ψ X, Arel s Σ Ψ -> binds X (abind_stvar_empty) Σ -> fresh_sigma X s.
Proof. intros s Σ Ψ X HA Hb. destruct HA as [Hnb [Ht [Hs [He [Hin [Hft [Hfs _]]]]]]]. apply Hfs. exact Hb. Qed.
Lemma Arel_var : forall s Σ Ψ x A, Arel s Σ Ψ -> binds x (abind_var_typ A) Σ -> binds x (dbind_typ (tsubst_typ s A)) Ψ.
Proof. intros s Σ Ψ x A HA Hb. destruct HA as [Hnb [Ht [Hs [He [Hin [Hft [Hfs Hv]]]]]]]. apply Hv. exact Hb. Qed.

Lemma s_in_arrow_inv : forall X A B,
  s_in X (typ_arrow A B) ->
  (s_in X A /\ lc_typ B) \/ (s_in X B /\ lc_typ A).
Proof. intros X A B H. inversion H; subst; auto. Qed.

Lemma s_in_all_inv : forall X A,
  s_in X (typ_all A) ->
  exists L, forall Y, Y `notin` L -> s_in X (open_typ_wrt_typ A (typ_var_f Y)).
Proof. intros X A H. inversion H; subst. eauto. Qed.

Lemma s_in_union_inv : forall X A B,
  s_in X (typ_union A B) -> s_in X A /\ s_in X B.
Proof. intros X A B H. inversion H; subst; auto. Qed.

Lemma s_in_inter_inv : forall X A B,
  s_in X (typ_intersection A B) -> s_in X A /\ s_in X B.
Proof. intros X A B H. inversion H; subst; auto. Qed.

Lemma open_tsubst_fresh : forall s A X,
  nb_sigma s -> fresh_sigma X s ->
  tsubst_typ s (open_typ_wrt_typ A (typ_var_f X)) =
  open_typ_wrt_typ (tsubst_typ s A) (typ_var_f X).
Proof.
  intros s A X Hnb Hf.
  rewrite (open_tsubst s A (typ_var_f X) Hnb).
  - rewrite (tsubst_var_fresh s X Hf). reflexivity.
  - simpl; auto.
Qed.

Lemma Pwf_apply : forall Σ A, Pwf Σ A ->
  forall s Ψ, Arel s Σ Ψ -> d_wf_typ Ψ (tsubst_typ s A).
Proof. intros Σ A H s Ψ HA. unfold Pwf in H. apply H; auto. Qed.

Lemma Qsin_apply : forall Σ A, Qsin Σ A ->
  forall Z s Ψ, Arel s Σ Ψ -> s_in Z A -> fresh_sigma Z s -> s_in Z (tsubst_typ s A).
Proof. intros Σ A H Z s Ψ HA Hsi Hf. unfold Qsin in H. apply (H Z s Ψ); auto. Qed.

Lemma a_wf_typ_trans_mut : forall Σ A,
  a_wf_typ Σ A -> Pwf Σ A /\ Qsin Σ A.
Proof.
  intros Σ A H. induction H; split.
  - (* P unit *) intros s Ψ HA. rewrite tsubst_unit. constructor.
  - (* Q unit *) intros Z s Ψ HA Hsi Hf. inversion Hsi.
  - (* P bot *) intros s Ψ HA. rewrite tsubst_bot. constructor.
  - (* Q bot *) intros Z s Ψ HA Hsi Hf. inversion Hsi.
  - (* P top *) intros s Ψ HA. rewrite tsubst_top. constructor.
  - (* Q top *) intros Z s Ψ HA Hsi Hf. inversion Hsi.
  - (* P tvar *) intros s Ψ HA. rewrite tsubst_var_fresh.
    + apply d_wf_typ__tvar. eapply Arel_tvar; eauto.
    + eapply Arel_fresh_tvar; eauto.
  - (* Q tvar *) intros Z s Ψ HA Hsi Hf. inversion Hsi; subst.
    rewrite tsubst_var_fresh.
    + constructor.
    + eapply Arel_fresh_tvar; eauto.
  - (* P stvar *) intros s Ψ HA. rewrite tsubst_var_fresh.
    + apply d_wf_typ__stvar. eapply Arel_stvar; eauto.
    + eapply Arel_fresh_stvar; eauto.
  - (* Q stvar *) intros Z s Ψ HA Hsi Hf. inversion Hsi; subst.
    rewrite tsubst_var_fresh.
    + constructor.
    + eapply Arel_fresh_stvar; eauto.
  - (* P etvar *) intros s Ψ HA. apply d_mono_typ_wf.
    eapply Arel_etvar; eauto.
  - (* Q etvar *) intros Z s Ψ HA Hsi Hf. inversion Hsi; subst.
    exfalso. apply Hf. eapply Arel_etvar_in; eauto.
  - (* P arrow *) intros s Ψ HA. rewrite tsubst_arrow. constructor.
    + apply (Pwf_apply Σ A1 (proj1 IHa_wf_typ1) s Ψ HA).
    + apply (Pwf_apply Σ A2 (proj1 IHa_wf_typ2) s Ψ HA).
  - (* Q arrow *) intros Z s Ψ HA Hsi Hf.
    destruct (s_in_arrow_inv _ _ _ Hsi) as [[Hsi1 Hlc2]|[Hsi2 Hlc1]].
    + rewrite tsubst_arrow. apply s_in__arrow1.
      * apply lc_tsubst; [apply lc_sigma_of_nb; apply (Arel_nb s Σ Ψ HA) | exact Hlc2].
      * apply (Qsin_apply Σ A1 (proj2 IHa_wf_typ1) Z s Ψ HA Hsi1 Hf).
    + rewrite tsubst_arrow. apply s_in__arrow2.
      * apply lc_tsubst; [apply lc_sigma_of_nb; apply (Arel_nb s Σ Ψ HA) | exact Hlc1].
      * apply (Qsin_apply Σ A2 (proj2 IHa_wf_typ2) Z s Ψ HA Hsi2 Hf).
  - (* P all *) intros s Ψ HA.
    rewrite tsubst_all.
    eapply d_wf_typ__all with (L := union L (names_set s)).
    + intros X HX.
      assert (HXL : X `notin` L) by (apply notin_union_1 with (s' := names_set s); auto).
      assert (HXs : X `notin` names_set s) by (apply notin_union_2 with (s := L); auto).
      assert (HXf : fresh_sigma X s) by (apply notin_names_set; auto).
      pose proof (Qsin_apply (X ~ abind_tvar_empty ++ Σ) (open_typ_wrt_typ A (typ_var_f X))
                    (proj2 (H1 X HXL)) X s (X ~ dbind_tvar_empty ++ Ψ)
                    (Arel_tvar_ext s Σ Ψ X HA HXf) (H X HXL) HXf) as Hs.
      rewrite (open_tsubst_fresh s A X (Arel_nb _ _ _ HA) HXf) in Hs.
      exact Hs.
    + intros X HX.
      assert (HXL : X `notin` L) by (apply notin_union_1 with (s' := names_set s); auto).
      assert (HXs : X `notin` names_set s) by (apply notin_union_2 with (s := L); auto).
      assert (HXf : fresh_sigma X s) by (apply notin_names_set; auto).
      pose proof (Pwf_apply (X ~ abind_tvar_empty ++ Σ) (open_typ_wrt_typ A (typ_var_f X))
                    (proj1 (H1 X HXL)) s (X ~ dbind_tvar_empty ++ Ψ)
                    (Arel_tvar_ext s Σ Ψ X HA HXf)) as Hw.
      rewrite (open_tsubst_fresh s A X (Arel_nb _ _ _ HA) HXf) in Hw.
      exact Hw.
  - (* Q all *) intros Z s Ψ HA Hsi Hf.
    rewrite tsubst_all.
    destruct (s_in_all_inv _ _ Hsi) as [Lsi Hsi0].
    apply s_in__all with (L := union (union Lsi L) (names_set s)).
    intros Y HY.
    assert (HYsi : Y `notin` Lsi) by (apply notin_union_1 with (s' := union L (names_set s)); auto).
    assert (HYL : Y `notin` L) by (apply notin_union_1 with (s' := names_set s);
                                    apply notin_union_2 with (s := Lsi); auto).
    assert (HYs : Y `notin` names_set s) by (apply notin_union_2 with (s := union Lsi L); auto).
    assert (HYf : fresh_sigma Y s) by (apply notin_names_set; auto).
    pose proof (Qsin_apply (Y ~ abind_tvar_empty ++ Σ) (open_typ_wrt_typ A (typ_var_f Y))
                  (proj2 (H1 Y HYL)) Z s (Y ~ dbind_tvar_empty ++ Ψ)
                  (Arel_tvar_ext s Σ Ψ Y HA HYf) (Hsi0 Y HYsi) Hf) as Hs.
    rewrite (open_tsubst_fresh s A Y (Arel_nb _ _ _ HA) HYf) in Hs.
    exact Hs.
  - (* P union *) intros s Ψ HA. rewrite tsubst_union. constructor.
    + apply (Pwf_apply Σ A1 (proj1 IHa_wf_typ1) s Ψ HA).
    + apply (Pwf_apply Σ A2 (proj1 IHa_wf_typ2) s Ψ HA).
  - (* Q union *) intros Z s Ψ HA Hsi Hf.
    destruct (s_in_union_inv _ _ _ Hsi) as [Hsi1 Hsi2].
    rewrite tsubst_union. constructor.
    + apply (Qsin_apply Σ A1 (proj2 IHa_wf_typ1) Z s Ψ HA Hsi1 Hf).
    + apply (Qsin_apply Σ A2 (proj2 IHa_wf_typ2) Z s Ψ HA Hsi2 Hf).
  - (* P inter *) intros s Ψ HA. rewrite tsubst_inter. constructor.
    + apply (Pwf_apply Σ A1 (proj1 IHa_wf_typ1) s Ψ HA).
    + apply (Pwf_apply Σ A2 (proj1 IHa_wf_typ2) s Ψ HA).
  - (* Q inter *) intros Z s Ψ HA Hsi Hf.
    destruct (s_in_inter_inv _ _ _ Hsi) as [Hsi1 Hsi2].
    rewrite tsubst_inter. constructor.
    + apply (Qsin_apply Σ A1 (proj2 IHa_wf_typ1) Z s Ψ HA Hsi1 Hf).
    + apply (Qsin_apply Σ A2 (proj2 IHa_wf_typ2) Z s Ψ HA Hsi2 Hf).
Qed.

Lemma a_wf_typ_trans : forall s Σ Ψ A,
  a_wf_typ Σ A -> Arel s Σ Ψ -> d_wf_typ Ψ (tsubst_typ s A).
Proof. intros s Σ Ψ A H HA. apply (Pwf_apply _ _ (proj1 (a_wf_typ_trans_mut _ _ H)) s Ψ HA). Qed.

Lemma s_in_tsubst : forall s Σ Ψ Z A,
  a_wf_typ Σ A -> Arel s Σ Ψ -> s_in Z A -> fresh_sigma Z s ->
  s_in Z (tsubst_typ s A).
Proof. intros s Σ Ψ Z A H HA Hsi Hf.
  apply (Qsin_apply _ _ (proj2 (a_wf_typ_trans_mut _ _ H)) Z s Ψ HA Hsi Hf). Qed.

Lemma a_mono_typ_trans : forall s Σ Ψ A,
  Arel s Σ Ψ -> a_mono_typ Σ A -> d_mono_typ Ψ (tsubst_typ s A).
Proof.
  intros s Σ Ψ A HA HAmono. induction HAmono.
  - rewrite tsubst_unit. constructor.
  - rewrite tsubst_var_fresh.
    + constructor. eapply Arel_tvar; eauto.
    + eapply Arel_fresh_tvar; eauto.
  - eapply Arel_etvar; eauto.
  - rewrite tsubst_arrow. constructor; auto.
Qed.

Lemma d_mono_typ_d_wneq_all : forall Ψ A,
  d_mono_typ Ψ A -> d_wneq_all Ψ A.
Proof.
  intros Ψ A H. induction H.
  - constructor.
  - constructor. auto.
  - apply d_wneq_all__arrow.
    + exact (d_mono_typ_lc Ψ A1 H).
    + exact (d_mono_typ_lc Ψ A2 H0).
Qed.


Lemma a_wf_typ_arrow_inv : forall Σ A B,
  a_wf_typ Σ (typ_arrow A B) -> a_wf_typ Σ A /\ a_wf_typ Σ B.
Proof. intros Σ A B H. inversion H; auto. Qed.
Lemma a_wf_typ_union_inv : forall Σ A B,
  a_wf_typ Σ (typ_union A B) -> a_wf_typ Σ A /\ a_wf_typ Σ B.
Proof. intros Σ A B H. inversion H; auto. Qed.
Lemma a_wf_typ_inter_inv : forall Σ A B,
  a_wf_typ Σ (typ_intersection A B) -> a_wf_typ Σ A /\ a_wf_typ Σ B.
Proof. intros Σ A B H. inversion H; auto. Qed.

Lemma a_wneq_trans : forall Σ A,
  a_wf_typ Σ A -> a_wneq_all Σ A ->
  forall s Ψ, Arel s Σ Ψ -> d_wneq_all Ψ (tsubst_typ s A).
Proof.
  intros Σ A Hwf Hne. revert Hwf. induction Hne; intros Hwf s Ψ HA.
  - rewrite tsubst_unit. constructor.
  - rewrite tsubst_top. constructor.
  - rewrite tsubst_var_fresh.
    + constructor. eapply Arel_tvar; eauto.
    + eapply Arel_fresh_tvar; eauto.
  - apply d_mono_typ_d_wneq_all. eapply Arel_etvar; eauto.
  - rewrite tsubst_arrow. apply d_wneq_all__arrow.
    + apply lc_tsubst; [apply lc_sigma_of_nb; apply (Arel_nb s Σ Ψ HA) | auto].
    + apply lc_tsubst; [apply lc_sigma_of_nb; apply (Arel_nb s Σ Ψ HA) | auto].
  - rewrite tsubst_union. apply d_wneq_all__union1.
    + apply lc_tsubst; [apply lc_sigma_of_nb; apply (Arel_nb s Σ Ψ HA) | auto].
    + destruct (a_wf_typ_union_inv _ _ _ Hwf) as [Hwf1 Hwf2].
      apply (IHHne Hwf1 s Ψ HA).
  - rewrite tsubst_union. apply d_wneq_all__union2.
    + apply lc_tsubst; [apply lc_sigma_of_nb; apply (Arel_nb s Σ Ψ HA) | auto].
    + destruct (a_wf_typ_union_inv _ _ _ Hwf) as [Hwf1 Hwf2].
      apply (IHHne Hwf2 s Ψ HA).
  - rewrite tsubst_inter. apply d_wneq_all__intersection2.
    + destruct (a_wf_typ_inter_inv _ _ _ Hwf) as [Hwf1 Hwf2].
      apply (IHHne1 Hwf1 s Ψ HA).
    + destruct (a_wf_typ_inter_inv _ _ _ Hwf) as [Hwf1 Hwf2].
      apply (IHHne2 Hwf2 s Ψ HA).
Qed.

(* ---------- d-side type well-formedness of work items ---------- *)
Fixpoint dwf_exp (Ψ : denv) (e : exp) {struct e} : Prop :=
  match e with
  | exp_unit => True
  | exp_var_b _ => True
  | exp_var_f _ => True
  | exp_abs e' => dwf_exp Ψ e'
  | exp_app e1 e2 => dwf_exp Ψ e1 /\ dwf_exp Ψ e2
  | exp_tabs e' =>
      match e' with
      | exp_anno e'' A => d_wf_typ Ψ (typ_all A) /\ dwf_exp Ψ e''
      | _ => False
      end
  | exp_tapp e' A => dwf_exp Ψ e' /\ d_wf_typ Ψ A
  | exp_anno e' A => dwf_exp Ψ e' /\ d_wf_typ Ψ A
  end.

Fixpoint dwf_conts (Ψ : denv) (cs : conts) {struct cs} : Prop :=
  match cs with
  | conts_infabs cd => dwf_contd Ψ cd
  | conts_inftapp A cs' => d_wf_typ Ψ A /\ dwf_conts Ψ cs'
  | conts_inftappunion A1 A2 cs' => d_wf_typ Ψ A1 /\ d_wf_typ Ψ A2 /\ dwf_conts Ψ cs'
  | conts_unioninftapp A cs' => d_wf_typ Ψ A /\ dwf_conts Ψ cs'
  | conts_sub A => d_wf_typ Ψ A
  end
with dwf_contd (Ψ : denv) (cd : contd) {struct cd} : Prop :=
  match cd with
  | contd_infabsunion A cd' => d_wf_typ Ψ A /\ dwf_contd Ψ cd'
  | contd_infapp e cs => dwf_exp Ψ e /\ dwf_conts Ψ cs
  | contd_unioninfabs A B cd' => d_wf_typ Ψ (typ_arrow A B) /\ dwf_contd Ψ cd'
  end.

Fixpoint dwf_work (Ψ : denv) (w : work) {struct w} : Prop :=
  match w with
  | work_infer e cs => dwf_exp Ψ e /\ dwf_conts Ψ cs
  | work_check e A => dwf_exp Ψ e /\ d_wf_typ Ψ A
  | work_infabs A cd => d_wf_typ Ψ A /\ dwf_contd Ψ cd
  | work_infabsunion A1 B1 A2 cd => d_wf_typ Ψ (typ_arrow A1 B1) /\ d_wf_typ Ψ A2 /\ dwf_contd Ψ cd
  | work_infapp A B e cs => d_wf_typ Ψ (typ_arrow A B) /\ dwf_exp Ψ e /\ dwf_conts Ψ cs
  | work_inftapp A1 A2 cs => d_wf_typ Ψ A1 /\ d_wf_typ Ψ A2 /\ dwf_conts Ψ cs
  | work_sub A1 A2 => d_wf_typ Ψ A1 /\ d_wf_typ Ψ A2
  | work_inftappunion A1 A2 B cs => d_wf_typ Ψ A1 /\ d_wf_typ Ψ A2 /\ d_wf_typ Ψ B /\ dwf_conts Ψ cs
  | work_unioninftapp A1 A2 cs => d_wf_typ Ψ A1 /\ d_wf_typ Ψ A2 /\ dwf_conts Ψ cs
  | work_unioninfabs A1 B1 A2 B2 cd => d_wf_typ Ψ (typ_arrow A1 B1) /\ d_wf_typ Ψ (typ_arrow A2 B2) /\ dwf_contd Ψ cd
  | work_applys cs A => d_wf_typ Ψ A /\ dwf_conts Ψ cs
  | work_applyd cd A B => d_wf_typ Ψ A /\ d_wf_typ Ψ B /\ dwf_contd Ψ cd
  end.

(* ---------- tsubst homomorphisms for expressions/continuations/work ---------- *)
Lemma tsubst_exp_unit : forall s, tsubst_exp s exp_unit = exp_unit.
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma tsubst_exp_varb : forall s n, tsubst_exp s (exp_var_b n) = exp_var_b n.
Proof. intros s n. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma tsubst_exp_varf : forall s x, tsubst_exp s (exp_var_f x) = exp_var_f x.
Proof. intros s x. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma tsubst_exp_abs : forall s e, tsubst_exp s (exp_abs e) = exp_abs (tsubst_exp s e).
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; intros e; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma tsubst_exp_app : forall s e1 e2, tsubst_exp s (exp_app e1 e2) = exp_app (tsubst_exp s e1) (tsubst_exp s e2).
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; intros e1 e2; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma tsubst_exp_tabs : forall s e, tsubst_exp s (exp_tabs e) = exp_tabs (tsubst_exp s e).
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; intros e; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma tsubst_exp_tapp : forall s e A, tsubst_exp s (exp_tapp e A) = exp_tapp (tsubst_exp s e) (tsubst_typ s A).
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; intros e A; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma tsubst_exp_anno : forall s e A, tsubst_exp s (exp_anno e A) = exp_anno (tsubst_exp s e) (tsubst_typ s A).
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; intros e A; simpl; auto. Qed.

Lemma tsubst_conts_sub : forall s A, tsubst_conts s (conts_sub A) = conts_sub (tsubst_typ s A).
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; intros A; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma tsubst_conts_infabs : forall s cd, tsubst_conts s (conts_infabs cd) = conts_infabs (tsubst_contd s cd).
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; intros cd; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma tsubst_conts_inftapp : forall s A cs, tsubst_conts s (conts_inftapp A cs) = conts_inftapp (tsubst_typ s A) (tsubst_conts s cs).
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; intros A cs; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma tsubst_conts_inftappunion : forall s A1 A2 cs,
  tsubst_conts s (conts_inftappunion A1 A2 cs) = conts_inftappunion (tsubst_typ s A1) (tsubst_typ s A2) (tsubst_conts s cs).
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; intros A1 A2 cs; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma tsubst_conts_unioninftapp : forall s A cs,
  tsubst_conts s (conts_unioninftapp A cs) = conts_unioninftapp (tsubst_typ s A) (tsubst_conts s cs).
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; intros A cs; simpl; auto. Qed.

Lemma tsubst_contd_infabsunion : forall s A cd,
  tsubst_contd s (contd_infabsunion A cd) = contd_infabsunion (tsubst_typ s A) (tsubst_contd s cd).
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; intros A cd; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma tsubst_contd_infapp : forall s e cs,
  tsubst_contd s (contd_infapp e cs) = contd_infapp (tsubst_exp s e) (tsubst_conts s cs).
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; intros e cs; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma tsubst_contd_unioninfabs : forall s A B cd,
  tsubst_contd s (contd_unioninfabs A B cd) = contd_unioninfabs (tsubst_typ s A) (tsubst_typ s B) (tsubst_contd s cd).
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; intros A B cd; simpl; auto. Qed.

Lemma tsubst_work_infer : forall s e cs, tsubst_work s (work_infer e cs) = work_infer (tsubst_exp s e) (tsubst_conts s cs).
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; intros e cs; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma tsubst_work_check : forall s e A, tsubst_work s (work_check e A) = work_check (tsubst_exp s e) (tsubst_typ s A).
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; intros e A; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma tsubst_work_infabs : forall s A cd, tsubst_work s (work_infabs A cd) = work_infabs (tsubst_typ s A) (tsubst_contd s cd).
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; intros A cd; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma tsubst_work_infabsunion : forall s A1 B1 A2 cd,
  tsubst_work s (work_infabsunion A1 B1 A2 cd) = work_infabsunion (tsubst_typ s A1) (tsubst_typ s B1) (tsubst_typ s A2) (tsubst_contd s cd).
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; intros A1 B1 A2 cd; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma tsubst_work_infapp : forall s A B e cs,
  tsubst_work s (work_infapp A B e cs) = work_infapp (tsubst_typ s A) (tsubst_typ s B) (tsubst_exp s e) (tsubst_conts s cs).
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; intros A B e cs; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma tsubst_work_inftapp : forall s A1 A2 cs,
  tsubst_work s (work_inftapp A1 A2 cs) = work_inftapp (tsubst_typ s A1) (tsubst_typ s A2) (tsubst_conts s cs).
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; intros A1 A2 cs; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma tsubst_work_sub : forall s A B, tsubst_work s (work_sub A B) = work_sub (tsubst_typ s A) (tsubst_typ s B).
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; intros A B; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma tsubst_work_inftappunion : forall s A1 A2 B cs,
  tsubst_work s (work_inftappunion A1 A2 B cs) = work_inftappunion (tsubst_typ s A1) (tsubst_typ s A2) (tsubst_typ s B) (tsubst_conts s cs).
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; intros A1 A2 B cs; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma tsubst_work_unioninftapp : forall s A1 A2 cs,
  tsubst_work s (work_unioninftapp A1 A2 cs) = work_unioninftapp (tsubst_typ s A1) (tsubst_typ s A2) (tsubst_conts s cs).
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; intros A1 A2 cs; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma tsubst_work_unioninfabs : forall s A1 B1 A2 B2 cd,
  tsubst_work s (work_unioninfabs A1 B1 A2 B2 cd) = work_unioninfabs (tsubst_typ s A1) (tsubst_typ s B1) (tsubst_typ s A2) (tsubst_typ s B2) (tsubst_contd s cd).
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; intros A1 B1 A2 B2 cd; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma tsubst_work_applys : forall s cs A, tsubst_work s (work_applys cs A) = work_applys (tsubst_conts s cs) (tsubst_typ s A).
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; intros cs A; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma tsubst_work_applyd : forall s cd A B, tsubst_work s (work_applyd cd A B) = work_applyd (tsubst_contd s cd) (tsubst_typ s A) (tsubst_typ s B).
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; intros cd A B; simpl; auto. Qed.

Lemma tw_exp_trans_aux : forall n e,
  size_exp e <= n -> forall Σ, tw_exp Σ e ->
  forall s Ψ, Arel s Σ Ψ -> dwf_exp Ψ (tsubst_exp s e).
Proof.
  induction n as [| n IH]; intros e Hn Σ Htw s Ψ HA.
  - destruct e; simpl in Hn; exfalso; lia.
  - destruct e as [| nb | x | e0 | e1 e2 | e' | e0 A | e0 A]; simpl in Hn.
    + rewrite tsubst_exp_unit. constructor.
    + rewrite tsubst_exp_varb. constructor.
    + rewrite tsubst_exp_varf. constructor.
    + rewrite tsubst_exp_abs. simpl. apply (IH e0 ltac:(simpl; lia) Σ Htw s Ψ HA).
    + rewrite tsubst_exp_app. destruct Htw as [H1 H2]. constructor.
      * apply (IH e1 ltac:(simpl; lia) Σ H1 s Ψ HA).
      * apply (IH e2 ltac:(simpl; lia) Σ H2 s Ψ HA).
    + (* tabs *) rewrite tsubst_exp_tabs.
      destruct e' as [| nb0 | x0 | e0 | e1 e2 | e0 | e0 A0 | e0 A0]; simpl in *.
      * destruct Htw.
      * destruct Htw.
      * destruct Htw.
      * destruct Htw.
      * destruct Htw.
      * destruct Htw.
      * destruct Htw.
      * (* anno *) rewrite tsubst_exp_anno. simpl.
        destruct Htw as [H1 H2]. constructor.
        -- rewrite <- tsubst_all. apply a_wf_typ_trans with (s := s) (Σ := Σ) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
        -- apply (IH e0 ltac:(simpl; lia) Σ H2 s Ψ HA).
    + (* tapp *) rewrite tsubst_exp_tapp. destruct Htw as [H1 H2]. constructor.
      * apply (IH e0 ltac:(simpl; lia) Σ H1 s Ψ HA).
      * apply a_wf_typ_trans with (s := s) (Σ := Σ) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + (* anno *) rewrite tsubst_exp_anno. destruct Htw as [H1 H2]. constructor.
      * apply (IH e0 ltac:(simpl; lia) Σ H1 s Ψ HA).
      * apply a_wf_typ_trans with (s := s) (Σ := Σ) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
Qed.

Lemma tw_exp_trans : forall Σ e,
  tw_exp Σ e -> forall s Ψ, Arel s Σ Ψ -> dwf_exp Ψ (tsubst_exp s e).
Proof.
  intros Σ e Htw s Ψ HA. eapply tw_exp_trans_aux with (n := size_exp e); eauto.
Qed.



Lemma tw_conts_contd_trans_mut : forall Σ,
  (forall cs, tw_conts Σ cs -> forall s Ψ, Arel s Σ Ψ -> dwf_conts Ψ (tsubst_conts s cs)) /\
  (forall cd, tw_contd Σ cd -> forall s Ψ, Arel s Σ Ψ -> dwf_contd Ψ (tsubst_contd s cd)).
Proof.
  intros Σ.
  assert (H : (forall cd, tw_contd Σ cd ->
                 forall s Ψ, Arel s Σ Ψ -> dwf_contd Ψ (tsubst_contd s cd)) /\
              (forall cs, tw_conts Σ cs ->
                 forall s Ψ, Arel s Σ Ψ -> dwf_conts Ψ (tsubst_conts s cs))).
  { apply contd_conts_mutind.
    - (* infabsunion *) intros A cd IH Htw s Ψ HA. simpl in Htw. destruct Htw as [H1 H2].
      rewrite tsubst_contd_infabsunion. simpl. constructor.
      + apply a_wf_typ_trans with (s := s) (Σ := Σ) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
      + apply IH; auto.
    - (* infapp *) intros e cs IH Htw s Ψ HA. simpl in Htw. destruct Htw as [H1 H2].
      rewrite tsubst_contd_infapp. simpl. constructor.
      + apply tw_exp_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
      + apply IH; auto.
    - (* unioninfabs *) intros A B cd IH Htw s Ψ HA. simpl in Htw. destruct Htw as [H1 H2].
      rewrite tsubst_contd_unioninfabs. simpl. constructor.
      + rewrite <- tsubst_arrow. apply a_wf_typ_trans with (s := s) (Σ := Σ) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
      + apply IH; auto.
    - (* infabs *) intros cd IH Htw s Ψ HA. simpl in Htw.
      rewrite tsubst_conts_infabs. simpl. apply (IH Htw s Ψ HA).
    - (* inftapp *) intros A cs IH Htw s Ψ HA. simpl in Htw. destruct Htw as [H1 H2].
      rewrite tsubst_conts_inftapp. simpl. constructor.
      + apply a_wf_typ_trans with (s := s) (Σ := Σ) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
      + apply IH; auto.
    - (* inftappunion *) intros A1 A2 cs IH Htw s Ψ HA. simpl in Htw.
      destruct Htw as [H1 [H2 H3]]. rewrite tsubst_conts_inftappunion. simpl. constructor.
      + apply a_wf_typ_trans with (s := s) (Σ := Σ) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
      + constructor.
        * apply a_wf_typ_trans with (s := s) (Σ := Σ) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
        * apply IH; auto.
    - (* unioninftapp *) intros A cs IH Htw s Ψ HA. simpl in Htw. destruct Htw as [H1 H2].
      rewrite tsubst_conts_unioninftapp. simpl. constructor.
      + apply a_wf_typ_trans with (s := s) (Σ := Σ) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
      + apply IH; auto.
    - (* sub *) intros A Htw s Ψ HA. simpl in Htw. rewrite tsubst_conts_sub. simpl.
      apply a_wf_typ_trans with (s := s) (Σ := Σ) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
  }
  destruct H as [Hcd Hcs]. split.
  - apply Hcs.
  - apply Hcd.
Qed.

Lemma tw_conts_trans : forall Σ cs, tw_conts Σ cs ->
  forall s Ψ, Arel s Σ Ψ -> dwf_conts Ψ (tsubst_conts s cs).
Proof. intros Σ cs H. apply (proj1 (tw_conts_contd_trans_mut Σ)); auto. Qed.

Lemma tw_contd_trans : forall Σ cd, tw_contd Σ cd ->
  forall s Ψ, Arel s Σ Ψ -> dwf_contd Ψ (tsubst_contd s cd).
Proof. intros Σ cd H. apply (proj2 (tw_conts_contd_trans_mut Σ)); auto. Qed.

Lemma tw_work_trans : forall Σ w,
  tw_work Σ w -> forall s Ψ, Arel s Σ Ψ -> dwf_work Ψ (tsubst_work s w).
Proof.
  intros Σ w. induction w as [e cs | e A | A cd | A1 B1 A2 cd | A B e cs | A1 A2 cs | A1 A2 | A1 A2 B cs | A1 A2 cs | A1 B1 A2 B2 cd | cs A | cd A B];
    intros Htw s Ψ HA; simpl in Htw.
  - rewrite tsubst_work_infer. simpl. destruct Htw as [H1 H2]. repeat split.
    + apply tw_exp_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + apply tw_conts_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
  - rewrite tsubst_work_check. simpl. destruct Htw as [H1 H2]. repeat split.
    + apply tw_exp_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + apply a_wf_typ_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
  - rewrite tsubst_work_infabs. simpl. destruct Htw as [H1 H2]. repeat split.
    + apply a_wf_typ_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + apply tw_contd_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
  - rewrite tsubst_work_infabsunion. simpl. destruct Htw as [H1 [H2 H3]]. repeat split.
    + rewrite <- tsubst_arrow. apply a_wf_typ_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + apply a_wf_typ_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + apply tw_contd_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
  - rewrite tsubst_work_infapp. simpl. destruct Htw as [H1 [H2 H3]]. repeat split.
    + rewrite <- tsubst_arrow. apply a_wf_typ_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + apply tw_exp_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + apply tw_conts_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
  - rewrite tsubst_work_inftapp. simpl. destruct Htw as [H1 [H2 H3]]. repeat split.
    + apply a_wf_typ_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + apply a_wf_typ_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + apply tw_conts_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
  - rewrite tsubst_work_sub. simpl. destruct Htw as [H1 H2]. repeat split.
    + apply a_wf_typ_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + apply a_wf_typ_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
  - rewrite tsubst_work_inftappunion. simpl. destruct Htw as [H1 [H2 [H3 H4]]]. repeat split.
    + apply a_wf_typ_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + apply a_wf_typ_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + apply a_wf_typ_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + apply tw_conts_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
  - rewrite tsubst_work_unioninftapp. simpl. destruct Htw as [H1 [H2 H3]]. repeat split.
    + apply a_wf_typ_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + apply a_wf_typ_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + apply tw_conts_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
  - rewrite tsubst_work_unioninfabs. simpl. destruct Htw as [H1 [H2 H3]]. repeat split.
    + rewrite <- tsubst_arrow. apply a_wf_typ_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + rewrite <- tsubst_arrow. apply a_wf_typ_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + apply tw_contd_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
  - rewrite tsubst_work_applys. simpl. destruct Htw as [H1 H2]. repeat split.
    + apply a_wf_typ_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + apply tw_conts_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
  - rewrite tsubst_work_applyd. simpl. destruct Htw as [H1 [H2 H3]]. repeat split.
    + apply a_wf_typ_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + apply a_wf_typ_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + apply tw_contd_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
Qed.


(* ---------- erasure commutes with substituting an etvar away ---------- *)
Lemma eraseσ_subst : forall A X s Γ,
  eraseσ s (subst_typ_in_aworklist A X Γ) = eraseσ ((X,A) :: s) Γ.
Proof.
  intros A X s Γ. induction Γ as [| Γ' IH Y b | Γ' IH w]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct b; simpl.
    + rewrite IH. reflexivity.
    + rewrite IH. reflexivity.
    + rewrite IH. reflexivity.
    + rewrite IH. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ---------- stvar-free environments ---------- *)
Definition stvar_free (Ψ : denv) : Prop :=
  forall X, binds X (dbind_stvar_empty) Ψ -> False.

Lemma d_wf_env_tenv : forall Ψ, d_wf_env Ψ -> stvar_free Ψ -> d_wf_tenv Ψ.
Proof.
  intros Ψ H. induction H as [Ψ Htenv | Ψ X Hwf Hfresh IH].
  - intros _. exact Htenv.
  - intros Hfree. exfalso. apply (Hfree X). constructor. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ---------- syntactic "needs a term environment" predicate ---------- *)
Fixpoint tenv_needed_conts (cs : conts) : Prop :=
  match cs with
  | conts_sub _ => False
  | _ => True
  end
with tenv_needed_contd (cd : contd) : Prop := True.

Definition tenv_needed_work (w : work) : Prop :=
  match w with
  | work_sub _ _ => False
  | work_applys cs _ => tenv_needed_conts cs
  | _ => True
  end.

(* ---------- the soundness invariant ---------- *)
Lemma binds_aenv_to_denv_tvar : forall s Σ X,
  binds X (abind_tvar_empty) Σ -> binds X (dbind_tvar_empty) (aenv_to_denv s Σ).
Proof.
  intros s Σ. induction Σ as [|[Y b] Σ IH]; intros X Hb; simpl in *.
  - contradiction.
  - destruct b; simpl.
    + apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
      * subst. apply binds_cons_2; auto.
      * apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
      * subst. discriminate e2.
      * apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
      * subst. discriminate e2.
      * auto.
    + apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
      * subst. discriminate e2.
      * apply binds_cons_3; auto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_aenv_to_denv_stvar : forall s Σ X,
  binds X (abind_stvar_empty) Σ -> binds X (dbind_stvar_empty) (aenv_to_denv s Σ).
Proof.
  intros s Σ. induction Σ as [|[Y b] Σ IH]; intros X Hb; simpl in *.
  - contradiction.
  - destruct b; simpl.
    + apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
      * subst. discriminate e2.
      * apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
      * subst. apply binds_cons_2; auto.
      * apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
      * subst. discriminate e2.
      * auto.
    + apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
      * subst. discriminate e2.
      * apply binds_cons_3; auto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_aenv_to_denv_var : forall s Σ x A,
  binds x (abind_var_typ A) Σ ->
  binds x (dbind_typ (tsubst_typ s A)) (aenv_to_denv s Σ).
Proof.
  intros s Σ. induction Σ as [|[Y b] Σ IH]; intros x A Hb; simpl in *.
  - contradiction.
  - destruct b; simpl.
    + apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
      * subst. discriminate e2.
      * apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
      * subst. discriminate e2.
      * apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
      * subst. discriminate e2.
      * auto.
    + apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
      * inversion e2; subst. apply binds_cons_2; auto.
      * apply binds_cons_3; auto.
Qed.

Lemma Arel_of_inv : forall s Σ Ψ,
  Ψ = aenv_to_denv s Σ -> nb_sigma s ->
  (forall X, binds X (abind_tvar_empty) Σ -> fresh_sigma X s) ->
  (forall X, binds X (abind_stvar_empty) Σ -> fresh_sigma X s) ->
  (forall X, binds X (abind_etvar_empty) Σ -> In X (names s)) ->
  (forall X, binds X (abind_etvar_empty) Σ ->
     d_mono_typ Ψ (tsubst_typ s (typ_var_f X))) ->
  Arel s Σ Ψ.
Proof.
  intros s Σ Ψ Heq Hnb Hft Hfs Hin He.
  subst Ψ. unfold Arel. repeat split.
  - exact Hnb.
  - intros X Hb. apply binds_aenv_to_denv_tvar; auto.
  - intros X Hb. apply binds_aenv_to_denv_stvar; auto.
  - intros X Hb. apply He; auto.
  - intros X Hb. apply Hin; auto.
  - intros X Hb. apply Hft; auto.
  - intros X Hb. apply Hfs; auto.
  - intros x A Hb. apply binds_aenv_to_denv_var; auto.
Qed.

Lemma d_wf_tenv_cons_tail : forall x b Ψ,
  d_wf_tenv (x ~ b ++ Ψ) -> d_wf_tenv Ψ.
Proof.
  intros x b Ψ H. destruct b.
  - inversion H; assumption.
  - inversion H.
  - inversion H; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma d_wf_env_cons_tail : forall x b Ψ,
  d_wf_env (x ~ b ++ Ψ) -> d_wf_env Ψ.
Proof.
  intros x b Ψ H. remember (x ~ b ++ Ψ) as E eqn:EE.
  induction H; subst; simpl in *.
  - apply d_wf_env__empty.
    match goal with Ht : d_wf_tenv _ |- _ => apply d_wf_tenv_cons_tail in Ht; exact Ht end.
  - inversion EE; subst. match goal with Hw : d_wf_env _ |- _ => exact Hw end.
Qed.

Lemma stvar_free_cons_tail : forall x b Ψ,
  stvar_free (x ~ b ++ Ψ) -> stvar_free Ψ.
Proof.
  intros x b Ψ H X HX. unfold stvar_free in H. apply (H X). apply binds_cons_3; auto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_dbind_typ_tvar : forall Y x A Ψ,
  binds Y (dbind_tvar_empty) (x ~ dbind_typ A ++ Ψ) -> binds Y (dbind_tvar_empty) Ψ.
Proof. intros. apply binds_cons_1 in H as [[e1 e2]|H]; [discriminate e2|exact H]. Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_stvar_tvar : forall Y X Ψ,
  binds Y (dbind_tvar_empty) (X ~ dbind_stvar_empty ++ Ψ) -> binds Y (dbind_tvar_empty) Ψ.
Proof. intros. apply binds_cons_1 in H as [[e1 e2]|H]; [discriminate e2|exact H]. Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_tvar_tvar : forall Y X Ψ,
  binds Y (dbind_tvar_empty) (X ~ dbind_tvar_empty ++ Ψ) ->
  Y = X \/ binds Y (dbind_tvar_empty) Ψ.
Proof. intros. apply binds_cons_1 in H as [[e1 e2]|H]; [left; auto|right; exact H]. Qed.

Lemma d_mono_typ_remove_typ : forall x A Ψ T,
  d_mono_typ (x ~ dbind_typ A ++ Ψ) T -> d_mono_typ Ψ T.
Proof.
  intros x A Ψ T H. dependent induction H.
  - constructor.
  - constructor. apply binds_cons_dbind_typ_tvar in H. exact H.
  - constructor.
    + apply (IHd_mono_typ1 x A Ψ); reflexivity.
    + apply (IHd_mono_typ2 x A Ψ); reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma d_mono_typ_remove_stvar : forall X Ψ T,
  d_mono_typ (X ~ dbind_stvar_empty ++ Ψ) T -> d_mono_typ Ψ T.
Proof.
  intros X Ψ T H. dependent induction H.
  - constructor.
  - constructor. match goal with Hb : binds _ (dbind_tvar_empty) (X ~ dbind_stvar_empty ++ Ψ) |- _ =>
      apply binds_cons_stvar_tvar in Hb; exact Hb end.
  - constructor.
    + apply (IHd_mono_typ1 X Ψ); reflexivity.
    + apply (IHd_mono_typ2 X Ψ); reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma d_mono_typ_remove_tvar : forall X Ψ T,
  X `notin` ftvar_in_typ T ->
  d_mono_typ (X ~ dbind_tvar_empty ++ Ψ) T -> d_mono_typ Ψ T.
Proof.
  intros X Ψ T Hfresh H. dependent induction H.
  - constructor.
  - constructor. apply binds_cons_tvar_tvar in H. destruct H as [e|H].
    + subst. exfalso. apply Hfresh. simpl. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2; reflexivity.
    + exact H.
  - constructor.
    + assert (Hf1 : X `notin` ftvar_in_typ A1)
        by (intro Hi; apply Hfresh; simpl; apply AtomSetImpl.union_2; exact Hi).
      apply (IHd_mono_typ1 X Ψ Hf1); reflexivity.
    + assert (Hf2 : X `notin` ftvar_in_typ A2)
        by (intro Hi; apply Hfresh; simpl; apply AtomSetImpl.union_3; exact Hi).
      apply (IHd_mono_typ2 X Ψ Hf2); reflexivity.
  Qed.

(* A d-monotype can only mention type variables bound as tvars. *)
Lemma d_mono_typ_ftvar : forall Ψ T,
  d_mono_typ Ψ T ->
  forall X, X `in` ftvar_in_typ T -> binds X (dbind_tvar_empty) Ψ.
Proof.
  intros Ψ T HH. rename HH into H0.
  induction H0.
  - intros Z HX. simpl in HX. exfalso. exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 (a:=Z) HX).
  - intros Z HX. simpl in HX. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_1 in HX. subst Z. assumption.
  - intros Z HX. simpl in HX. apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in HX as [HX|HX].
    + apply IHd_mono_typ1; auto.
    + apply IHd_mono_typ2; auto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_tvar_aenv_to_denv_inv : forall s Σ X,
  binds X (dbind_tvar_empty) (aenv_to_denv s Σ) ->
  binds X (abind_tvar_empty) Σ.
Proof.
  intros s Σ. induction Σ as [|[Y b] Σ IH]; intros X HX; simpl in *.
  - contradiction.
  - destruct b; simpl in *.
    + apply binds_cons_1 in HX as [[e1 e2]|HX].
      * subst. apply binds_cons_2; auto.
      * apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + apply binds_cons_1 in HX as [[e1 e2]|HX]; [|apply binds_cons_3; auto].
      subst. discriminate e2.
    + apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + apply binds_cons_1 in HX as [[e1 e2]|HX]; [|apply binds_cons_3; auto].
      subst. discriminate e2.
Qed.

(* Substituting a different atom Y for X does not introduce X. *)
Lemma subst_typ_in_typ_notin : forall A X Y T,
  X <> Y ->
  X `notin` ftvar_in_typ A ->
  X `notin` ftvar_in_typ T ->
  X `notin` ftvar_in_typ (subst_typ_in_typ T Y A).
Proof.
  intros A.
  induction A as [| | | n | X0 | A1 IH1 A2 IH2 | A0 IH0 | A1 IH1 A2 IH2 | A1 IH1 A2 IH2];
    intros X Y T Hne HA HT; simpl in *.
  - intro Hc; exfalso; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 (a:=X) Hc).
  - intro Hc; exfalso; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 (a:=X) Hc).
  - intro Hc; exfalso; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 (a:=X) Hc).
  - intro Hc; exfalso; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 (a:=X) Hc).
  - destruct (eq_var X0 Y) as [e|e]; simpl.
    + exact HT.
    + exact HA.
  - intro Hc. apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in Hc as [Hc|Hc].
    + assert (HA1 : X `notin` ftvar_in_typ A1)
        by (intro Hi; apply HA; apply AtomSetImpl.union_2; exact Hi).
      exact (IH1 X Y T Hne HA1 HT Hc).
    + assert (HA2 : X `notin` ftvar_in_typ A2)
        by (intro Hi; apply HA; apply AtomSetImpl.union_3; exact Hi).
      exact (IH2 X Y T Hne HA2 HT Hc).
  - exact (IH0 X Y T Hne HA HT).
  - intro Hc. apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in Hc as [Hc|Hc].
    + assert (HA1 : X `notin` ftvar_in_typ A1)
        by (intro Hi; apply HA; apply AtomSetImpl.union_2; exact Hi).
      exact (IH1 X Y T Hne HA1 HT Hc).
    + assert (HA2 : X `notin` ftvar_in_typ A2)
        by (intro Hi; apply HA; apply AtomSetImpl.union_3; exact Hi).
      exact (IH2 X Y T Hne HA2 HT Hc).
  - intro Hc. apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in Hc as [Hc|Hc].
    + assert (HA1 : X `notin` ftvar_in_typ A1)
        by (intro Hi; apply HA; apply AtomSetImpl.union_2; exact Hi).
      exact (IH1 X Y T Hne HA1 HT Hc).
    + assert (HA2 : X `notin` ftvar_in_typ A2)
        by (intro Hi; apply HA; apply AtomSetImpl.union_3; exact Hi).
      exact (IH2 X Y T Hne HA2 HT Hc).
Qed.

(* A typed substitution neither introduces an atom that is neither a key
   nor mentioned by any of the substituted types nor by the argument. *)
Lemma tsubst_typ_notin : forall s A X,
  fresh_sigma X s ->
  (forall Y T, In (Y,T) s -> X `notin` ftvar_in_typ T) ->
  X `notin` ftvar_in_typ A ->
  X `notin` ftvar_in_typ (tsubst_typ s A).
Proof.
  intros s. induction s as [|[Y T] s IH]; intros A X Hf Hval HA; simpl.
  - exact HA.
  - assert (Hneq : X <> Y).
    { intro e. apply Hf. subst. simpl. auto. }
    assert (Hfs : fresh_sigma X s).
    { intros Hin. apply Hf. simpl. auto. }
    assert (HvalT : X `notin` ftvar_in_typ T).
    { apply (Hval Y T). simpl. auto. }
    assert (Hvals : forall Y0 T0, In (Y0,T0) s -> X `notin` ftvar_in_typ T0).
    { intros Y0 T0 Hin. apply (Hval Y0 T0). apply List.in_cons. exact Hin. }
    apply IH.
    + exact Hfs.
    + exact Hvals.
    + exact (subst_typ_in_typ_notin A X Y T Hneq HA HvalT).
Qed.

Definition stvar_free_aenv (Σ : aenv) : Prop :=
  forall X, binds X (abind_stvar_empty) Σ -> False.

Lemma binds_stvar_aenv_to_denv_inv : forall s Σ X,
  binds X (dbind_stvar_empty) (aenv_to_denv s Σ) ->
  binds X (abind_stvar_empty) Σ.
Proof.
  intros s Σ. induction Σ as [|[Y b] Σ IH]; intros X HX; simpl in *.
  - contradiction.
  - destruct b; simpl in *.
    + apply binds_cons_1 in HX as [[e1 e2]|HX]; [discriminate e2|apply binds_cons_3; auto].
    + apply binds_cons_1 in HX as [[e1 e2]|HX]; [|apply binds_cons_3; auto].
      subst. apply binds_cons_2; auto.
    + apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + apply binds_cons_1 in HX as [[e1 e2]|HX]; [discriminate e2|apply binds_cons_3; auto].
Qed.

Lemma stvar_free_aenv_denv : forall s Σ,
  stvar_free_aenv Σ -> stvar_free (aenv_to_denv s Σ).
Proof.
  intros s Σ H X HX. apply (H X). apply binds_stvar_aenv_to_denv_inv with (s := s); auto.
Qed.

Lemma tenv_needed_work_subst : forall A X w,
  tenv_needed_work (subst_typ_in_work A X w) = tenv_needed_work w.
Proof.
  intros A X w. destruct w; simpl; try reflexivity.
  destruct cs; simpl; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma tenv_needed_work_tsubst : forall s w,
  tenv_needed_work (tsubst_work s w) = tenv_needed_work w.
Proof.
  intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; intros w; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. rewrite tenv_needed_work_subst. reflexivity.
Qed.

Definition full_arel (s : list (typvar * typ)) (Γ : aworklist) : Prop :=
  Arel s (awl_to_aenv Γ) (aenv_to_denv s (awl_to_aenv Γ)).

Definition full_envok (s : list (typvar * typ)) (Γ : aworklist) : Prop :=
  d_wf_env (aenv_to_denv s (awl_to_aenv Γ)).

Fixpoint tshape (Γ : aworklist) : Prop :=
  match Γ with
  | aworklist_empty => True
  | aworklist_cons_var Γ' _ _ => tshape Γ'
  | aworklist_cons_work Γ' w =>
      tshape Γ' /\ (tenv_needed_work w -> stvar_free_aenv (awl_to_aenv Γ'))
  end.

Definition head_ok (Γ : aworklist) : Prop :=
  match Γ with
  | aworklist_cons_work Γ' w =>
      tenv_needed_work w -> stvar_free_aenv (awl_to_aenv Γ')
  | _ => True
  end.

Definition INV (s : list (typvar * typ)) (Γ : aworklist) : Prop :=
  nb_sigma s /\ full_arel s Γ /\ full_envok s Γ /\ tshape Γ /\
  d_wl_del_red (eraseσ s Γ).

Definition SOUND (Γ : aworklist) : Prop :=
  twf Γ -> head_ok Γ -> exists s, INV s Γ.

Lemma INV_nb : forall s Γ, INV s Γ -> nb_sigma s.
Proof. intros s Γ [H _]. exact H. Qed.
Lemma INV_arel : forall s Γ, INV s Γ -> full_arel s Γ.
Proof. intros s Γ [_ [H _]]. exact H. Qed.
Lemma INV_env : forall s Γ, INV s Γ -> full_envok s Γ.
Proof. intros s Γ [_ [_ [H _]]]. exact H. Qed.
Lemma INV_tshape : forall s Γ, INV s Γ -> tshape Γ.
Proof. intros s Γ [_ [_ [_ [H _]]]]. exact H. Qed.
Lemma INV_red : forall s Γ, INV s Γ -> d_wl_del_red (eraseσ s Γ).
Proof. intros s Γ [_ [_ [_ [_ H]]]]. exact H. Qed.

Lemma d_wl_del_red_var_head : forall Ω x db,
  d_wl_del_red (dworklist_cons_var Ω x db) -> d_wl_del_red Ω.
Proof.
  intros Ω x db H. inversion H; subst; auto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_in_dom : forall (A : Type) (x : atom) (a : A) (E : list (atom*A)),
  binds x a E -> x `in` dom E.
Proof.
  intros A x a E. induction E as [|[y b] E IH]; intros H.
  - contradiction.
  - apply binds_cons_1 in H as [[e1 e2]|H]; subst.
    + apply AtomSetImpl.add_1; reflexivity.
    + apply AtomSetImpl.add_2. apply IH; auto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_strip : forall (Y X : atom) (b a : dbind) (Ψ : denv),
  Y <> X -> binds Y a (X ~ b ++ Ψ) -> binds Y a Ψ.
Proof.
  intros. apply binds_cons_1 in H0 as [[e1 e2]|H0]; auto.
  exfalso; apply H; auto.
Qed.

Lemma Arel_strip : forall s Σ X b,
  X `notin` dom Σ ->
  (forall Y, binds Y (abind_etvar_empty) Σ ->
      X `notin` ftvar_in_typ (tsubst_typ s (typ_var_f Y))) ->
  Arel s (X ~ b ++ Σ) (aenv_to_denv s (X ~ b ++ Σ)) ->
  Arel s Σ (aenv_to_denv s Σ).
Proof.
  intros s Σ X b Hdom Hfresh H.
  destruct b.
  - (* tvar *) simpl in *.
    destruct H as [Hnb [Ht [Hs [He [Hin [Hft [Hfs Hv]]]]]]].
    unfold Arel. repeat split.
    + exact Hnb.
    + intros Y Hb.
      assert (Hb' : binds Y (dbind_tvar_empty) (X ~ dbind_tvar_empty ++ aenv_to_denv s Σ)).
      { apply Ht. apply binds_cons_3; auto. }
      eapply binds_cons_strip with (X := X); [intro e; subst; apply Hdom; apply binds_in_dom with (a := abind_tvar_empty); auto | exact Hb'].
    + intros Y Hb.
      assert (Hb' : binds Y (dbind_stvar_empty) (X ~ dbind_tvar_empty ++ aenv_to_denv s Σ)).
      { apply Hs. apply binds_cons_3; auto. }
      eapply binds_cons_strip with (X := X); [intro e; subst; apply Hdom; apply binds_in_dom with (a := abind_stvar_empty); auto | exact Hb'].
    + intros Y Hb.
      apply d_mono_typ_remove_tvar with (X := X).
      * apply Hfresh; auto.
      * apply He. apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + intros Y Hb. apply Hin. apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + intros Y Hb.
      assert (Hb' : binds Y (abind_tvar_empty) (X ~ abind_tvar_empty ++ Σ)) by (apply binds_cons_3; auto).
      apply Hft in Hb'. unfold fresh_sigma in *. intro Hin2. apply Hb'. simpl; auto.
    + intros Y Hb.
      assert (Hb' : binds Y (abind_stvar_empty) (X ~ abind_tvar_empty ++ Σ)) by (apply binds_cons_3; auto).
      apply Hfs in Hb'. unfold fresh_sigma in *. intro Hin2. apply Hb'. simpl; auto.
    + intros x A Hb.
      assert (Hb' : binds x (dbind_typ (tsubst_typ s A)) (X ~ dbind_tvar_empty ++ aenv_to_denv s Σ)).
      { apply Hv. apply binds_cons_3; auto. }
      eapply binds_cons_strip with (X := X); [intro e; subst; apply Hdom; apply binds_in_dom with (a := abind_var_typ A); auto | exact Hb'].
  - (* stvar *) simpl in *.
    destruct H as [Hnb [Ht [Hs [He [Hin [Hft [Hfs Hv]]]]]]].
    unfold Arel. repeat split.
    + exact Hnb.
    + intros Y Hb.
      assert (Hb' : binds Y (dbind_tvar_empty) (X ~ dbind_stvar_empty ++ aenv_to_denv s Σ)).
      { apply Ht. apply binds_cons_3; auto. }
      eapply binds_cons_strip with (X := X); [intro e; subst; apply Hdom; apply binds_in_dom with (a := abind_tvar_empty); auto | exact Hb'].
    + intros Y Hb.
      assert (Hb' : binds Y (dbind_stvar_empty) (X ~ dbind_stvar_empty ++ aenv_to_denv s Σ)).
      { apply Hs. apply binds_cons_3; auto. }
      eapply binds_cons_strip with (X := X); [intro e; subst; apply Hdom; apply binds_in_dom with (a := abind_stvar_empty); auto | exact Hb'].
    + intros Y Hb.
      apply d_mono_typ_remove_stvar with (X := X).
      apply He. apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + intros Y Hb. apply Hin. apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + intros Y Hb.
      assert (Hb' : binds Y (abind_tvar_empty) (X ~ abind_stvar_empty ++ Σ)) by (apply binds_cons_3; auto).
      apply Hft in Hb'. unfold fresh_sigma in *. intro Hin2. apply Hb'. simpl; auto.
    + intros Y Hb.
      assert (Hb' : binds Y (abind_stvar_empty) (X ~ abind_stvar_empty ++ Σ)) by (apply binds_cons_3; auto).
      apply Hfs in Hb'. unfold fresh_sigma in *. intro Hin2. apply Hb'. simpl; auto.
    + intros x A Hb.
      assert (Hb' : binds x (dbind_typ (tsubst_typ s A)) (X ~ dbind_stvar_empty ++ aenv_to_denv s Σ)).
      { apply Hv. apply binds_cons_3; auto. }
      eapply binds_cons_strip with (X := X); [intro e; subst; apply Hdom; apply binds_in_dom with (a := abind_var_typ A); auto | exact Hb'].
  - (* etvar *) simpl in *.
    destruct H as [Hnb [Ht [Hs [He [Hin [Hft [Hfs Hv]]]]]]].
    unfold Arel. repeat split.
    + exact Hnb.
    + intros Y Hb. apply Ht. apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + intros Y Hb. apply Hs. apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + intros Y Hb. apply He. apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + intros Y Hb. apply Hin. apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + intros Y Hb. apply Hft. apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + intros Y Hb. apply Hfs. apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + intros x A0 Hb. apply Hv. apply binds_cons_3; auto.
  - (* var_typ *) simpl in *.
    destruct H as [Hnb [Ht [Hs [He [Hin [Hft [Hfs Hv]]]]]]].
    unfold Arel. repeat split.
    + exact Hnb.
    + intros Y Hb.
      assert (Hb' : binds Y (dbind_tvar_empty) (X ~ dbind_typ (tsubst_typ s A) ++ aenv_to_denv s Σ)).
      { apply Ht. apply binds_cons_3; auto. }
      eapply binds_cons_strip with (X := X); [intro e; subst; apply Hdom; apply binds_in_dom with (a := abind_tvar_empty); auto | exact Hb'].
    + intros Y Hb.
      assert (Hb' : binds Y (dbind_stvar_empty) (X ~ dbind_typ (tsubst_typ s A) ++ aenv_to_denv s Σ)).
      { apply Hs. apply binds_cons_3; auto. }
      eapply binds_cons_strip with (X := X); [intro e; subst; apply Hdom; apply binds_in_dom with (a := abind_stvar_empty); auto | exact Hb'].
    + intros Y Hb.
      apply (d_mono_typ_remove_typ X (tsubst_typ s A) (aenv_to_denv s Σ)).
      apply He. apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + intros Y Hb. apply Hin. apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + intros Y Hb.
      assert (Hb' : binds Y (abind_tvar_empty) (X ~ abind_var_typ A ++ Σ)) by (apply binds_cons_3; auto).

      assert (Hb' : binds Y (abind_stvar_empty) (X ~ abind_var_typ A ++ Σ)) by (apply binds_cons_3; auto).

      eapply binds_cons_strip with (X := X); [intro e; subst; apply Hdom; apply binds_in_dom with (a := abind_var_typ A0); auto | exact Hb'].
