Lemma tw_exp_trans_aux : forall n e,
  size_exp e <= n -> forall Σ, tw_exp Σ e ->
  forall s Ψ, Arel s Σ Ψ -> dwf_exp Ψ (tsubst_exp s e).
Proof.
  induction n as [| n IH]; intros e Hn Σ Htw s Ψ HA.
  - destruct e; simpl in Hn; exfalso; lia.
  - destruct e as [| nb | x | e0 | e1 e2 | e' | e0 A | e0 A]; simpl in Hn.
    + rewrite tsubst_exp_unit. constructor.
    + rewrite tsubst_exp_varb. constructor.
    + rewrite tsubst_exp_varf. constructor.
    + rewrite tsubst_exp_abs. simpl. apply (IH e0 ltac:(simpl; lia) Σ Htw s Ψ HA).
    + rewrite tsubst_exp_app. destruct Htw as [H1 H2]. constructor.
      * apply (IH e1 ltac:(simpl; lia) Σ H1 s Ψ HA).
      * apply (IH e2 ltac:(simpl; lia) Σ H2 s Ψ HA).
    + (* tabs *) rewrite tsubst_exp_tabs.
      destruct e' as [| nb0 | x0 | e0 | e1 e2 | e0 | e0 A0 | e0 A0]; simpl in *.
      * destruct Htw.
      * destruct Htw.
      * destruct Htw.
      * destruct Htw.
      * destruct Htw.
      * destruct Htw.
      * destruct Htw.
      * (* anno *) rewrite tsubst_exp_anno. simpl.
        destruct Htw as [H1 H2]. constructor.
        -- rewrite <- tsubst_all. apply a_wf_typ_trans with (s := s) (Σ := Σ) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
        -- apply (IH e0 ltac:(simpl; lia) Σ H2 s Ψ HA).
    + (* tapp *) rewrite tsubst_exp_tapp. destruct Htw as [H1 H2]. constructor.
      * apply (IH e0 ltac:(simpl; lia) Σ H1 s Ψ HA).
      * apply a_wf_typ_trans with (s := s) (Σ := Σ) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + (* anno *) rewrite tsubst_exp_anno. destruct Htw as [H1 H2]. constructor.
      * apply (IH e0 ltac:(simpl; lia) Σ H1 s Ψ HA).
      * apply a_wf_typ_trans with (s := s) (Σ := Σ) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
Qed.

Lemma tw_exp_trans : forall Σ e,
  tw_exp Σ e -> forall s Ψ, Arel s Σ Ψ -> dwf_exp Ψ (tsubst_exp s e).
Proof.
  intros Σ e Htw s Ψ HA. eapply tw_exp_trans_aux with (n := size_exp e); eauto.
Qed.



Lemma tw_conts_contd_trans_mut : forall Σ,
  (forall cs, tw_conts Σ cs -> forall s Ψ, Arel s Σ Ψ -> dwf_conts Ψ (tsubst_conts s cs)) /\
  (forall cd, tw_contd Σ cd -> forall s Ψ, Arel s Σ Ψ -> dwf_contd Ψ (tsubst_contd s cd)).
Proof.
  intros Σ.
  assert (H : (forall cd, tw_contd Σ cd ->
                 forall s Ψ, Arel s Σ Ψ -> dwf_contd Ψ (tsubst_contd s cd)) /\
              (forall cs, tw_conts Σ cs ->
                 forall s Ψ, Arel s Σ Ψ -> dwf_conts Ψ (tsubst_conts s cs))).
  { apply contd_conts_mutind.
    - (* infabsunion *) intros A cd IH Htw s Ψ HA. simpl in Htw. destruct Htw as [H1 H2].
      rewrite tsubst_contd_infabsunion. simpl. constructor.
      + apply a_wf_typ_trans with (s := s) (Σ := Σ) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
      + apply IH; auto.
    - (* infapp *) intros e cs IH Htw s Ψ HA. simpl in Htw. destruct Htw as [H1 H2].
      rewrite tsubst_contd_infapp. simpl. constructor.
      + apply tw_exp_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
      + apply IH; auto.
    - (* unioninfabs *) intros A B cd IH Htw s Ψ HA. simpl in Htw. destruct Htw as [H1 H2].
      rewrite tsubst_contd_unioninfabs. simpl. constructor.
      + rewrite <- tsubst_arrow. apply a_wf_typ_trans with (s := s) (Σ := Σ) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
      + apply IH; auto.
    - (* infabs *) intros cd IH Htw s Ψ HA. simpl in Htw.
      rewrite tsubst_conts_infabs. simpl. apply (IH Htw s Ψ HA).
    - (* inftapp *) intros A cs IH Htw s Ψ HA. simpl in Htw. destruct Htw as [H1 H2].
      rewrite tsubst_conts_inftapp. simpl. constructor.
      + apply a_wf_typ_trans with (s := s) (Σ := Σ) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
      + apply IH; auto.
    - (* inftappunion *) intros A1 A2 cs IH Htw s Ψ HA. simpl in Htw.
      destruct Htw as [H1 [H2 H3]]. rewrite tsubst_conts_inftappunion. simpl. constructor.
      + apply a_wf_typ_trans with (s := s) (Σ := Σ) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
      + constructor.
        * apply a_wf_typ_trans with (s := s) (Σ := Σ) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
        * apply IH; auto.
    - (* unioninftapp *) intros A cs IH Htw s Ψ HA. simpl in Htw. destruct Htw as [H1 H2].
      rewrite tsubst_conts_unioninftapp. simpl. constructor.
      + apply a_wf_typ_trans with (s := s) (Σ := Σ) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
      + apply IH; auto.
    - (* sub *) intros A Htw s Ψ HA. simpl in Htw. rewrite tsubst_conts_sub. simpl.
      apply a_wf_typ_trans with (s := s) (Σ := Σ) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
  }
  destruct H as [Hcd Hcs]. split.
  - apply Hcs.
  - apply Hcd.
Qed.

Lemma tw_conts_trans : forall Σ cs, tw_conts Σ cs ->
  forall s Ψ, Arel s Σ Ψ -> dwf_conts Ψ (tsubst_conts s cs).
Proof. intros Σ cs H. apply (proj1 (tw_conts_contd_trans_mut Σ)); auto. Qed.

Lemma tw_contd_trans : forall Σ cd, tw_contd Σ cd ->
  forall s Ψ, Arel s Σ Ψ -> dwf_contd Ψ (tsubst_contd s cd).
Proof. intros Σ cd H. apply (proj2 (tw_conts_contd_trans_mut Σ)); auto. Qed.

Lemma tw_work_trans : forall Σ w,
  tw_work Σ w -> forall s Ψ, Arel s Σ Ψ -> dwf_work Ψ (tsubst_work s w).
Proof.
  intros Σ w. induction w as [e cs | e A | A cd | A1 B1 A2 cd | A B e cs | A1 A2 cs | A1 A2 | A1 A2 B cs | A1 A2 cs | A1 B1 A2 B2 cd | cs A | cd A B];
    intros Htw s Ψ HA; simpl in Htw.
  - rewrite tsubst_work_infer. simpl. destruct Htw as [H1 H2]. repeat split.
    + apply tw_exp_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + apply tw_conts_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
  - rewrite tsubst_work_check. simpl. destruct Htw as [H1 H2]. repeat split.
    + apply tw_exp_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + apply a_wf_typ_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
  - rewrite tsubst_work_infabs. simpl. destruct Htw as [H1 H2]. repeat split.
    + apply a_wf_typ_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + apply tw_contd_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
  - rewrite tsubst_work_infabsunion. simpl. destruct Htw as [H1 [H2 H3]]. repeat split.
    + rewrite <- tsubst_arrow. apply a_wf_typ_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + apply a_wf_typ_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + apply tw_contd_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
  - rewrite tsubst_work_infapp. simpl. destruct Htw as [H1 [H2 H3]]. repeat split.
    + rewrite <- tsubst_arrow. apply a_wf_typ_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + apply tw_exp_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + apply tw_conts_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
  - rewrite tsubst_work_inftapp. simpl. destruct Htw as [H1 [H2 H3]]. repeat split.
    + apply a_wf_typ_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + apply a_wf_typ_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + apply tw_conts_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
  - rewrite tsubst_work_sub. simpl. destruct Htw as [H1 H2]. repeat split.
    + apply a_wf_typ_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + apply a_wf_typ_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
  - rewrite tsubst_work_inftappunion. simpl. destruct Htw as [H1 [H2 [H3 H4]]]. repeat split.
    + apply a_wf_typ_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + apply a_wf_typ_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + apply a_wf_typ_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + apply tw_conts_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
  - rewrite tsubst_work_unioninftapp. simpl. destruct Htw as [H1 [H2 H3]]. repeat split.
    + apply a_wf_typ_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + apply a_wf_typ_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + apply tw_conts_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
  - rewrite tsubst_work_unioninfabs. simpl. destruct Htw as [H1 [H2 H3]]. repeat split.
    + rewrite <- tsubst_arrow. apply a_wf_typ_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + rewrite <- tsubst_arrow. apply a_wf_typ_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + apply tw_contd_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
  - rewrite tsubst_work_applys. simpl. destruct Htw as [H1 H2]. repeat split.
    + apply a_wf_typ_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + apply tw_conts_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
  - rewrite tsubst_work_applyd. simpl. destruct Htw as [H1 [H2 H3]]. repeat split.
    + apply a_wf_typ_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + apply a_wf_typ_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + apply tw_contd_trans with (Σ := Σ) (s := s) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
Qed.


(* ---------- erasure commutes with substituting an etvar away ---------- *)
Lemma eraseσ_subst : forall A X s Γ,
  eraseσ s (subst_typ_in_aworklist A X Γ) = eraseσ ((X,A) :: s) Γ.
Proof.
  intros A X s Γ. induction Γ as [| Γ' IH Y b | Γ' IH w]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct b; simpl.
    + rewrite IH. reflexivity.
    + rewrite IH. reflexivity.
    + rewrite IH. reflexivity.
    + rewrite IH. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ---------- stvar-free environments ---------- *)
Definition stvar_free (Ψ : denv) : Prop :=
  forall X, binds X (dbind_stvar_empty) Ψ -> False.

Lemma d_wf_env_tenv : forall Ψ, d_wf_env Ψ -> stvar_free Ψ -> d_wf_tenv Ψ.
Proof.
  intros Ψ H. induction H as [Ψ Htenv | Ψ X Hwf Hfresh IH].
  - intros _. exact Htenv.
  - intros Hfree. exfalso. apply (Hfree X). constructor. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ---------- syntactic "needs a term environment" predicate ---------- *)
Fixpoint tenv_needed_conts (cs : conts) : Prop :=
  match cs with
  | conts_sub _ => False
  | _ => True
  end
with tenv_needed_contd (cd : contd) : Prop := True.

Definition tenv_needed_work (w : work) : Prop :=
  match w with
  | work_sub _ _ => False
  | work_applys cs _ => tenv_needed_conts cs
  | _ => True
  end.

(* ---------- the soundness invariant ---------- *)
Lemma binds_aenv_to_denv_tvar : forall s Σ X,
  binds X (abind_tvar_empty) Σ -> binds X (dbind_tvar_empty) (aenv_to_denv s Σ).
Proof.
  intros s Σ. induction Σ as [|[Y b] Σ IH]; intros X Hb; simpl in *.
  - contradiction.
  - destruct b; simpl.
    + apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
      * subst. apply binds_cons_2; auto.
      * apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
      * subst. discriminate e2.
      * apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
      * subst. discriminate e2.
      * auto.
    + apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
      * subst. discriminate e2.
      * apply binds_cons_3; auto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_aenv_to_denv_stvar : forall s Σ X,
  binds X (abind_stvar_empty) Σ -> binds X (dbind_stvar_empty) (aenv_to_denv s Σ).
Proof.
  intros s Σ. induction Σ as [|[Y b] Σ IH]; intros X Hb; simpl in *.
  - contradiction.
  - destruct b; simpl.
    + apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
      * subst. discriminate e2.
      * apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
      * subst. apply binds_cons_2; auto.
      * apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
      * subst. discriminate e2.
      * auto.
    + apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
      * subst. discriminate e2.
      * apply binds_cons_3; auto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_aenv_to_denv_var : forall s Σ x A,
  binds x (abind_var_typ A) Σ ->
  binds x (dbind_typ (tsubst_typ s A)) (aenv_to_denv s Σ).
Proof.
  intros s Σ. induction Σ as [|[Y b] Σ IH]; intros x A Hb; simpl in *.
  - contradiction.
  - destruct b; simpl.
    + apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
      * subst. discriminate e2.
      * apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
      * subst. discriminate e2.
      * apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
      * subst. discriminate e2.
      * auto.
    + apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
      * inversion e2; subst. apply binds_cons_2; auto.
      * apply binds_cons_3; auto.
Qed.

Lemma Arel_of_inv : forall s Σ Ψ,
  Ψ = aenv_to_denv s Σ -> nb_sigma s ->
  (forall X, binds X (abind_tvar_empty) Σ -> fresh_sigma X s) ->
  (forall X, binds X (abind_stvar_empty) Σ -> fresh_sigma X s) ->
  (forall X, binds X (abind_etvar_empty) Σ -> In X (names s)) ->
  (forall X, binds X (abind_etvar_empty) Σ ->
     d_mono_typ Ψ (tsubst_typ s (typ_var_f X))) ->
  Arel s Σ Ψ.
Proof.
  intros s Σ Ψ Heq Hnb Hft Hfs Hin He.
  subst Ψ. unfold Arel. repeat split.
  - exact Hnb.
  - intros X Hb. apply binds_aenv_to_denv_tvar; auto.
  - intros X Hb. apply binds_aenv_to_denv_stvar; auto.
  - intros X Hb. apply He; auto.
  - intros X Hb. apply Hin; auto.
  - intros X Hb. apply Hft; auto.
  - intros X Hb. apply Hfs; auto.
  - intros x A Hb. apply binds_aenv_to_denv_var; auto.
Qed.

Lemma d_wf_tenv_cons_tail : forall x b Ψ,
  d_wf_tenv (x ~ b ++ Ψ) -> d_wf_tenv Ψ.
Proof.
  intros x b Ψ H. destruct b.
  - inversion H; assumption.
  - inversion H.
  - inversion H; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma d_wf_env_cons_tail : forall x b Ψ,
  d_wf_env (x ~ b ++ Ψ) -> d_wf_env Ψ.
Proof.
  intros x b Ψ H. remember (x ~ b ++ Ψ) as E eqn:EE.
  induction H; subst; simpl in *.
  - apply d_wf_env__empty.
    match goal with Ht : d_wf_tenv _ |- _ => apply d_wf_tenv_cons_tail in Ht; exact Ht end.
  - inversion EE; subst. match goal with Hw : d_wf_env _ |- _ => exact Hw end.
Qed.

Lemma stvar_free_cons_tail : forall x b Ψ,
  stvar_free (x ~ b ++ Ψ) -> stvar_free Ψ.
Proof.
  intros x b Ψ H X HX. unfold stvar_free in H. apply (H X). apply binds_cons_3; auto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_dbind_typ_tvar : forall Y x A Ψ,
  binds Y (dbind_tvar_empty) (x ~ dbind_typ A ++ Ψ) -> binds Y (dbind_tvar_empty) Ψ.
Proof. intros. apply binds_cons_1 in H as [[e1 e2]|H]; [discriminate e2|exact H]. Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_stvar_tvar : forall Y X Ψ,
  binds Y (dbind_tvar_empty) (X ~ dbind_stvar_empty ++ Ψ) -> binds Y (dbind_tvar_empty) Ψ.
Proof. intros. apply binds_cons_1 in H as [[e1 e2]|H]; [discriminate e2|exact H]. Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_tvar_tvar : forall Y X Ψ,
  binds Y (dbind_tvar_empty) (X ~ dbind_tvar_empty ++ Ψ) ->
  Y = X \/ binds Y (dbind_tvar_empty) Ψ.
Proof. intros. apply binds_cons_1 in H as [[e1 e2]|H]; [left; auto|right; exact H]. Qed.

Lemma d_mono_typ_remove_typ : forall x A Ψ T,
  d_mono_typ (x ~ dbind_typ A ++ Ψ) T -> d_mono_typ Ψ T.
Proof.
  intros x A Ψ T H. dependent induction H.
  - constructor.
  - constructor. apply binds_cons_dbind_typ_tvar in H. exact H.
  - constructor.
    + apply (IHd_mono_typ1 x A Ψ); reflexivity.
    + apply (IHd_mono_typ2 x A Ψ); reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma d_mono_typ_remove_stvar : forall X Ψ T,
  d_mono_typ (X ~ dbind_stvar_empty ++ Ψ) T -> d_mono_typ Ψ T.
Proof.
  intros X Ψ T H. dependent induction H.
  - constructor.
  - constructor. match goal with Hb : binds _ (dbind_tvar_empty) (X ~ dbind_stvar_empty ++ Ψ) |- _ =>
      apply binds_cons_stvar_tvar in Hb; exact Hb end.
  - constructor.
    + apply (IHd_mono_typ1 X Ψ); reflexivity.
    + apply (IHd_mono_typ2 X Ψ); reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma d_mono_typ_remove_tvar : forall X Ψ T,
  X `notin` ftvar_in_typ T ->
  d_mono_typ (X ~ dbind_tvar_empty ++ Ψ) T -> d_mono_typ Ψ T.
Proof.
  intros X Ψ T Hfresh H. dependent induction H.
  - constructor.
  - constructor. apply binds_cons_tvar_tvar in H. destruct H as [e|H].
    + subst. exfalso. apply Hfresh. simpl. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2; reflexivity.
    + exact H.
  - constructor.
    + assert (Hf1 : X `notin` ftvar_in_typ A1)
        by (intro Hi; apply Hfresh; simpl; apply AtomSetImpl.union_2; exact Hi).
      apply (IHd_mono_typ1 X Ψ Hf1); reflexivity.
    + assert (Hf2 : X `notin` ftvar_in_typ A2)
        by (intro Hi; apply Hfresh; simpl; apply AtomSetImpl.union_3; exact Hi).
      apply (IHd_mono_typ2 X Ψ Hf2); reflexivity.
  Qed.

(* A d-monotype can only mention type variables bound as tvars. *)
Lemma d_mono_typ_ftvar : forall Ψ T,
  d_mono_typ Ψ T ->
  forall X, X `in` ftvar_in_typ T -> binds X (dbind_tvar_empty) Ψ.
Proof.
  intros Ψ T HH. rename HH into H0.
  induction H0.
  - intros Z HX. simpl in HX. exfalso. exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 (a:=Z) HX).
  - intros Z HX. simpl in HX. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_1 in HX. subst Z. assumption.
  - intros Z HX. simpl in HX. apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in HX as [HX|HX].
    + apply IHd_mono_typ1; auto.
    + apply IHd_mono_typ2; auto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_tvar_aenv_to_denv_inv : forall s Σ X,
  binds X (dbind_tvar_empty) (aenv_to_denv s Σ) ->
  binds X (abind_tvar_empty) Σ.
Proof.
  intros s Σ. induction Σ as [|[Y b] Σ IH]; intros X HX; simpl in *.
  - contradiction.
  - destruct b; simpl in *.
    + apply binds_cons_1 in HX as [[e1 e2]|HX].
      * subst. apply binds_cons_2; auto.
      * apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + apply binds_cons_1 in HX as [[e1 e2]|HX]; [|apply binds_cons_3; auto].
      subst. discriminate e2.
    + apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + apply binds_cons_1 in HX as [[e1 e2]|HX]; [|apply binds_cons_3; auto].
      subst. discriminate e2.
Qed.

(* Substituting a different atom Y for X does not introduce X. *)
Lemma subst_typ_in_typ_notin : forall A X Y T,
  X <> Y ->
  X `notin` ftvar_in_typ A ->
  X `notin` ftvar_in_typ T ->
  X `notin` ftvar_in_typ (subst_typ_in_typ T Y A).
Proof.
  intros A.
  induction A as [| | | n | X0 | A1 IH1 A2 IH2 | A0 IH0 | A1 IH1 A2 IH2 | A1 IH1 A2 IH2];
    intros X Y T Hne HA HT; simpl in *.
  - intro Hc; exfalso; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 (a:=X) Hc).
  - intro Hc; exfalso; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 (a:=X) Hc).
  - intro Hc; exfalso; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 (a:=X) Hc).
  - intro Hc; exfalso; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 (a:=X) Hc).
  - destruct (eq_var X0 Y) as [e|e]; simpl.
    + exact HT.
    + exact HA.
  - intro Hc. apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in Hc as [Hc|Hc].
    + assert (HA1 : X `notin` ftvar_in_typ A1)
        by (intro Hi; apply HA; apply AtomSetImpl.union_2; exact Hi).
      exact (IH1 X Y T Hne HA1 HT Hc).
    + assert (HA2 : X `notin` ftvar_in_typ A2)
        by (intro Hi; apply HA; apply AtomSetImpl.union_3; exact Hi).
      exact (IH2 X Y T Hne HA2 HT Hc).
  - exact (IH0 X Y T Hne HA HT).
  - intro Hc. apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in Hc as [Hc|Hc].
    + assert (HA1 : X `notin` ftvar_in_typ A1)
        by (intro Hi; apply HA; apply AtomSetImpl.union_2; exact Hi).
      exact (IH1 X Y T Hne HA1 HT Hc).
    + assert (HA2 : X `notin` ftvar_in_typ A2)
        by (intro Hi; apply HA; apply AtomSetImpl.union_3; exact Hi).
      exact (IH2 X Y T Hne HA2 HT Hc).
  - intro Hc. apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in Hc as [Hc|Hc].
    + assert (HA1 : X `notin` ftvar_in_typ A1)
        by (intro Hi; apply HA; apply AtomSetImpl.union_2; exact Hi).
      exact (IH1 X Y T Hne HA1 HT Hc).
    + assert (HA2 : X `notin` ftvar_in_typ A2)
        by (intro Hi; apply HA; apply AtomSetImpl.union_3; exact Hi).
      exact (IH2 X Y T Hne HA2 HT Hc).
Qed.

(* A typed substitution neither introduces an atom that is neither a key
   nor mentioned by any of the substituted types nor by the argument. *)
Lemma tsubst_typ_notin : forall s A X,
  fresh_sigma X s ->
  (forall Y T, In (Y,T) s -> X `notin` ftvar_in_typ T) ->
  X `notin` ftvar_in_typ A ->
  X `notin` ftvar_in_typ (tsubst_typ s A).
Proof.
  intros s. induction s as [|[Y T] s IH]; intros A X Hf Hval HA; simpl.
  - exact HA.
  - assert (Hneq : X <> Y).
    { intro e. apply Hf. subst. simpl. auto. }
    assert (Hfs : fresh_sigma X s).
    { intros Hin. apply Hf. simpl. auto. }
    assert (HvalT : X `notin` ftvar_in_typ T).
    { apply (Hval Y T). simpl. auto. }
    assert (Hvals : forall Y0 T0, In (Y0,T0) s -> X `notin` ftvar_in_typ T0).
    { intros Y0 T0 Hin. apply (Hval Y0 T0). apply List.in_cons. exact Hin. }
    apply IH.
    + exact Hfs.
    + exact Hvals.
    + exact (subst_typ_in_typ_notin A X Y T Hneq HA HvalT).
Qed.

Definition stvar_free_aenv (Σ : aenv) : Prop :=
  forall X, binds X (abind_stvar_empty) Σ -> False.

Lemma binds_stvar_aenv_to_denv_inv : forall s Σ X,
  binds X (dbind_stvar_empty) (aenv_to_denv s Σ) ->
  binds X (abind_stvar_empty) Σ.
Proof.
  intros s Σ. induction Σ as [|[Y b] Σ IH]; intros X HX; simpl in *.
  - contradiction.
  - destruct b; simpl in *.
    + apply binds_cons_1 in HX as [[e1 e2]|HX]; [discriminate e2|apply binds_cons_3; auto].
    + apply binds_cons_1 in HX as [[e1 e2]|HX]; [|apply binds_cons_3; auto].
      subst. apply binds_cons_2; auto.
    + apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + apply binds_cons_1 in HX as [[e1 e2]|HX]; [discriminate e2|apply binds_cons_3; auto].
Qed.

Lemma stvar_free_aenv_denv : forall s Σ,
  stvar_free_aenv Σ -> stvar_free (aenv_to_denv s Σ).
Proof.
  intros s Σ H X HX. apply (H X). apply binds_stvar_aenv_to_denv_inv with (s := s); auto.
Qed.

Lemma tenv_needed_work_subst : forall A X w,
  tenv_needed_work (subst_typ_in_work A X w) = tenv_needed_work w.
Proof.
  intros A X w. destruct w; simpl; try reflexivity.
  destruct cs; simpl; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma tenv_needed_work_tsubst : forall s w,
  tenv_needed_work (tsubst_work s w) = tenv_needed_work w.
Proof.
  intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; intros w; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. rewrite tenv_needed_work_subst. reflexivity.
Qed.

Definition full_arel (s : list (typvar * typ)) (Γ : aworklist) : Prop :=
  Arel s (awl_to_aenv Γ) (aenv_to_denv s (awl_to_aenv Γ)).

Definition full_envok (s : list (typvar * typ)) (Γ : aworklist) : Prop :=
  d_wf_env (aenv_to_denv s (awl_to_aenv Γ)).

Fixpoint tshape (Γ : aworklist) : Prop :=
  match Γ with
  | aworklist_empty => True
  | aworklist_cons_var Γ' _ _ => tshape Γ'
  | aworklist_cons_work Γ' w =>
      tshape Γ' /\ (tenv_needed_work w -> stvar_free_aenv (awl_to_aenv Γ'))
  end.

Definition head_ok (Γ : aworklist) : Prop :=
  match Γ with
  | aworklist_cons_work Γ' w =>
      tenv_needed_work w -> stvar_free_aenv (awl_to_aenv Γ')
  | _ => True
  end.

Definition INV (s : list (typvar * typ)) (Γ : aworklist) : Prop :=
  nb_sigma s /\ full_arel s Γ /\ full_envok s Γ /\ tshape Γ /\
  d_wl_del_red (eraseσ s Γ).

Definition SOUND (Γ : aworklist) : Prop :=
  twf Γ -> head_ok Γ -> exists s, INV s Γ.

Lemma INV_nb : forall s Γ, INV s Γ -> nb_sigma s.
Proof. intros s Γ [H _]. exact H. Qed.
Lemma INV_arel : forall s Γ, INV s Γ -> full_arel s Γ.
Proof. intros s Γ [_ [H _]]. exact H. Qed.
Lemma INV_env : forall s Γ, INV s Γ -> full_envok s Γ.
Proof. intros s Γ [_ [_ [H _]]]. exact H. Qed.
Lemma INV_tshape : forall s Γ, INV s Γ -> tshape Γ.
Proof. intros s Γ [_ [_ [_ [H _]]]]. exact H. Qed.
Lemma INV_red : forall s Γ, INV s Γ -> d_wl_del_red (eraseσ s Γ).
Proof. intros s Γ [_ [_ [_ [_ H]]]]. exact H. Qed.

Lemma d_wl_del_red_var_head : forall Ω x db,
  d_wl_del_red (dworklist_cons_var Ω x db) -> d_wl_del_red Ω.
Proof.
  intros Ω x db H. inversion H; subst; auto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_in_dom : forall (A : Type) (x : atom) (a : A) (E : list (atom*A)),
  binds x a E -> x `in` dom E.
Proof.
  intros A x a E. induction E as [|[y b] E IH]; intros H.
  - contradiction.
  - apply binds_cons_1 in H as [[e1 e2]|H]; subst.
    + apply AtomSetImpl.add_1; reflexivity.
    + apply AtomSetImpl.add_2. apply IH; auto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_cons_strip : forall (Y X : atom) (b a : dbind) (Ψ : denv),
  Y <> X -> binds Y a (X ~ b ++ Ψ) -> binds Y a Ψ.
Proof.
  intros. apply binds_cons_1 in H0 as [[e1 e2]|H0]; auto.
  exfalso; apply H; auto.
Qed.

Lemma Arel_strip : forall s Σ X b,
  X `notin` dom Σ ->
  (forall Y, binds Y (abind_etvar_empty) Σ ->
      X `notin` ftvar_in_typ (tsubst_typ s (typ_var_f Y))) ->
  Arel s (X ~ b ++ Σ) (aenv_to_denv s (X ~ b ++ Σ)) ->
  Arel s Σ (aenv_to_denv s Σ).
Proof.
  intros s Σ X b Hdom Hfresh H.
  destruct b.
  - (* tvar *) simpl in *.
    destruct H as [Hnb [Ht [Hs [He [Hin [Hft [Hfs Hv]]]]]]].
    unfold Arel. repeat split.
    + exact Hnb.
    + intros Y Hb.
      assert (Hb' : binds Y (dbind_tvar_empty) (X ~ dbind_tvar_empty ++ aenv_to_denv s Σ)).
      { apply Ht. apply binds_cons_3; auto. }
      eapply binds_cons_strip with (X := X); [intro e; subst; apply Hdom; apply binds_in_dom with (a := abind_tvar_empty); auto | exact Hb'].
    + intros Y Hb.
      assert (Hb' : binds Y (dbind_stvar_empty) (X ~ dbind_tvar_empty ++ aenv_to_denv s Σ)).
      { apply Hs. apply binds_cons_3; auto. }
      eapply binds_cons_strip with (X := X); [intro e; subst; apply Hdom; apply binds_in_dom with (a := abind_stvar_empty); auto | exact Hb'].
    + intros Y Hb.
      apply d_mono_typ_remove_tvar with (X := X).
      * apply Hfresh; auto.
      * apply He. apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + intros Y Hb. apply Hin. apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + intros Y Hb.
      assert (Hb' : binds Y (abind_tvar_empty) (X ~ abind_tvar_empty ++ Σ)) by (apply binds_cons_3; auto).
      apply Hft in Hb'. unfold fresh_sigma in *. intro Hin2. apply Hb'. simpl; auto.
    + intros Y Hb.
      assert (Hb' : binds Y (abind_stvar_empty) (X ~ abind_tvar_empty ++ Σ)) by (apply binds_cons_3; auto).
      apply Hfs in Hb'. unfold fresh_sigma in *. intro Hin2. apply Hb'. simpl; auto.
    + intros x A Hb.
      assert (Hb' : binds x (dbind_typ (tsubst_typ s A)) (X ~ dbind_tvar_empty ++ aenv_to_denv s Σ)).
      { apply Hv. apply binds_cons_3; auto. }
      eapply binds_cons_strip with (X := X); [intro e; subst; apply Hdom; apply binds_in_dom with (a := abind_var_typ A); auto | exact Hb'].
  - (* stvar *) simpl in *.
    destruct H as [Hnb [Ht [Hs [He [Hin [Hft [Hfs Hv]]]]]]].
    unfold Arel. repeat split.
    + exact Hnb.
    + intros Y Hb.
      assert (Hb' : binds Y (dbind_tvar_empty) (X ~ dbind_stvar_empty ++ aenv_to_denv s Σ)).
      { apply Ht. apply binds_cons_3; auto. }
      eapply binds_cons_strip with (X := X); [intro e; subst; apply Hdom; apply binds_in_dom with (a := abind_tvar_empty); auto | exact Hb'].
    + intros Y Hb.
      assert (Hb' : binds Y (dbind_stvar_empty) (X ~ dbind_stvar_empty ++ aenv_to_denv s Σ)).
      { apply Hs. apply binds_cons_3; auto. }
      eapply binds_cons_strip with (X := X); [intro e; subst; apply Hdom; apply binds_in_dom with (a := abind_stvar_empty); auto | exact Hb'].
    + intros Y Hb.
      apply d_mono_typ_remove_stvar with (X := X).
      apply He. apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + intros Y Hb. apply Hin. apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + intros Y Hb.
      assert (Hb' : binds Y (abind_tvar_empty) (X ~ abind_stvar_empty ++ Σ)) by (apply binds_cons_3; auto).
      apply Hft in Hb'. unfold fresh_sigma in *. intro Hin2. apply Hb'. simpl; auto.
    + intros Y Hb.
      assert (Hb' : binds Y (abind_stvar_empty) (X ~ abind_stvar_empty ++ Σ)) by (apply binds_cons_3; auto).
      apply Hfs in Hb'. unfold fresh_sigma in *. intro Hin2. apply Hb'. simpl; auto.
    + intros x A Hb.
      assert (Hb' : binds x (dbind_typ (tsubst_typ s A)) (X ~ dbind_stvar_empty ++ aenv_to_denv s Σ)).
      { apply Hv. apply binds_cons_3; auto. }
      eapply binds_cons_strip with (X := X); [intro e; subst; apply Hdom; apply binds_in_dom with (a := abind_var_typ A); auto | exact Hb'].
  - (* etvar *) simpl in *.
    destruct H as [Hnb [Ht [Hs [He [Hin [Hft [Hfs Hv]]]]]]].
    unfold Arel. repeat split.
    + exact Hnb.
    + intros Y Hb. apply Ht. apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + intros Y Hb. apply Hs. apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + intros Y Hb. apply He. apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + intros Y Hb. apply Hin. apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + intros Y Hb. apply Hft. apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + intros Y Hb. apply Hfs. apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + intros x A0 Hb. apply Hv. apply binds_cons_3; auto.
  - (* var_typ *) simpl in *.
    destruct H as [Hnb [Ht [Hs [He [Hin [Hft [Hfs Hv]]]]]]].
    unfold Arel. repeat split.
    + exact Hnb.
    + intros Y Hb.
      assert (Hb' : binds Y (dbind_tvar_empty) (X ~ dbind_typ (tsubst_typ s A) ++ aenv_to_denv s Σ)).
      { apply Ht. apply binds_cons_3; auto. }
      eapply binds_cons_strip with (X := X); [intro e; subst; apply Hdom; apply binds_in_dom with (a := abind_tvar_empty); auto | exact Hb'].
    + intros Y Hb.
      assert (Hb' : binds Y (dbind_stvar_empty) (X ~ dbind_typ (tsubst_typ s A) ++ aenv_to_denv s Σ)).
      { apply Hs. apply binds_cons_3; auto. }
      eapply binds_cons_strip with (X := X); [intro e; subst; apply Hdom; apply binds_in_dom with (a := abind_stvar_empty); auto | exact Hb'].
    + intros Y Hb.
      apply (d_mono_typ_remove_typ X (tsubst_typ s A) (aenv_to_denv s Σ)).
      apply He. apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + intros Y Hb. apply Hin. apply binds_cons_3; auto.
    + intros Y Hb.
      assert (Hb' : binds Y (abind_tvar_empty) (X ~ abind_var_typ A ++ Σ)) by (apply binds_cons_3; auto).
      apply Hft in Hb'. unfold fresh_sigma in *. intro Hin2. apply Hb'. simpl; auto.
    + intros Y Hb.
      assert (Hb' : binds Y (abind_stvar_empty) (X ~ abind_var_typ A ++ Σ)) by (apply binds_cons_3; auto).
      apply Hfs in Hb'. unfold fresh_sigma in *. intro Hin2. apply Hb'. simpl; auto.
    + intros x A0 Hb.
      assert (Hb' : binds x (dbind_typ (tsubst_typ s A0)) (X ~ dbind_typ (tsubst_typ s A) ++ aenv_to_denv s Σ)).
      { apply Hv. apply binds_cons_3; auto. }
      eapply binds_cons_strip with (X := X); [intro e; subst; apply Hdom; apply binds_in_dom with (a := abind_var_typ A0); auto | exact Hb'].
Qed.

(* ---------- scoping of a substitution with respect to a context ---------- *)
Definition sigma_keys_in_env (s : list (typvar * typ)) (Σ : aenv) : Prop :=
  forall Y T, In (Y,T) s -> binds Y (abind_etvar_empty) Σ.

Definition before_bind (Σ : aenv) (X Y : atom) : Prop :=
  exists Σ1 b Σ2, Σ = Σ1 ++ (Y,b) :: Σ2 /\ In (X, abind_tvar_empty) Σ1.

Definition tvar_scope_ok (s : list (typvar * typ)) (Σ : aenv) : Prop :=
  forall Y T, In (Y,T) s -> binds Y (abind_etvar_empty) Σ ->
  forall X, binds X (abind_tvar_empty) Σ -> before_bind Σ X Y ->
    X `notin` ftvar_in_typ T.

Lemma In_names_exists : forall s Y,
  In Y (names s) -> exists T, In (Y,T) s.
Proof.
  intros s. induction s as [|[Z T] s IH]; intros Y Hin.
  - simpl in Hin. destruct Hin.
  - simpl in Hin. destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
    + subst. exists T. simpl. left. auto.
    + destruct (IH Y Hin) as [T' HT]. exists T'. simpl. right. exact HT.
Qed.

Lemma binds_decomp : forall (A : Type) (E : list (atom * A)) x a,
  binds x a E -> exists E1 b E2, E = E1 ++ (x,b) :: E2 /\ a = b.
Proof.
  intros A E. induction E as [|[y b] E IH]; intros x a Hb.
  - contradiction.
  - apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. exists nil, b, E. simpl. auto.
    + destruct (IH x a Hb) as [E1 [b' [E2 [Heq Ha]]]].
      exists ((y,b)::E1), b', E2. simpl. rewrite Heq. auto.
Qed.

Lemma tsubst_var_notin_of_dmono : forall s Σ X b Y,
  X `notin` dom Σ ->
  b <> abind_tvar_empty ->
  binds Y (abind_etvar_empty) Σ ->
  d_mono_typ (aenv_to_denv s (X ~ b ++ Σ)) (tsubst_typ s (typ_var_f Y)) ->
  X `notin` ftvar_in_typ (tsubst_typ s (typ_var_f Y)).
Proof.
  intros s Σ X b Y Hdom Hnt HY Hdm Hin.
  assert (Hbinds : binds X (dbind_tvar_empty) (aenv_to_denv s (X ~ b ++ Σ)))
    by (apply d_mono_typ_ftvar with (T := tsubst_typ s (typ_var_f Y)); auto).
  apply binds_tvar_aenv_to_denv_inv in Hbinds.
  apply binds_cons_1 in Hbinds as [[e1 e2]|Hbinds].
  - subst. exfalso. apply Hnt. auto.
  - apply Hdom. apply binds_in_dom with (a := abind_tvar_empty). exact Hbinds.
Qed.

Lemma Arel_strip_scoped : forall s Σ X b,
  X `notin` dom Σ ->
  sigma_keys_in_env s (X ~ b ++ Σ) ->
  tvar_scope_ok s (X ~ b ++ Σ) ->
  Arel s (X ~ b ++ Σ) (aenv_to_denv s (X ~ b ++ Σ)) ->
  Arel s Σ (aenv_to_denv s Σ).
Proof.
  intros s Σ X b Hdom Hkey Hscope HA.
  unfold sigma_keys_in_env in Hkey.
  unfold tvar_scope_ok in Hscope.
  apply Arel_strip with (X := X) (b := b); auto.
  intros Y HY.
  destruct HA as [Hnb [Ht [Hs [He [Hin [Hft [Hfs Hv]]]]]]].
  destruct b.
  { (* tvar *)
    assert (Hfx : fresh_sigma X s).
    { apply Hft. apply binds_cons_2; auto. }
    assert (Hvals : forall Z T, In (Z,T) s -> X `notin` ftvar_in_typ T).
    { intros Z T HinZ.
      assert (HbZbig : binds Z (abind_etvar_empty) (X ~ abind_tvar_empty ++ Σ))
        by (exact (Hkey Z T HinZ)).
      assert (HbZ : binds Z (abind_etvar_empty) Σ).
      { apply binds_cons_1 in HbZbig as [[e1 e2]|HbZbig].
        { subst. discriminate e2. }
        { exact HbZbig. } }
      assert (Hbefore : before_bind (X ~ abind_tvar_empty ++ Σ) X Z).
      { destruct (binds_decomp _ _ _ _ HbZ) as [E1 [bz [E2 [Heq Ha]]]].
        exists ((X, abind_tvar_empty) :: E1), bz, E2.
        split.

(* ---------- per-item declarative semantics with normalised item envs ---------- *)
Fixpoint denv_to_dwl (Ψ : denv) : dworklist :=
  match Ψ with
  | nil => dworklist_empty
  | (x, dbind_tvar_empty) :: Ψ' => dworklist_cons_var (denv_to_dwl Ψ') x dbind_tvar_empty
  | (x, dbind_stvar_empty) :: Ψ' => dworklist_cons_var (denv_to_dwl Ψ') x dbind_stvar_empty
  | (x, dbind_typ A) :: Ψ' => dworklist_cons_var (denv_to_dwl Ψ') x (dbind_typ A)
  end.

Lemma dwl_to_denv_denv_to_dwl : forall Ψ,
  dwl_to_denv (denv_to_dwl Ψ) = Ψ.
Proof.
  intros Ψ. induction Ψ as [| [x b] Ψ IH]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct b; simpl; rewrite IH; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma d_wl_del_red_denv_to_dwl : forall Ψ,
  d_wl_del_red (denv_to_dwl Ψ).
Proof.
  intros Ψ. induction Ψ as [| [x b] Ψ IH]; simpl.
  - apply d_wl_del_red__empty.
  - destruct b.
    + apply d_wl_del_red__var. exact IH.
    + apply d_wl_del_red__var. exact IH.
    + apply d_wl_del_red__var. exact IH.
Qed.

Definition d_work_sem (Ψ : denv) (w : work) : Prop :=
  d_wl_del_red (dworklist_cons_work (denv_to_dwl Ψ) w).

Lemma d_work_sem_check : forall Ψ e A,
  d_work_sem Ψ (work_check e A) ->
  d_chk_inf Ψ e typingmode__chk A.
Proof.
  intros Ψ e A H. unfold d_work_sem in H.
  inversion H; subst; rewrite dwl_to_denv_denv_to_dwl in *; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma d_work_sem_sub : forall Ψ A B,
  d_work_sem Ψ (work_sub A B) ->
  d_sub Ψ A B.
Proof.
  intros Ψ A B H. unfold d_work_sem in H.
  inversion H; subst; rewrite dwl_to_denv_denv_to_dwl in *; assumption.
Qed.

Fixpoint denv_stvars (Ψ : denv) : denv :=
  match Ψ with
  | nil => nil
  | (x, dbind_stvar_empty) :: Ψ' => (x, dbind_stvar_empty) :: denv_stvars Ψ'
  | _ :: Ψ' => denv_stvars Ψ'
  end.

Fixpoint denv_nonstvars (Ψ : denv) : denv :=
  match Ψ with
  | nil => nil
  | (x, dbind_stvar_empty) :: Ψ' => denv_nonstvars Ψ'
  | p :: Ψ' => p :: denv_nonstvars Ψ'
  end.

Definition norm_denv (Ψ : denv) : denv :=
  denv_stvars Ψ ++ denv_nonstvars Ψ.

(* Each work item is interpreted in the normalisation of the environment
   formed by the binders in its suffix.  Leading binders are ignored, as
   they are never in scope for any item. *)
Fixpoint SEM (s : list (typvar * typ)) (Γ : aworklist) : Prop :=
  match Γ with
  | aworklist_empty => True
  | aworklist_cons_var Γ' _ _ => SEM s Γ'
  | aworklist_cons_work Γ' w =>
      d_work_sem (norm_denv (aenv_to_denv s (awl_to_aenv Γ'))) (tsubst_work s w)
      /\ SEM s Γ'
  end.

Lemma SEM_empty : forall s, SEM s aworklist_empty.
Proof. intros s. simpl. auto. Qed.

Lemma SEM_cons_var : forall s Γ X b,
  SEM s (aworklist_cons_var Γ X b) <-> SEM s Γ.
Proof. intros. simpl. tauto. Qed.

Lemma SEM_cons_work : forall s Γ w,
  SEM s (aworklist_cons_work Γ w) <->
  d_work_sem (norm_denv (aenv_to_denv s (awl_to_aenv Γ))) (tsubst_work s w)
  /\ SEM s Γ.
Proof. intros. simpl. tauto. Qed.
EOF

(* ---------- invariant with leading binders removed ---------- *)
Fixpoint drop_leading_vars (Γ : aworklist) : aworklist :=
  match Γ with
  | aworklist_cons_var Γ' _ _ => drop_leading_vars Γ'
  | _ => Γ
  end.

Definition base_env (Γ : aworklist) : aenv :=
  awl_to_aenv (drop_leading_vars Γ).

Definition base_arel (s : list (typvar * typ)) (Γ : aworklist) : Prop :=
  Arel s (base_env Γ) (aenv_to_denv s (base_env Γ)).

Definition base_keys (s : list (typvar * typ)) (Γ : aworklist) : Prop :=
  sigma_keys_in_env s (base_env Γ).

Definition base_scope (s : list (typvar * typ)) (Γ : aworklist) : Prop :=
  tvar_scope_ok s (base_env Γ).

Definition SINV (s : list (typvar * typ)) (Γ : aworklist) : Prop :=
  nb_sigma s /\ base_arel s Γ /\ base_keys s Γ /\ base_scope s Γ /\ SEM s Γ.

Definition SSOUND (Γ : aworklist) : Prop :=
  twf Γ -> tshape Γ -> exists s, SINV s Γ.

Lemma SINV_cons_var : forall s Γ X b,
  SINV s Γ -> SINV s (aworklist_cons_var Γ X b).
Proof.
  intros s Γ X b [Hnb [Harel [Hkeys [Hscope HSEM]]]].
  unfold SINV, base_arel, base_keys, base_scope, base_env in *.
  simpl. refine (conj Hnb (conj Harel (conj Hkeys (conj Hscope HSEM)))).
Qed.

Lemma SSOUND_gc_var : forall Γ X b,
  SSOUND Γ -> SSOUND (aworklist_cons_var Γ X b).
Proof.
  intros Γ X b HS Htw Hshape.
  simpl in Htw. destruct Htw as [HtwΓ [Hb Hfresh]].
  simpl in Hshape.
  destruct (HS HtwΓ Hshape) as [s Hs].
  exists s. apply SINV_cons_var. exact Hs.
Qed.
EOF

(* ---------- dropping expression-variable binders from a denv ---------- *)
Fixpoint denv_typeonly (Ψ : denv) : denv :=
  match Ψ with
  | nil => nil
  | (x, dbind_typ A) :: Ψ' => denv_typeonly Ψ'
  | p :: Ψ' => p :: denv_typeonly Ψ'
  end.

Lemma dom_typeonly_subset : forall Ψ X,
  X `in` dom (denv_typeonly Ψ) -> X `in` dom Ψ.
Proof.
  intros Ψ. induction Ψ as [|[Y b] Ψ IH]; intros X H; simpl in *.
  - exact H.
  - destruct b; simpl in *.
    + apply in_add_inv in H as [e|H].
      * subst. apply AtomSetImpl.add_1; reflexivity.
      * apply AtomSetImpl.add_2. apply IH; exact H.
    + apply in_add_inv in H as [e|H].
      * subst. apply AtomSetImpl.add_1; reflexivity.
      * apply AtomSetImpl.add_2. apply IH; exact H.
    + apply IH in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma binds_kind_typeonly : forall Ψ Y b',
  binds Y b' Ψ ->
  (b' = dbind_tvar_empty \/ b' = dbind_stvar_empty) ->
  binds Y b' (denv_typeonly Ψ).
Proof.
  intros Ψ. induction Ψ as [|[Y0 b] Ψ IH]; intros Y b' Hb Hkind; simpl in *.
  - apply binds_nil_iff in Hb. contradiction.
  - destruct b; simpl in *.
    + apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
      * subst. apply binds_cons_2; auto.
      * apply binds_cons_3. apply IH; assumption.
    + apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
      * subst. apply binds_cons_2; auto.
      * apply binds_cons_3. apply IH; assumption.
    + apply IH; assumption.
    + apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
      * subst. apply binds_cons_2; auto.
      * apply binds_cons_3. apply IH; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma d_wf_typ_typeonly : forall Ψ A,
  d_wf_typ Ψ A -> d_wf_typ (denv_typeonly Ψ) A.
Proof.
  intros Ψ A H.
  apply d_wf_typ_binds_kind with (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
  intros Y HY [Hb|Hb].
  - left. apply binds_kind_typeonly with (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
  - right. apply binds_kind_typeonly with (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
Qed.

Lemma d_mono_typ_typeonly : forall Ψ A,
  d_mono_typ Ψ A -> d_mono_typ (denv_typeonly Ψ) A.
Proof.
  intros Ψ A HH. rename HH into H0. induction H0 as
    [Ψ | Ψ X HX | Ψ A1 A2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2].
  - constructor.
  - constructor. apply binds_kind_typeonly with (Ψ := Ψ); auto. left; reflexivity.
  - constructor; [apply IH1 | apply IH2].
Qed.

Lemma subst_typ_in_aworklist_app : forall A X Γ1 Γ2,
  subst_typ_in_aworklist A X (awl_app Γ1 Γ2) =
  awl_app (subst_typ_in_aworklist A X Γ1) (subst_typ_in_aworklist A X Γ2).

  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma eraseσ_app : forall s Γ1 Γ2,
  eraseσ s (awl_app Γ1 Γ2) = dwl_app (eraseσ s Γ1) (eraseσ s Γ2).
Proof.

Fixpoint dwf_exp (Ψ : denv) (e : exp) {struct e} : Prop :=
  match e with
  | exp_unit => True
  | exp_var_b _ => True
  | exp_var_f _ => True
  | exp_abs e' => dwf_exp Ψ e'
  | exp_app e1 e2 => dwf_exp Ψ e1 /\ dwf_exp Ψ e2
  | exp_tabs e' =>

      | _ => False
      end
  | exp_tapp e' A => dwf_exp Ψ e' /\ d_wf_typ Ψ A
  | exp_anno e' A => dwf_exp Ψ e' /\ d_wf_typ Ψ A
  end.

Fixpoint dwf_conts (Ψ : denv) (cs : conts) {struct cs} : Prop :=
  match cs with
  | conts_infabs cd => dwf_contd Ψ cd
  | conts_inftapp A cs' => d_wf_typ Ψ A /\ dwf_conts Ψ cs'
  | conts_inftappunion A1 A2 cs' => d_wf_typ Ψ A1 /\ d_wf_typ Ψ A2 /\ dwf_conts Ψ cs'
  | conts_unioninftapp A cs' => d_wf_typ Ψ A /\ dwf_conts Ψ cs'
  | conts_sub A => d_wf_typ Ψ A
  end
with dwf_contd (Ψ : denv) (cd : contd) {struct cd} : Prop :=
  match cd with
  | contd_infabsunion A cd' => d_wf_typ Ψ A /\ dwf_contd Ψ cd'

Lemma tw_exp_trans_aux : forall n e,
  size_exp e <= n -> forall Σ, tw_exp Σ e ->
  forall s Ψ, Arel s Σ Ψ -> dwf_exp Ψ (tsubst_exp s e).
Proof.
  induction n as [| n IH]; intros e Hn Σ Htw s Ψ HA.
  - destruct e; simpl in Hn; exfalso; lia.
  - destruct e as [| nb | x | e0 | e1 e2 | e' | e0 A | e0 A]; simpl in Hn.
    + rewrite tsubst_exp_unit. constructor.
    + rewrite tsubst_exp_varb. constructor.
    + rewrite tsubst_exp_varf. constructor.
    + rewrite tsubst_exp_abs. simpl. apply (IH e0 ltac:(simpl; lia) Σ Htw s Ψ HA).
    + rewrite tsubst_exp_app. destruct Htw as [H1 H2]. constructor.
      * apply (IH e1 ltac:(simpl; lia) Σ H1 s Ψ HA).
      * apply (IH e2 ltac:(simpl; lia) Σ H2 s Ψ HA).
    + (* tabs *) rewrite tsubst_exp_tabs.
      destruct e' as [| nb0 | x0 | e0 | e1 e2 | e0 | e0 A0 | e0 A0]; simpl in *.
      * destruct Htw.
      * destruct Htw.
      * destruct Htw.
      * destruct Htw.
      * destruct Htw.
      * destruct Htw.
      * destruct Htw.
      * (* anno *) rewrite tsubst_exp_anno. simpl.
        destruct Htw as [H1 H2]. constructor.
        -- rewrite <- tsubst_all. apply a_wf_typ_trans with (s := s) (Σ := Σ) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
        -- apply (IH e0 ltac:(simpl; lia) Σ H2 s Ψ HA).
    + (* tapp *) rewrite tsubst_exp_tapp. destruct Htw as [H1 H2]. constructor.
      * apply (IH e0 ltac:(simpl; lia) Σ H1 s Ψ HA).
      * apply a_wf_typ_trans with (s := s) (Σ := Σ) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + (* anno *) rewrite tsubst_exp_anno. destruct Htw as [H1 H2]. constructor.
      * apply (IH e0 ltac:(simpl; lia) Σ H1 s Ψ HA).
      * apply a_wf_typ_trans with (s := s) (Σ := Σ) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
Qed.

Lemma tw_exp_trans : forall Σ e,
  tw_exp Σ e -> forall s Ψ, Arel s Σ Ψ -> dwf_exp Ψ (tsubst_exp s e).
Proof.
  intros Σ e Htw s Ψ HA. eapply tw_exp_trans_aux with (n := size_exp e); eauto.
Qed.

Definition base_env (Γ : aworklist) : aenv :=
  awl_to_aenv (drop_leading_vars Γ).

Definition base_arel (s : list (typvar * typ)) (Γ : aworklist) : Prop :=
  Arel s (base_env Γ) (aenv_to_denv s (base_env Γ)).

Definition base_keys (s : list (typvar * typ)) (Γ : aworklist) : Prop :=
  sigma_keys_in_env s (base_env Γ).

Definition base_scope (s : list (typvar * typ)) (Γ : aworklist) : Prop :=
  tvar_scope_ok s (base_env Γ).

Definition SINV (s : list (typvar * typ)) (Γ : aworklist) : Prop :=
  nb_sigma s /\ base_arel s Γ /\ base_keys s Γ /\ base_scope s Γ /\ SEM s Γ.

Definition SSOUND (Γ : aworklist) : Prop :=
  twf Γ -> tshape Γ -> exists s, SINV s Γ.

Lemma SINV_cons_var : forall s Γ X b,
  SINV s Γ -> SINV s (aworklist_cons_var Γ X b).
Proof.
  intros s Γ X b [Hnb [Harel [Hkeys [Hscope HSEM]]]].
  unfold SINV, base_arel, base_keys, base_scope, base_env in *.
  simpl. refine (conj Hnb (conj Harel (conj Hkeys (conj Hscope HSEM)))).
Qed.

  forall s Ψ, Arel s Σ Ψ -> dwf_exp Ψ (tsubst_exp s e).
Proof.
  induction n as [| n IH]; intros e Hn Σ Htw s Ψ HA.
  - destruct e; simpl in Hn; exfalso; lia.
  - destruct e as [| nb | x | e0 | e1 e2 | e' | e0 A | e0 A]; simpl in Hn.
    + rewrite tsubst_exp_unit. constructor.
    + rewrite tsubst_exp_varb. constructor.
    + rewrite tsubst_exp_varf. constructor.
    + rewrite tsubst_exp_abs. simpl. apply (IH e0 ltac:(simpl; lia) Σ Htw s Ψ HA).
    + rewrite tsubst_exp_app. destruct Htw as [H1 H2]. constructor.
      * apply (IH e1 ltac:(simpl; lia) Σ H1 s Ψ HA).
      * apply (IH e2 ltac:(simpl; lia) Σ H2 s Ψ HA).
    + (* tabs *) rewrite tsubst_exp_tabs.
      destruct e' as [| nb0 | x0 | e0 | e1 e2 | e0 | e0 A0 | e0 A0]; simpl in *.
      * destruct Htw.
      * destruct Htw.
      * destruct Htw.
      * destruct Htw.
      * destruct Htw.
      * destruct Htw.
      * destruct Htw.
      * (* anno *) rewrite tsubst_exp_anno. simpl.
        destruct Htw as [H1 H2]. constructor.
        -- rewrite <- tsubst_all. apply a_wf_typ_trans with (s := s) (Σ := Σ) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
        -- apply (IH e0 ltac:(simpl; lia) Σ H2 s Ψ HA).
    + (* tapp *) rewrite tsubst_exp_tapp. destruct Htw as [H1 H2]. constructor.
      * apply (IH e0 ltac:(simpl; lia) Σ H1 s Ψ HA).
      * apply a_wf_typ_trans with (s := s) (Σ := Σ) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
    + (* anno *) rewrite tsubst_exp_anno. destruct Htw as [H1 H2]. constructor.
      * apply (IH e0 ltac:(simpl; lia) Σ H1 s Ψ HA).
      * apply a_wf_typ_trans with (s := s) (Σ := Σ) (Ψ := Ψ); auto.
Qed.

Lemma tw_exp_trans : forall Σ e,
  tw_exp Σ e -> forall s Ψ, Arel s Σ Ψ -> dwf_exp Ψ (tsubst_exp s e).
Proof.
  intros Σ e Htw s Ψ HA. eapply tw_exp_trans_aux with (n := size_exp e); eauto.
Qed.

Definition base_env (Γ : aworklist) : aenv :=
  awl_to_aenv (drop_leading_vars Γ).

Definition base_arel (s : list (typvar * typ)) (Γ : aworklist) : Prop :=
  Arel s (base_env Γ) (aenv_to_denv s (base_env Γ)).

Definition base_keys (s : list (typvar * typ)) (Γ : aworklist) : Prop :=
  sigma_keys_in_env s (base_env Γ).

Definition base_scope (s : list (typvar * typ)) (Γ : aworklist) : Prop :=
  tvar_scope_ok s (base_env Γ).

Definition SINV (s : list (typvar * typ)) (Γ : aworklist) : Prop :=
  nb_sigma s /\ base_arel s Γ /\ base_keys s Γ /\ base_scope s Γ /\ SEM s Γ.

Definition SSOUND (Γ : aworklist) : Prop :=
  twf Γ -> tshape Γ -> exists s, SINV s Γ.

Lemma SINV_cons_var : forall s Γ X b,
  SINV s Γ -> SINV s (aworklist_cons_var Γ X b).
Proof.
  intros s Γ X b [Hnb [Harel [Hkeys [Hscope HSEM]]]].
  unfold SINV, base_arel, base_keys, base_scope, base_env in *.
  simpl. refine (conj Hnb (conj Harel (conj Hkeys (conj Hscope HSEM)))).
Qed.

  SSOUND Γ -> SSOUND (aworklist_cons_var Γ X b).
Proof.
  intros Γ X b HS Htw Hshape.

Fixpoint tw_exp (Σ : aenv) (e : exp) {struct e} : Prop :=
  match e with
  | exp_unit => True
  | exp_var_b _ => True
  | exp_var_f _ => True
  | exp_abs e' => tw_exp Σ e'
  | exp_app e1 e2 => tw_exp Σ e1 /\ tw_exp Σ e2
  | exp_tabs e' =>
      match e' with
      | exp_anno e'' A => a_wf_typ Σ (typ_all A) /\ tw_exp Σ e''
      | _ => False
      end
  | exp_tapp e' A => tw_exp Σ e' /\ a_wf_typ Σ A
  | exp_anno e' A => tw_exp Σ e' /\ a_wf_typ Σ A
  end.

Fixpoint tw_conts (Σ : aenv) (cs : conts) {struct cs} : Prop :=
  match cs with
  | conts_infabs cd => tw_contd Σ cd
  | conts_inftapp A cs' => a_wf_typ Σ A /\ tw_conts Σ cs'
  | conts_inftappunion A1 A2 cs' => a_wf_typ Σ A1 /\ a_wf_typ Σ A2 /\ tw_conts Σ cs'
  | conts_unioninftapp A cs' => a_wf_typ Σ A /\ tw_conts Σ cs'
  | conts_sub A => a_wf_typ Σ A
  end
with tw_contd (Σ : aenv) (cd : contd) {struct cd} : Prop :=
  match cd with
  | contd_infabsunion A cd' => a_wf_typ Σ A /\ tw_contd Σ cd'
  | contd_infapp e cs => tw_exp Σ e /\ tw_conts Σ cs
  | contd_unioninfabs A B cd' => a_wf_typ Σ (typ_arrow A B) /\ tw_contd Σ cd'
  end.

Fixpoint tw_work (Σ : aenv) (w : work) {struct w} : Prop :=
  match w with
  | work_infer e cs => tw_exp Σ e /\ tw_conts Σ cs
  | work_check e A => tw_exp Σ e /\ a_wf_typ Σ A
  | work_infabs A cd => a_wf_typ Σ A /\ tw_contd Σ cd
  | work_infabsunion A1 B1 A2 cd => a_wf_typ Σ (typ_arrow A1 B1) /\ a_wf_typ Σ A2 /\ tw_contd Σ cd
  | work_infapp A B e cs => a_wf_typ Σ (typ_arrow A B) /\ tw_exp Σ e /\ tw_conts Σ cs
  | work_inftapp A1 A2 cs => a_wf_typ Σ A1 /\ a_wf_typ Σ A2 /\ tw_conts Σ cs
  | work_sub A1 A2 => a_wf_typ Σ A1 /\ a_wf_typ Σ A2
  | work_inftappunion A1 A2 B cs => a_wf_typ Σ A1 /\ a_wf_typ Σ A2 /\ a_wf_typ Σ B /\ tw_conts Σ cs
  | work_unioninftapp A1 A2 cs => a_wf_typ Σ A1 /\ a_wf_typ Σ A2 /\ tw_conts Σ cs
  | work_unioninfabs A1 B1 A2 B2 cd => a_wf_typ Σ (typ_arrow A1 B1) /\ a_wf_typ Σ (typ_arrow A2 B2) /\ tw_contd Σ cd
  | work_applys cs A => a_wf_typ Σ A /\ tw_conts Σ cs
  | work_applyd cd A B => a_wf_typ Σ A /\ a_wf_typ Σ B /\ tw_contd Σ cd
  end.

Fixpoint tw_bind (Σ : aenv) (b : abind) {struct b} : Prop :=
  match b with
  | abind_var_typ A => a_wf_typ Σ A
  | _ => True
  end.

Fixpoint twf (Γ : aworklist) {struct Γ} : Prop :=
  match Γ with
  | aworklist_empty => True
  | aworklist_cons_var Γ' X b => twf Γ' /\ tw_bind (awl_to_aenv Γ') b /\ X `notin` dom (awl_to_aenv Γ')
  | aworklist_cons_work Γ' w => twf Γ' /\ tw_work (awl_to_aenv Γ') w
  end.

Lemma tw_bind_var : forall Σ A, tw_bind Σ (abind_var_typ A) -> a_wf_typ Σ A.
Proof. intros Σ A H. change (a_wf_typ Σ A) in H. exact H. Qed.

Lemma twf_env : forall Γ, twf Γ -> a_wf_env (awl_to_aenv Γ).
Proof.
  intros Γ. induction Γ as [| Γ' IH X b | Γ' IH w]; intros H.
  - simpl. constructor.
  - simpl in H. destruct H as [Ht [Hb Hf]]. simpl.
    destruct b as [| | | A].
    + apply a_wf_env__tvar.
      * apply IH. exact Ht.
      * auto.
    + apply a_wf_env__stvar.
      * apply IH. exact Ht.
      * auto.
    + apply a_wf_env__etvar.
      * apply IH. exact Ht.
      * auto.
    + apply a_wf_env__typ.
      * apply IH. exact Ht.
      * exact (tw_bind_var _ _ Hb).
      * exact Hf.
  - simpl in H. destruct H as [Ht Hw]. simpl. apply IH. exact Ht.

  | exp_var_b _ => True
  | exp_var_f _ => True
  | exp_abs e' => tw_exp Σ e'
  | exp_app e1 e2 => tw_exp Σ e1 /\ tw_exp Σ e2
  | exp_tabs e' =>
      match e' with
      | exp_anno e'' A => a_wf_typ Σ (typ_all A) /\ tw_exp Σ e''
      | _ => False
      end
  | exp_tapp e' A => tw_exp Σ e' /\ a_wf_typ Σ A
  | exp_anno e' A => tw_exp Σ e' /\ a_wf_typ Σ A
  end.

Fixpoint tw_conts (Σ : aenv) (cs : conts) {struct cs} : Prop :=
  match cs with
  | conts_infabs cd => tw_contd Σ cd
  | conts_inftapp A cs' => a_wf_typ Σ A /\ tw_conts Σ cs'
  | conts_inftappunion A1 A2 cs' => a_wf_typ Σ A1 /\ a_wf_typ Σ A2 /\ tw_conts Σ cs'
  | conts_unioninftapp A cs' => a_wf_typ Σ A /\ tw_conts Σ cs'
  | conts_sub A => a_wf_typ Σ A
  end
with tw_contd (Σ : aenv) (cd : contd) {struct cd} : Prop :=
  match cd with
  | contd_infabsunion A cd' => a_wf_typ Σ A /\ tw_contd Σ cd'
  | contd_infapp e cs => tw_exp Σ e /\ tw_conts Σ cs
  | contd_unioninfabs A B cd' => a_wf_typ Σ (typ_arrow A B) /\ tw_contd Σ cd'
  end.

Fixpoint tw_work (Σ : aenv) (w : work) {struct w} : Prop :=
  match w with
  | work_infer e cs => tw_exp Σ e /\ tw_conts Σ cs
  | work_check e A => tw_exp Σ e /\ a_wf_typ Σ A
  | work_infabs A cd => a_wf_typ Σ A /\ tw_contd Σ cd
  | work_infabsunion A1 B1 A2 cd => a_wf_typ Σ (typ_arrow A1 B1) /\ a_wf_typ Σ A2 /\ tw_contd Σ cd
  | work_infapp A B e cs => a_wf_typ Σ (typ_arrow A B) /\ tw_exp Σ e /\ tw_conts Σ cs
  | work_inftapp A1 A2 cs => a_wf_typ Σ A1 /\ a_wf_typ Σ A2 /\ tw_conts Σ cs
  | work_sub A1 A2 => a_wf_typ Σ A1 /\ a_wf_typ Σ A2
  | work_inftappunion A1 A2 B cs => a_wf_typ Σ A1 /\ a_wf_typ Σ A2 /\ a_wf_typ Σ B /\ tw_conts Σ cs
  | work_unioninftapp A1 A2 cs => a_wf_typ Σ A1 /\ a_wf_typ Σ A2 /\ tw_conts Σ cs
  | work_unioninfabs A1 B1 A2 B2 cd => a_wf_typ Σ (typ_arrow A1 B1) /\ a_wf_typ Σ (typ_arrow A2 B2) /\ tw_contd Σ cd
  | work_applys cs A => a_wf_typ Σ A /\ tw_conts Σ cs
  | work_applyd cd A B => a_wf_typ Σ A /\ a_wf_typ Σ B /\ tw_contd Σ cd
  end.

Fixpoint tw_bind (Σ : aenv) (b : abind) {struct b} : Prop :=
  match b with
  | abind_var_typ A => a_wf_typ Σ A
  | _ => True
  end.

Fixpoint twf (Γ : aworklist) {struct Γ} : Prop :=
  match Γ with
  | aworklist_empty => True
  | aworklist_cons_var Γ' X b => twf Γ' /\ tw_bind (awl_to_aenv Γ') b /\ X `notin` dom (awl_to_aenv Γ')
  | aworklist_cons_work Γ' w => twf Γ' /\ tw_work (awl_to_aenv Γ') w
  end.

Lemma tw_bind_var : forall Σ A, tw_bind Σ (abind_var_typ A) -> a_wf_typ Σ A.
Proof. intros Σ A H. change (a_wf_typ Σ A) in H. exact H. Qed.

Lemma twf_env : forall Γ, twf Γ -> a_wf_env (awl_to_aenv Γ).
Proof.
  intros Γ. induction Γ as [| Γ' IH X b | Γ' IH w]; intros H.
  - simpl. constructor.
  - simpl in H. destruct H as [Ht [Hb Hf]]. simpl.
    destruct b as [| | | A].
    + apply a_wf_env__tvar.
      * apply IH. exact Ht.
      * auto.
    + apply a_wf_env__stvar.
      * apply IH. exact Ht.
      * auto.
    + apply a_wf_env__etvar.
      * apply IH. exact Ht.
      * auto.
    + apply a_wf_env__typ.
      * apply IH. exact Ht.
      * exact (tw_bind_var _ _ Hb).
      * exact Hf.
  - simpl in H. destruct H as [Ht Hw]. simpl. apply IH. exact Ht.

Require Import Bool.

Fixpoint awl_app (Γ1 Γ2 : aworklist) :=
  match Γ1 with
    | aworklist_empty => Γ2
    | aworklist_cons_var Γ1' X b => aworklist_cons_var (awl_app Γ1' Γ2) X b
    | aworklist_cons_work Γ1' w => aworklist_cons_work (awl_app Γ1' Γ2) w
  end.

Inductive aworklist_subst : aworklist -> typvar -> typ -> aworklist -> aworklist -> Prop :=
  | a_ws__stop : forall Γ X A ,
      aworklist_subst (aworklist_cons_var Γ X (abind_etvar_empty)) X A Γ aworklist_empty
  | a_ws__var_stay : forall Γ X Y A B Γ1 Γ2,
      aworklist_subst Γ X A Γ1 Γ2 ->
      aworklist_subst (aworklist_cons_var Γ Y (abind_var_typ B)) X A Γ1 (aworklist_cons_var Γ2 Y (abind_var_typ B))
  | a_ws__tvar_stay : forall Γ X Y A Γ1 Γ2,
      aworklist_subst Γ X A Γ1 Γ2 ->
      Y <> X ->
      Y `notin` ftvar_in_typ A ->
      aworklist_subst (aworklist_cons_var Γ Y (abind_tvar_empty)) X A Γ1 (aworklist_cons_var Γ2 Y (abind_tvar_empty))
  | a_ws__stvar_stay : forall Γ X Y A Γ1 Γ2,
      aworklist_subst Γ X A Γ1 Γ2 ->
      Y <> X ->
      Y `notin` ftvar_in_typ A ->
      aworklist_subst (aworklist_cons_var Γ Y (abind_stvar_empty)) X A Γ1 (aworklist_cons_var Γ2 Y (abind_stvar_empty))
  | a_ws__work_stay : forall Γ X A w Γ1 Γ2,
      aworklist_subst Γ X A Γ1 Γ2 ->
      aworklist_subst (aworklist_cons_work Γ w) X A  Γ1 (aworklist_cons_work Γ2 w)
  | a_ws__etvar_stay : forall Γ X Y A Γ1 Γ2,
      aworklist_subst Γ X A Γ1 Γ2 ->
      Y <> X ->
      Y `notin` ftvar_in_typ A ->
      aworklist_subst (aworklist_cons_var Γ Y (abind_etvar_empty)) X A Γ1 (aworklist_cons_var Γ2 Y (abind_etvar_empty))
  | a_ws__etvar_move : forall Γ1 Γ2 X Y A  Γ'1 Γ'2,
      aworklist_subst (awl_app Γ2 (aworklist_cons_var (aworklist_cons_var Γ1 Y abind_etvar_empty) X abind_etvar_empty)) X A Γ'1 Γ'2 ->
      Y <> X ->
      Y `in` ftvar_in_typ A ->
      aworklist_subst (aworklist_cons_var (awl_app Γ2 (aworklist_cons_var Γ1 X abind_etvar_empty)) Y (abind_etvar_empty)) X A Γ'1 Γ'2.

Inductive a_wl_red : aworklist -> Prop :=
  | a_wl_red__empty : a_wl_red aworklist_empty
  | a_wl_red__gc_var : forall (Γ:aworklist) (X:typvar) (b:abind),
      a_wl_red Γ ->
      a_wl_red (aworklist_cons_var Γ X b)
  | a_wl_red__sub_top : forall (Γ:aworklist) (B1:typ),
      a_wl_red Γ ->
      a_wl_red (aworklist_cons_work Γ (work_sub B1 typ_top))
  | a_wl_red__sub_bot : forall (Γ:aworklist) (A:typ),
      a_wl_red Γ ->
      a_wl_red (aworklist_cons_work Γ (work_sub typ_bot A))
  | a_wl_red__sub_unit : forall (Γ:aworklist),
      a_wl_red Γ ->
      a_wl_red (aworklist_cons_work Γ (work_sub typ_unit typ_unit))
  | a_wl_red__sub_tvar : forall (Γ:aworklist) (X:typvar),
      a_wl_red Γ ->
      a_wl_red (aworklist_cons_work Γ (work_sub (typ_var_f X) (typ_var_f X)))
  | a_wl_red__subarrow : forall (Γ:aworklist) (B1 B2 A1 A2:typ),
      a_wl_red (aworklist_cons_work (aworklist_cons_work Γ (work_sub A1 B1)) (work_sub B2 A2)) ->
      a_wl_red (aworklist_cons_work Γ (work_sub (typ_arrow B1 B2) (typ_arrow A1 A2)))
  | a_wl_red__sub_alll : forall (L:vars) (Γ:aworklist) (B1 A1:typ),

      (a_wl_red  (awl_app (subst_typ_in_aworklist (typ_arrow (typ_var_f X1) (typ_var_f X2)) X Γ2) Γ1 )   ) ) ->
      a_wl_red (aworklist_cons_work Γ (work_sub (typ_var_f X) (typ_arrow A1 A2)))
  | a_wl_red__sub_arrow2 : forall (L:vars) (Γ:aworklist) (A1 A2:typ) (X:typvar),
      binds ( X )  ( abind_etvar_empty ) (  ( awl_to_aenv  Γ  )  )  ->
      ( a_mono_typ   ( awl_to_aenv  Γ  )     ( (typ_arrow A1 A2) )   -> False )  ->
      (forall X1, X1 `notin` L -> forall X2, X2 `notin` (L `union` singleton X1) -> forall Γ1 Γ2,
      (aworklist_subst (aworklist_cons_work (aworklist_cons_var (aworklist_cons_var Γ X1 abind_etvar_empty) X2 abind_etvar_empty) (work_sub (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_var_f X))) X (typ_arrow (typ_var_f X1) (typ_var_f X2)) Γ1 Γ2) ->

      a_wl_red (aworklist_cons_work Γ (work_sub (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_var_f X)))
  | a_wl_red__sub_etvarmono1 : forall (Γ Γ1 Γ2:aworklist) (X:typvar) (A:typ),
      binds ( X )  abind_etvar_empty (  ( awl_to_aenv  Γ  )  )  ->
      a_mono_typ  ( awl_to_aenv  Γ  )  A ->
      X `notin` ftvar_in_typ A ->
      (aworklist_subst  Γ  X A Γ1 Γ2) ->
      a_wl_red   (awl_app (subst_typ_in_aworklist A X Γ2) Γ1 ) ->

      a_mono_typ  ( awl_to_aenv  Γ  )  B ->
      X `notin` ftvar_in_typ B ->
      (aworklist_subst  Γ  X B Γ1 Γ2) ->
      a_wl_red   (awl_app (subst_typ_in_aworklist B X Γ2) Γ1 ) ->
      a_wl_red (aworklist_cons_work Γ (work_sub (typ_var_f X) B))
  | a_wl_red__sub_intersection1 : forall (Γ:aworklist) (A1 B1 B2:typ),
      a_wl_red (aworklist_cons_work (aworklist_cons_work Γ (work_sub A1 B1)) (work_sub A1 B2)) ->
      a_wl_red (aworklist_cons_work Γ (work_sub A1 (typ_intersection B1 B2)))
  | a_wl_red__sub_intersection2 : forall (Γ:aworklist) (B1 B2 A1:typ),
      a_wl_red (aworklist_cons_work Γ (work_sub B1 A1)) ->
      a_wl_red (aworklist_cons_work Γ (work_sub (typ_intersection B1 B2) A1))
  | a_wl_red__sub_intersection3 : forall (Γ:aworklist) (B1 B2 A1:typ),

  | a_wl_red__sub_union1 : forall (Γ:aworklist) (B1 A1 A2:typ),

  | a_wl_red__sub_union3 : forall (Γ:aworklist) (B1 B2 A1:typ),

    | aworklist_cons_work Γ1' w => aworklist_cons_work (awl_app Γ1' Γ2) w

The SSOUND invariant currently: twf Γ -> tshape Γ -> exists s, SINV s Γ. Instead of twf, perhaps use a well-formedness predicate that is derivable from a_wf_exp and sufficient. Great. a_wf_wwl is available and inductive with all nice inversion lemmas. Our first goal: derive a_wf_wwl (cons_work empty (work_check e A)) from a_wf_exp nil e, a_wf_typ nil A. Easy: apply conswork with empty.

Then we need a semantic invariant `S(Γ) := a_wf_wwl Γ -> tshape Γ -> exists s, SINV s Γ` maybe. But for rules like gc_var, premise is Γ and conclusion cons_var Γ X b; a_wf_wwl conclusion does not imply a_wf_wwl Γ? Yes it does via inversion: a_wf_wwl (cons_var Γ X b) gives a_wf_wwl Γ (and freshness/type). For `gc_var` rule we need S(Γ) from S(cons_var Γ X b) given a_wf_wwl conclusion; we have a_wf_wwl Γ. Then apply IH. Fine. But also SINV for cons_var given SINV Γ.

Earlier SSOUND was exactly `twf Γ -> tshape Γ -> exists s, SINV s Γ`, and gc_var proved since twf cons_var implies twf Γ. So if we just replace `twf` with `a_wf_wwl`, all the 13 constructor lemmas may still be provable? They used twf for work well-formedness of premises. But a_wf_wwl gives a_wf_work which is relationally similar to tw_work. The proofs of SSOUND_* need adjusting from twf to a_wf_wwl: more importantly, they need to derive the well-formedness of premise worklists. Under twf, tw_work is a Fixpoint giving direct decomposition; under a_wf_wwl it's an Inductive giving inversion. But likely doable (maybe our custom tw_exp metatheory was to convert a_wf_exp to dwf_exp...). Hmm.

But wait, why did the earlier proof use SINV = base_arel ... SEM, and need twf? The SSOUND_* lemmas need produce SINV for the conclusion worklist from SINV for premise. E.g. chk_sub: conclusion work_check e A1, premise work_infer e (conts_sub A1). SINV conclusion requires SEM s Γ_conclusion: first item `work_check e A1` semantically d_work_sem env (work_check (tsubst e)(tsubst A1)); SEM premise gives d_work_sem env (work_infer (tsubst e)(conts_sub (tsubst A1))). There's a semantic lemma d_work_sem_check/sub relating these. No well-formedness needed. The twf is only used at gc_var etc? Let's look at SSOUND_gc_var proof.

Lemma SSOUND_gc_var : forall Γ X b,
  SSOUND Γ -> SSOUND (aworklist_cons_var Γ X b).
Proof.
  intros Γ X b HS Htw Hshape.
  simpl in Htw. destruct Htw as [HtwΓ [Hb Hfresh]].
  simpl in Hshape.
  destruct (HS HtwΓ Hshape) as [s Hs].
  exists s. apply SINV_cons_var. exact Hs.
Qed.

Lemma SSOUND_empty : SSOUND aworklist_empty.
Proof.
  intros _ _. exists nil.
  unfold SINV, base_arel, base_keys, base_scope, base_env.
  simpl. refine (conj _ (conj _ (conj _ (conj _ _)))).
  - unfold nb_sigma. intros X T H. simpl in H. contradiction.
  - unfold Arel. repeat split; simpl; intros; try contradiction; auto.
    unfold nb_sigma. intros X T H. simpl in H. contradiction.
  - unfold sigma_keys_in_env. simpl. intros Y T H. contradiction.
  - unfold tvar_scope_ok. simpl. intros Y T H. contradiction.
  - simpl. auto.
Qed.

Lemma d_work_sem_chk_sub : forall Ψ e A1,
  d_work_sem Ψ (work_infer e (conts_sub A1)) ->
  d_work_sem Ψ (work_check e A1).
Proof.
  intros Ψ e A1 H. unfold d_work_sem in *.
  inversion H; subst.
  rewrite dwl_to_denv_denv_to_dwl in H2.
  inversion H4; subst.
  inversion H3; subst.
  inversion H6; subst.
  rewrite dwl_to_denv_denv_to_dwl in H5.
  apply d_wl_del_red__chk with (A := A1).
  - rewrite dwl_to_denv_denv_to_dwl.
    apply d_chk_inf__chk_sub with (B := A); [exact H2|exact H5].
  - exact H8.
Qed.


Lemma SSOUND_chk_sub : forall Γ e A1,
  SSOUND (aworklist_cons_work Γ (work_infer e (conts_sub A1))) ->
  SSOUND (aworklist_cons_work Γ (work_check e A1)).
Proof.
  intros Γ e A1 HS Htw Hshape.
  assert (Htwp : twf (aworklist_cons_work Γ (work_infer e (conts_sub A1)))).
  { simpl. simpl in Htw. exact Htw. }
  assert (Hshapep : tshape (aworklist_cons_work Γ (work_infer e (conts_sub A1)))).
  { simpl. simpl in Hshape. exact Hshape. }
  destruct (HS Htwp Hshapep) as [s Hs].
  exists s.
  destruct Hs as [Hnb [Harel [Hkeys [Hscope HSEM]]]].
  unfold SINV. refine (conj Hnb (conj Harel (conj Hkeys (conj Hscope _)))).
  unfold SEM in HSEM. simpl in HSEM. destruct HSEM as [Hsem1 Hsem2].
  split.
  - rewrite tsubst_work_check.
    apply d_work_sem_chk_sub with (e := tsubst_exp s e) (A1 := tsubst_typ s A1).
    rewrite tsubst_work_infer, tsubst_conts_sub in Hsem1. exact Hsem1.
  - exact Hsem2.
Qed.

Proof.
  intros Ψ A B1 B2 H1 H2.

  end.

Definition erase_bind (s : list (typvar * typ)) (b : abind) : option dbind :=
  match b with
  | abind_tvar_empty => Some dbind_tvar_empty
  | abind_stvar_empty => Some dbind_stvar_empty
  | abind_etvar_empty => None
  | abind_var_typ A => Some (dbind_typ (tsubst_typ s A))
  end.

Fixpoint eraseσ (s : list (typvar * typ)) (Γ : aworklist) {struct Γ} : dworklist :=
  match Γ with
  | aworklist_empty => dworklist_empty
  | aworklist_cons_var Γ' X b =>
      match erase_bind s b with
      | Some db => dworklist_cons_var (eraseσ s Γ') X db
      | None => eraseσ s Γ'
      end
  | aworklist_cons_work Γ' w =>
      dworklist_cons_work (eraseσ s Γ') (tsubst_work s w)
  end.

Definition sigma_keys_in_env (s : list (typvar * typ)) (Σ : aenv) : Prop :=
  forall Y T, In (Y,T) s -> binds Y (abind_etvar_empty) Σ.

Definition before_bind (Σ : aenv) (X Y : atom) : Prop :=
  exists Σ1 b Σ2, Σ = Σ1 ++ (Y,b) :: Σ2 /\ In (X, abind_tvar_empty) Σ1.

Definition tvar_scope_ok (s : list (typvar * typ)) (Σ : aenv) : Prop :=
  forall Y T, In (Y,T) s -> binds Y (abind_etvar_empty) Σ ->
  forall X, binds X (abind_tvar_empty) Σ -> before_bind Σ X Y ->
    X `notin` ftvar_in_typ T.

Require Export Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import List.

Fixpoint ftvar_in_aworklist' (Γ_5:aworklist) : vars :=
  match Γ_5 with
    | aworklist_empty => empty
    | (aworklist_cons_var Γ X ab) =>
      match ab with
      | abind_var_typ A => (ftvar_in_aworklist' Γ) \u (ftvar_in_abind ab)
      | _ => (ftvar_in_aworklist' Γ) \u (singleton X)
      end
    | (aworklist_cons_work Γ w) => (ftvar_in_aworklist' Γ) \u (ftvar_in_work w)
  end.

Fixpoint fvar_in_aworklist' (Γ_5:aworklist) : vars :=
  match Γ_5 with
    | aworklist_empty => {}
    | (aworklist_cons_var Γ x ab) =>
      match ab with
      | abind_var_typ A => (fvar_in_aworklist' Γ) \u (singleton x)
      | _ => (fvar_in_aworklist' Γ)
      end
    | (aworklist_cons_work Γ w) => (fvar_in_aworklist' Γ) \u (fvar_in_work w)
  end.

Inductive apply_conts : conts -> typ -> work -> Prop :=
  | apply_conts__infabs: forall A cs,
      apply_conts (conts_infabs cs) A (work_infabs A cs)
  | apply_conts__inftapp : forall A B cs,
      apply_conts (conts_inftapp B cs) A (work_inftapp A B cs)
  | apply_conts__inftappunion : forall A2 B C1 cs,
      apply_conts (conts_inftappunion A2 B cs) C1 (work_inftappunion C1 A2 B cs)
  | apply_conts__unioninftapp : forall A1 A2 cs,
      apply_conts (conts_unioninftapp A1 cs) A2 (work_unioninftapp A1 A2 cs)
  | apply_conts__sub : forall A B,
      apply_conts (conts_sub B) A (work_sub A B).

Fixpoint subst_typ_in_typ (A_5:typ) (X5:typvar) (A__6:typ) {struct A__6} : typ :=
  match A__6 with
  | typ_unit => typ_unit
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_bot => typ_bot
  | (typ_var_b nat) => typ_var_b nat
  | (typ_var_f X) => (if eq_var X X5 then A_5 else (typ_var_f X))
  | (typ_arrow A1 A2) => typ_arrow (subst_typ_in_typ A_5 X5 A1) (subst_typ_in_typ A_5 X5 A2)
  | (typ_all A) => typ_all (subst_typ_in_typ A_5 X5 A)
  | (typ_union A1 A2) => typ_union (subst_typ_in_typ A_5 X5 A1) (subst_typ_in_typ A_5 X5 A2)
  | (typ_intersection A1 A2) => typ_intersection (subst_typ_in_typ A_5 X5 A1) (subst_typ_in_typ A_5 X5 A2)
end.

Fixpoint subst_typ_in_exp (A_5:typ) (X5:typvar) (e_5:exp) {struct e_5} : exp :=
  match e_5 with

  | (exp_var_f x) => exp_var_f x
  | (exp_abs e) => exp_abs (subst_typ_in_exp A_5 X5 e)
  | (exp_app e1 e2) => exp_app (subst_typ_in_exp A_5 X5 e1) (subst_typ_in_exp A_5 X5 e2)
  | (exp_tabs e) => exp_tabs (subst_typ_in_exp A_5 X5 e)
  | (exp_tapp e A) => exp_tapp (subst_typ_in_exp A_5 X5 e) (subst_typ_in_typ A_5 X5 A)

Fixpoint subst_exp_in_exp (e_5:exp) (x5:expvar) (e__6:exp) {struct e__6} : exp :=
  match e__6 with

Require Import Program.Tactics.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import List.

Require Import uni.notations.
Require Import uni.algo_worklist.def_extra.
Open Scope aworklist_scope.
Open Scope dworklist_scope.

(* ---------- substitution of type variables by types ---------- *)
Fixpoint tsubst_typ (s : list (typvar * typ)) (A : typ) : typ :=
  match s with
  | nil => A
  | (X, T) :: s' => tsubst_typ s' (subst_typ_in_typ T X A)
  end.

Fixpoint tsubst_exp (s : list (typvar * typ)) (e : exp) : exp :=
  match s with
  | nil => e
  | (X, T) :: s' => tsubst_exp s' (subst_typ_in_exp T X e)
  end.

Fixpoint tsubst_conts (s : list (typvar * typ)) (cs : conts) : conts :=
  match s with
  | nil => cs
  | (X, T) :: s' => tsubst_conts s' (subst_typ_in_conts T X cs)
  end
with tsubst_contd (s : list (typvar * typ)) (cd : contd) : contd :=
  match s with
  | nil => cd
  | (X, T) :: s' => tsubst_contd s' (subst_typ_in_contd T X cd)
  end.

Fixpoint tsubst_work (s : list (typvar * typ)) (w : work) : work :=
  match s with
  | nil => w
  | (X, T) :: s' => tsubst_work s' (subst_typ_in_work T X w)
  end.

  - assert (H1 : X `notin` ftvar_in_typ T1)

    assert (H2 : X `notin` ftvar_in_typ T2)

  - assert (H1 : X `notin` ftvar_in_typ T1)

    assert (H2 : X `notin` ftvar_in_typ T2)
      by (intro Hc; apply H; apply AtomSetImpl.union_3; exact Hc).
    rewrite (IH1 H1), (IH2 H2). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma tsubst_typ_cons_fresh : forall s A X T,
  X `notin` ftvar_in_typ T ->
  tsubst_typ ((X,A)::s) T = tsubst_typ s T.
Proof.
  intros s A X T H. simpl. rewrite subst_typ_in_typ_fresh with (A := A); auto.
Qed.

Lemma subst_typ_in_exp_fresh : forall A X e,
  X `notin` ftvar_in_exp e -> subst_typ_in_exp A X e = e.
Proof.
  intros A X e. induction e as [| nb | y | e IH | e1 IH1 e2 IH2 | e IH | e IH T | e IH T];

  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.

    assert (H2 : X `notin` ftvar_in_exp e2)
      by (intro Hc; apply H; apply AtomSetImpl.union_3; exact Hc).
    rewrite (IH1 H1), (IH2 H2). reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH; auto.
  - assert (H1 : X `notin` ftvar_in_exp e)
      by (intro Hc; apply H; apply AtomSetImpl.union_2; exact Hc).
      by (intro Hc; apply H; apply AtomSetImpl.union_2; exact Hc).
    assert (H2 : X `notin` ftvar_in_typ A0)
      by (intro Hc; apply H; apply AtomSetImpl.union_3; apply AtomSetImpl.union_2; exact Hc).
    assert (H3 : X `notin` ftvar_in_typ B)
      by (intro Hc; apply H; apply AtomSetImpl.union_3; apply AtomSetImpl.union_3; exact Hc).
    simpl. rewrite (subst_typ_in_contd_fresh A X cd H1), (subst_typ_in_typ_fresh A X A0 H2),

Lemma tsubst_work_cons_fresh : forall s A X w,

Proof.
  intros s A X w H. simpl.
  rewrite subst_typ_in_work_fresh with (A := A); auto.
Qed.

Lemma eraseσ_fresh : forall s A X Γ,
  X `notin` ftvar_in_aworklist Γ ->
  eraseσ ((X,A)::s) Γ = eraseσ s Γ.
Proof.

Lemma twf_ftvar_notin : forall Γ,
  twf Γ ->
  forall X, X `notin` dom (awl_to_aenv Γ) -> X `notin` ftvar_in_aworklist Γ.
Proof.
  intros Γ. induction Γ as [| Γ' IH Y b | Γ' IH w]; intros Htwf X Hnotin.
  - simpl. intro Hc. exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 (a:=X) Hc).
  - simpl in Htwf. destruct Htwf as [Htwf' [Hb Hfresh]].
    simpl in Hnotin.
    assert (Hnotin_tail : X `notin` dom (awl_to_aenv Γ')).
    { apply (notin_dom_cons abind X Y b (awl_to_aenv Γ')). exact Hnotin. }
    simpl. intro Hc. apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in Hc as [Hc|Hc].
    + exact (IH Htwf' X Hnotin_tail Hc).
    + destruct b; simpl in Hb.
      * simpl in Hc. exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 (a:=X) Hc).
      * simpl in Hc. exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 (a:=X) Hc).
      * simpl in Hc. exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 (a:=X) Hc).
      * exact (a_wf_typ_ftvar_notin (awl_to_aenv Γ') A X Hb Hnotin_tail Hc).
  - simpl in Htwf. destruct Htwf as [Htwf' Htw].
    simpl. intro Hc. apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in Hc as [Hc|Hc].
    + exact (IH Htwf' X Hnotin Hc).
    + exact (tw_work_ftvar_notin (awl_to_aenv Γ') w Htw X Hnotin Hc).
Qed.

Lemma subst_typ_in_typ_fresh : forall A X T,
  X `notin` ftvar_in_typ T -> subst_typ_in_typ A X T = T.
Proof.
  intros A X T. induction T as [| | | n | Y | T1 IH1 T2 IH2 | T0 IH0 | T1 IH1 T2 IH2 | T1 IH1 T2 IH2];
    simpl; intros H.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (eq_var Y X) as [e|e].
    + exfalso. apply H. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. exact e.
    + reflexivity.
  - assert (H1 : X `notin` ftvar_in_typ T1)
      by (intro Hc; apply H; apply AtomSetImpl.union_2; exact Hc).
    assert (H2 : X `notin` ftvar_in_typ T2)
      by (intro Hc; apply H; apply AtomSetImpl.union_3; exact Hc).
    rewrite (IH1 H1), (IH2 H2). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IH0 H). reflexivity.
  - assert (H1 : X `notin` ftvar_in_typ T1)
      by (intro Hc; apply H; apply AtomSetImpl.union_2; exact Hc).
    assert (H2 : X `notin` ftvar_in_typ T2)
      by (intro Hc; apply H; apply AtomSetImpl.union_3; exact Hc).
    rewrite (IH1 H1), (IH2 H2). reflexivity.

Lemma tw_conts_contd_ftvar_mut : forall Σ,
  (forall cs, tw_conts Σ cs ->
     forall X, X `notin` dom Σ -> X `notin` ftvar_in_conts cs) /\
  (forall cd, tw_contd Σ cd ->
     forall X, X `notin` dom Σ -> X `notin` ftvar_in_contd cd).
Proof.
  intros Σ.
  assert (H : (forall cd, tw_contd Σ cd ->
                 forall X, X `notin` dom Σ -> X `notin` ftvar_in_contd cd) /\
              (forall cs, tw_conts Σ cs ->
                 forall X, X `notin` dom Σ -> X `notin` ftvar_in_conts cs)).
  { apply contd_conts_mutind.
    - intros A cd IH Htw X HX. simpl in Htw. destruct Htw as [H1 H2].
      simpl. intro Hc. apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in Hc as [Hc|Hc].
      + exact (a_wf_typ_ftvar_notin Σ A X H1 HX Hc).
      + exact (IH H2 X HX Hc).
    - intros e cs IH Htw X HX. simpl in Htw. destruct Htw as [H1 H2].
      simpl. intro Hc. apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in Hc as [Hc|Hc].
      + exact (tw_exp_ftvar_notin Σ e H1 X HX Hc).
      + exact (IH H2 X HX Hc).
    - intros A B cd IH Htw X HX. simpl in Htw. destruct Htw as [H1 H2].
      simpl. intro Hc. apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in Hc as [Hc|Hc].
      + apply (a_wf_typ_ftvar_notin Σ (typ_arrow A B) X H1 HX).
        apply AtomSetImpl.union_2. exact Hc.
      + apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in Hc as [Hc|Hc].
        * apply (a_wf_typ_ftvar_notin Σ (typ_arrow A B) X H1 HX).
          apply AtomSetImpl.union_3. exact Hc.
        * exact (IH H2 X HX Hc).
    - intros cd IH Htw X HX. simpl in Htw. simpl. exact (IH Htw X HX).
    - intros A cs IH Htw X HX. simpl in Htw. destruct Htw as [H1 H2].
      simpl. intro Hc. apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in Hc as [Hc|Hc].
      + exact (a_wf_typ_ftvar_notin Σ A X H1 HX Hc).
      + exact (IH H2 X HX Hc).
    - intros A1 A2 cs IH Htw X HX. simpl in Htw. destruct Htw as [H1 [H2 H3]].
      simpl. intro Hc. apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in Hc as [Hc|Hc].
      + exact (a_wf_typ_ftvar_notin Σ A1 X H1 HX Hc).
      + apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in Hc as [Hc|Hc].
        * exact (a_wf_typ_ftvar_notin Σ A2 X H2 HX Hc).
        * exact (IH H3 X HX Hc).
    - intros A cs IH Htw X HX. simpl in Htw. destruct Htw as [H1 H2].
      simpl. intro Hc. apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in Hc as [Hc|Hc].
      + exact (a_wf_typ_ftvar_notin Σ A X H1 HX Hc).
      + exact (IH H2 X HX Hc).
    - intros A Htw X HX. simpl in Htw. simpl.
      exact (a_wf_typ_ftvar_notin Σ A X Htw HX).
  }
  destruct H as [Hcd Hcs]. split.
  - apply Hcs.
  - apply Hcd.
Qed.

  tw_conts Σ cs ->
  forall X, X `notin` dom Σ -> X `notin` ftvar_in_conts cs.
Proof.
  intros Σ cs H. apply (proj1 (tw_conts_contd_ftvar_mut Σ)); exact H.
Qed.

Lemma tw_contd_ftvar_notin : forall Σ cd,
  tw_contd Σ cd ->
  forall X, X `notin` dom Σ -> X `notin` ftvar_in_contd cd.
Proof.
  intros Σ cd H. apply (proj2 (tw_conts_contd_ftvar_mut Σ)); exact H.
Qed.

Proof.

Qed.

    + exact (tw_contd_ftvar_notin Σ cd Hcd X HX Hc).

    apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in Hc as [Hc|Hc].
    + exact (a_wf_typ_arrow_ftvar_notin1 Σ A B X H1 HX Hc).
    + apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in Hc as [Hc|Hc].
      * exact (a_wf_typ_arrow_ftvar_notin2 Σ A B X H1 HX Hc).
      * apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in Hc as [Hc|Hc].

    + apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in Hc as [Hc|Hc].
      * exact (a_wf_typ_ftvar_notin Σ A2 X H2 HX Hc).

    - intros cd IH Htw X HX. simpl in Htw. simpl. exact (IH Htw X HX).
    - intros A cs IH Htw X HX. simpl in Htw. destruct Htw as [H1 H2].
      simpl. intro Hc. apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in Hc as [Hc|Hc].
      + exact (a_wf_typ_ftvar_notin Σ A X H1 HX Hc).
      + exact (IH H2 X HX Hc).
    - intros A1 A2 cs IH Htw X HX. simpl in Htw. destruct Htw as [H1 [H2 H3]].
      simpl. intro Hc. apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in Hc as [Hc|Hc].

Lemma binds_rn_tvar_same : forall Y Z Ψ,
  binds Y dbind_tvar_empty Ψ -> binds Z dbind_tvar_empty (rn_denv Y Z Ψ).
Proof.
  intros Y Z Ψ. induction Ψ as [|[W bk] Ψ IH]; intros Hb.
  - apply binds_nil_iff in Hb. contradiction.
  - simpl in Hb. rewrite binds_cons_iff in Hb. destruct Hb as [[e hb]|Hb].
    + subst W. subst bk. simpl. rewrite binds_cons_iff. left. split.

        exfalso. apply e. reflexivity.
      * reflexivity.
    + simpl. rewrite binds_cons_iff. right. apply IH; exact Hb.
Qed.

(* ---------- one-way renaming of a fresh term variable ---------- *)
Definition rn_ename (x y X : expvar) (b : dbind) : expvar :=
  match b with
  | dbind_typ _ => if eq_var X x then y else X
  | _ => X
  end.

Fixpoint rn_eden (x y : expvar) (Ψ : denv) : denv :=
  match Ψ with
  | nil => nil
  | (X,b) :: Ψ' => (rn_ename x y X b, b) :: rn_eden x y Ψ'
  end.

Definition rne (x y : expvar) (e : exp) : exp :=
  subst_exp_in_exp (exp_var_f y) x e.

Lemma rn_eden_cons_typ_other : forall x y X A Ψ,
  X <> x ->
  rn_eden x y ((X, dbind_typ A) :: Ψ) =
  (X, dbind_typ A) :: rn_eden x y Ψ.
Proof.
  intros. simpl.
  match goal with |- context [if ?d then _ else _] => destruct d as [e|e] end.
  - exfalso. apply H. exact e.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma rn_eden_cons_typ_same : forall x y A Ψ,

Lemma Arel_strip : forall s Σ X b,
  X `notin` dom Σ ->
  (forall Y, binds Y (abind_etvar_empty) Σ ->
      X `notin` ftvar_in_typ (tsubst_typ s (typ_var_f Y))) ->
  Arel s (X ~ b ++ Σ) (aenv_to_denv s (X ~ b ++ Σ)) ->
  Arel s Σ (aenv_to_denv s Σ).
Proof.
  intros s Σ X b Hdom Hfresh H.
  destruct b.
  - (* tvar *) simpl in *.
    destruct H as [Hnb [Ht [Hs [He [Hin [Hft [Hfs Hv]]]]]]].
    unfold Arel. repeat split.
    + exact Hnb.
    + intros Y Hb.
      assert (Hb' : binds Y (dbind_tvar_empty) (X ~ dbind_tvar_empty ++ aenv_to_denv s Σ)).
      { apply Ht. apply binds_cons_3; auto. }
      eapply binds_cons_strip with (X := X); [intro e; subst; apply Hdom; apply binds_in_dom with (a := abind_tvar_empty); auto | exact Hb'].
    + intros Y Hb.
      assert (Hb' : binds Y (dbind_stvar_empty) (X ~ dbind_tvar_empty ++ aenv_to_denv s Σ)).
      { apply Hs. apply binds_cons_3; auto. }
      eapply binds_cons_strip with (X := X); [intro e; subst; apply Hdom; apply binds_in_dom with (a := abind_stvar_empty); auto | exact Hb'].

    + intros Y Hb. apply Hin. apply binds_cons_3; auto.

      apply Hfs in Hb'. unfold fresh_sigma in *. intro Hin2. apply Hb'. simpl; auto.
    + intros x A Hb.

Lemma denv_stvars_nil_stvar_free : forall Ψ,
  stvar_free Ψ -> denv_stvars Ψ = nil.
Proof.
  intros Ψ H. induction Ψ as [|[X b] Ψ IH]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct b; simpl in *.
    + exact IH.
    + exfalso. apply (H X). constructor. reflexivity.
    + exact IH.
Qed.

Lemma denv_nonstvars_id_stvar_free : forall Ψ,
  stvar_free Ψ -> denv_nonstvars Ψ = Ψ.
Proof.
  intros Ψ H. induction Ψ as [|[X b] Ψ IH]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct b; simpl in *.
    + rewrite IH; reflexivity.
    + exfalso. apply (H X). constructor. reflexivity.
    + rewrite IH; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma norm_denv_stvar_free : forall Ψ,
  stvar_free Ψ -> norm_denv Ψ = Ψ.
Proof.
  intros Ψ H. unfold norm_denv.
  rewrite denv_stvars_nil_stvar_free; auto.
  rewrite denv_nonstvars_id_stvar_free; auto.
Qed.

Lemma d_chk_inf_to_tc : forall Ψ e m A,
  stvar_free Ψ -> d_chk_inf Ψ e m A -> d_chk_inf_tc Ψ e m A.
Proof.
  intros Ψ e m A Hsf H.
  revert Hsf. induction H as
    [ Ψ0 x0 A0 Htenv Hbind
    | Ψ0 e0 A0 HA Hchk IHchk
    | Ψ0 Htenv
    | Ψ0 e1 e2 A0 B0 C0 Hinf IHinf Hinfabs Hchk2 IHchk2
    | L Ψ0 e0 A0 B0 Hmono Hbody IHbody
    | L Ψ0 e0 A0 Hs Hbody IHbody
    | Ψ0 e1 A0 B0 C0 HB Hinf IHinf Hinftapp
    | L Ψ0 e0 Hbody IHbody
    | L Ψ0 e0 A1 A2 HA Hbody IHbody
    | Ψ0 e0 A0 B0 Hinf IHinf Hsub
    | Ψ0 e0 A1 A2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
    | Ψ0 e0 A1 A2 H1 IH1 HA2
    | Ψ0 e0 A1 A2 H2 IH2 HA1 ];
    intros Hsf.
  all: try (eauto using d_chk_inf_tc__inf_var, d_chk_inf_tc__inf_anno,
            d_chk_inf_tc__inf_unit, d_chk_inf_tc__inf_app,
