Inductive dwl_tc : dworklist -> Prop :=
  | dwl_tc__empty : dwl_tc dworklist_empty
  | dwl_tc__var : forall Ω x b,
      dwl_tc Ω -> dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_var Ω x b)
  | dwl_tc__chk : forall Ω e A,
      d_chk_inf_tc (dwl_to_denv Ω) e typingmode__chk A ->
      dwl_tc Ω -> dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_check e A))
  | dwl_tc__inf : forall Ω e A cs,
      d_chk_inf_tc (dwl_to_denv Ω) e typingmode__inf A ->
      dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_applys cs A)) ->
      dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_infer e cs))
  | dwl_tc__infabs : forall Ω A B C cd,
      d_infabs (dwl_to_denv Ω) A B C ->
      dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_applyd cd B C)) ->
      dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_infabs A cd))
  | dwl_tc__infabsunion : forall Ω A2 B1 B2 C1 C2 cd,
      d_infabs (dwl_to_denv Ω) A2 B2 C2 ->
      dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_applyd cd (typ_intersection B1 B2) (typ_union C1 C2))) ->
      dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_infabsunion B1 C1 A2 cd))
  | dwl_tc__unioninfabs : forall Ω B1 B2 C1 C2 cd,
      dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_applyd cd (typ_intersection B1 B2) (typ_union C1 C2))) ->
      dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_unioninfabs B1 C1 B2 C2 cd))
  | dwl_tc__infapp : forall Ω e A B cs,
      dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_applys cs B)) (work_check e A)) ->
      dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_infapp A B e cs))
  | dwl_tc__inftapp : forall Ω A B C cs,
      d_inftapp (dwl_to_denv Ω) A B C ->
      dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_applys cs C)) ->
      dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_inftapp A B cs))
  | dwl_tc__inftappunion : forall Ω A2 B2 C1 C2 cs,
      d_inftapp (dwl_to_denv Ω) A2 B2 C2 ->
      dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_applys cs (typ_union C1 C2))) ->
      dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_inftappunion C1 A2 B2 cs))
  | dwl_tc__unioninftapp : forall Ω A1 A2 cs,
      dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_applys cs (typ_union A1 A2))) ->
      dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_unioninftapp A1 A2 cs))
  | dwl_tc__sub : forall Ω A B,
      d_sub_tc_env (dwl_to_denv Ω) A B ->
      dwl_tc Ω -> dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_sub A B))
  | dwl_tc__applys : forall Ω cs A w,
      apply_conts cs A w ->
      dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω w) ->
      dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_applys cs A))
  | dwl_tc__applyd : forall Ω cd A B w,
      apply_contd cd A B w ->
      dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω w) ->
      dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_applyd cd A B)).

Definition d_work_sem_tc (Ψ : denv) (w : work) : Prop :=
  dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work (denv_to_dwl Ψ) w).

Fixpoint SEM_tc (s : list (typvar * typ)) (Γ : aworklist) : Prop :=
  match Γ with
  | aworklist_empty => True
  | aworklist_cons_var Γ' _ _ => SEM_tc s Γ'
  | aworklist_cons_work Γ' w =>
      d_work_sem_tc (norm_denv (aenv_to_denv s (awl_to_aenv Γ'))) (tsubst_work s w)
      /\ SEM_tc s Γ'
  end.

Lemma SEM_tc_cons_var : forall s Γ X b,
  SEM_tc s (aworklist_cons_var Γ X b) <-> SEM_tc s Γ.
Proof. intros. simpl. tauto. Qed.

Lemma SEM_tc_cons_work : forall s Γ w,
  SEM_tc s (aworklist_cons_work Γ w) <->
  d_work_sem_tc (norm_denv (aenv_to_denv s (awl_to_aenv Γ))) (tsubst_work s w)
  /\ SEM_tc s Γ.
Proof. intros. simpl. tauto. Qed.
EOF

Lemma denv_stvars_app : forall Ψ1 Ψ2,
  denv_stvars (Ψ1 ++ Ψ2) = denv_stvars Ψ1 ++ denv_stvars Ψ2.
Proof.
  intros Ψ1. induction Ψ1 as [|[X b] Ψ1 IH]; intros Ψ2; simpl.

Lemma denv_nonstvars_app : forall Ψ1 Ψ2,

  intros Ψ1. induction Ψ1 as [|[X b] Ψ1 IH]; intros Ψ2; simpl.

Lemma denv_stvars_stvars : forall Ψ,

Definition Arel (s : list (typvar * typ)) (Σ : aenv) (Ψ : denv) : Prop :=
  nb_sigma s /\
  (forall X, binds X (abind_tvar_empty) Σ -> binds X (dbind_tvar_empty) Ψ) /\
  (forall X, binds X (abind_stvar_empty) Σ -> binds X (dbind_stvar_empty) Ψ) /\
  (forall X, binds X (abind_etvar_empty) Σ -> d_mono_typ Ψ (tsubst_typ s (typ_var_f X))) /\
  (forall X, binds X (abind_etvar_empty) Σ -> In X (names s)) /\
  (forall X, binds X (abind_tvar_empty) Σ -> fresh_sigma X s) /\
  (forall X, binds X (abind_stvar_empty) Σ -> fresh_sigma X s) /\
  (forall x A, binds x (abind_var_typ A) Σ -> binds x (dbind_typ (tsubst_typ s A)) Ψ).

  - intros Y Hb. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].

Definition names_set (s : list (typvar * typ)) : atoms :=
  fold_right AtomSetImpl.add AtomSetImpl.empty (names s).

Lemma notin_names_set : forall s X,
  X `notin` names_set s -> ~ In X (names s).
Proof.
  intros s. induction s as [|[Y T] s IH]; intros X H Hin.
  - simpl in Hin. contradiction.
  - simpl in H, Hin.
    assert (Hne : X <> Y) by (intro; subst; apply H; apply AtomSetImpl.add_1; reflexivity).
    assert (Hnot : X `notin` names_set s) by (intro Hc; apply H; apply AtomSetImpl.add_2; auto).
    destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
    + subst. apply Hne; reflexivity.
    + exact (IH X Hnot Hin).
Qed.

Definition NSINV_tc (s : list (typvar * typ)) (Γ : aworklist) : Prop :=

Definition NSOUND_tc (Γ : aworklist) : Prop :=

Proof. intros s Γ [_ [_ [H _]]]. exact H. Qed.

  - unfold nb_sigma. intros X T H. simpl in H. contradiction.

(* ---------- environment correspondence under a substitution ---------- *)
Definition Arel (s : list (typvar * typ)) (Σ : aenv) (Ψ : denv) : Prop :=
  nb_sigma s /\
  (forall X, binds X (abind_tvar_empty) Σ -> binds X (dbind_tvar_empty) Ψ) /\
  (forall X, binds X (abind_stvar_empty) Σ -> binds X (dbind_stvar_empty) Ψ) /\
  (forall X, binds X (abind_etvar_empty) Σ -> d_mono_typ Ψ (tsubst_typ s (typ_var_f X))) /\
  (forall X, binds X (abind_etvar_empty) Σ -> In X (names s)) /\
  (forall X, binds X (abind_tvar_empty) Σ -> fresh_sigma X s) /\
  (forall X, binds X (abind_stvar_empty) Σ -> fresh_sigma X s) /\
  (forall x A, binds x (abind_var_typ A) Σ -> binds x (dbind_typ (tsubst_typ s A)) Ψ).

Lemma d_mono_typ_cons : forall Ψ A Z b,
  d_mono_typ Ψ A -> d_mono_typ (Z ~ b ++ Ψ) A.
Proof.
  intros Ψ A Z b H. induction H.
  - constructor.
  - constructor. apply binds_cons_3; auto.
  - constructor; auto.
Qed.

Lemma Arel_tvar_ext : forall s Σ Ψ X,
  Arel s Σ Ψ -> fresh_sigma X s ->
  Arel s (X ~ abind_tvar_empty ++ Σ) (X ~ dbind_tvar_empty ++ Ψ).
Proof.
  intros s Σ Ψ X [Hnb [Ht [Hs [He [Hin [Hft [Hfs Hv]]]]]]] Hf.
  unfold Arel. repeat split.
  - exact Hnb.
  - intros Y Hb. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. apply binds_cons_2; auto.
    + apply binds_cons_3; auto.
  - intros Y Hb. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. discriminate e2.
    + apply binds_cons_3; auto.
  - intros Y Hb. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. discriminate e2.
    + apply d_mono_typ_cons. apply He; auto.
  - intros Y Hb. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. discriminate e2.
    + apply Hin; auto.
  - intros Y Hb. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. auto.
    + apply Hft; auto.
  - intros Y Hb. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. discriminate e2.
    + apply Hfs; auto.
  - intros x A Hb. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. discriminate e2.
    + apply binds_cons_3. apply Hv; auto.
Qed.

Lemma Arel_var_ext : forall s Σ Ψ x A,
  Arel s Σ Ψ ->
  Arel s (x ~ abind_var_typ A ++ Σ) (x ~ dbind_typ (tsubst_typ s A) ++ Ψ).

Definition names_set (s : list (typvar * typ)) : atoms :=
  fold_right AtomSetImpl.add AtomSetImpl.empty (names s).

Lemma notin_names_set : forall s X,
  X `notin` names_set s -> ~ In X (names s).
Proof.
  intros s. induction s as [|[Y T] s IH]; intros X H Hin.
  - simpl in Hin. contradiction.
  - simpl in H, Hin.
    assert (Hne : X <> Y) by (intro; subst; apply H; apply AtomSetImpl.add_1; reflexivity).
    assert (Hnot : X `notin` names_set s) by (intro Hc; apply H; apply AtomSetImpl.add_2; auto).
    destruct Hin as [Hin|Hin].
    + subst. apply Hne; reflexivity.
    + exact (IH X Hnot Hin).
Qed.

Definition Pwf (Σ : aenv) (A : typ) : Prop :=
  forall s Ψ, Arel s Σ Ψ -> d_wf_typ Ψ (tsubst_typ s A).

Lemma binds_decomp : forall (A : Type) (E : list (atom * A)) x a,
  binds x a E -> exists E1 b E2, E = E1 ++ (x,b) :: E2 /\ a = b.
Proof.
  intros A E. induction E as [|[y b] E IH]; intros x a Hb.

Lemma tsubst_var_notin_of_dmono : forall s Σ X b Y,
  X `notin` dom Σ ->
  b <> abind_tvar_empty ->
  binds Y (abind_etvar_empty) Σ ->
  d_mono_typ (aenv_to_denv s (X ~ b ++ Σ)) (tsubst_typ s (typ_var_f Y)) ->
  X `notin` ftvar_in_typ (tsubst_typ s (typ_var_f Y)).
Proof.
  intros s Σ X b Y Hdom Hnt HY Hdm Hin.
  assert (Hbinds : binds X (dbind_tvar_empty) (aenv_to_denv s (X ~ b ++ Σ)))
    by (apply d_mono_typ_ftvar with (T := tsubst_typ s (typ_var_f Y)); auto).
  apply binds_tvar_aenv_to_denv_inv in Hbinds.
  apply binds_cons_1 in Hbinds as [[e1 e2]|Hbinds].
  - subst. exfalso. apply Hnt. auto.
  - apply Hdom. apply binds_in_dom with (a := abind_tvar_empty). exact Hbinds.
Qed.

Lemma Arel_strip_scoped : forall s Σ X b,
  X `notin` dom Σ ->
  sigma_keys_in_env s (X ~ b ++ Σ) ->
  tvar_scope_ok s (X ~ b ++ Σ) ->
  Arel s (X ~ b ++ Σ) (aenv_to_denv s (X ~ b ++ Σ)) ->
  Arel s Σ (aenv_to_denv s Σ).
Proof.
  intros s Σ X b Hdom Hkey Hscope HA.
  unfold sigma_keys_in_env in Hkey.
  unfold tvar_scope_ok in Hscope.
  apply Arel_strip with (X := X) (b := b); auto.
  intros Y HY.
  destruct HA as [Hnb [Ht [Hs [He [Hin [Hft [Hfs Hv]]]]]]].
  destruct b.
  { (* tvar *)
    assert (Hfx : fresh_sigma X s).
    { apply Hft. apply binds_cons_2; auto. }
    assert (Hvals : forall Z T, In (Z,T) s -> X `notin` ftvar_in_typ T).
    { intros Z T HinZ.
      assert (HbZbig : binds Z (abind_etvar_empty) (X ~ abind_tvar_empty ++ Σ))
        by (exact (Hkey Z T HinZ)).
      assert (HbZ : binds Z (abind_etvar_empty) Σ).
      { apply binds_cons_1 in HbZbig as [[e1 e2]|HbZbig].
        { subst. discriminate e2. }
        { exact HbZbig. } }
      assert (Hbefore : before_bind (X ~ abind_tvar_empty ++ Σ) X Z).
      { destruct (binds_decomp _ _ _ _ HbZ) as [E1 [bz [E2 [Heq Ha]]]].
        exists ((X, abind_tvar_empty) :: E1), bz, E2.
        split.
        { simpl. rewrite Heq. reflexivity. }
        { simpl. left. reflexivity. } }
      apply (Hscope Z T HinZ HbZbig X).
      { apply binds_cons_2; reflexivity. }
      { exact Hbefore. } }
    assert (HYnot : X `notin` ftvar_in_typ (typ_var_f Y)).
    { intro Hi. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_1 in Hi. subst.
      apply Hdom. apply binds_in_dom with (a := abind_etvar_empty). exact HY. }
    exact (tsubst_typ_notin s (typ_var_f Y) X Hfx Hvals HYnot). }
  { (* stvar *) apply tsubst_var_notin_of_dmono with (Σ := Σ) (b := abind_stvar_empty) (Y := Y).
    - exact Hdom.
    - intro e; discriminate e.
    - exact HY.
    - apply He. apply binds_cons_3. exact HY. }
  { (* etvar *) apply tsubst_var_notin_of_dmono with (Σ := Σ) (b := abind_etvar_empty) (Y := Y).
    - exact Hdom.
    - intro e; discriminate e.
    - exact HY.
    - apply He. apply binds_cons_3. exact HY. }
  { (* var *) apply tsubst_var_notin_of_dmono with (Σ := Σ) (b := abind_var_typ A) (Y := Y).
    - exact Hdom.
    - intro e; discriminate e.
    - exact HY.
    - apply He. apply binds_cons_3. exact HY. }
Qed.

(* ---------- proof invariant including substitution scoping ---------- *)
Definition PINV (s : list (typvar * typ)) (Γ : aworklist) : Prop :=
  nb_sigma s /\ full_arel s Γ /\
  sigma_keys_in_env s (awl_to_aenv Γ) /\
  tvar_scope_ok s (awl_to_aenv Γ) /\

(* [tshape] is threaded separately through the induction; it is the
   syntactic side condition that licenses construction of well-formed
   declarative environments. *)
Definition PSOUND (Γ : aworklist) : Prop :=
  twf Γ -> tshape Γ -> exists s, PINV s Γ.

Lemma PINV_nb : forall s Γ, PINV s Γ -> nb_sigma s.
Proof. intros s Γ [H _]. exact H. Qed.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.
Require Import Program.Tactics.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import List.
Require Import Lia.
Require Import uni.notations.
Require Import uni.algo_worklist.def_extra.
Open Scope aworklist_scope.
Open Scope dworklist_scope.

(* ---------- substitution of type variables by types ---------- *)
Fixpoint tsubst_typ (s : list (typvar * typ)) (A : typ) : typ :=
  match s with
  | nil => A
  | (X, T) :: s' => tsubst_typ s' (subst_typ_in_typ T X A)
  end.

Fixpoint tsubst_exp (s : list (typvar * typ)) (e : exp) : exp :=
  match s with
  | nil => e
  | (X, T) :: s' => tsubst_exp s' (subst_typ_in_exp T X e)
  end.

Fixpoint tsubst_conts (s : list (typvar * typ)) (cs : conts) : conts :=
  match s with
  | nil => cs
  | (X, T) :: s' => tsubst_conts s' (subst_typ_in_conts T X cs)
  end
with tsubst_contd (s : list (typvar * typ)) (cd : contd) : contd :=
  match s with
  | nil => cd
  | (X, T) :: s' => tsubst_contd s' (subst_typ_in_contd T X cd)
  end.

Fixpoint tsubst_work (s : list (typvar * typ)) (w : work) : work :=
  match s with
  | nil => w
  | (X, T) :: s' => tsubst_work s' (subst_typ_in_work T X w)
  end.

Fixpoint tsubst_abind (s : list (typvar * typ)) (b : abind) : abind :=
  match s with
  | nil => b
  | (X, T) :: s' => tsubst_abind s' (subst_typ_in_abind T X b)
  end.

Fixpoint aenv_to_denv (s : list (typvar * typ)) (E : aenv) {struct E} : denv :=
  match E with
  | nil => nil
  | (X, abind_tvar_empty) :: E' => X ~ dbind_tvar_empty ++ aenv_to_denv s E'
  | (X, abind_stvar_empty) :: E' => X ~ dbind_stvar_empty ++ aenv_to_denv s E'
  | (X, abind_etvar_empty) :: E' => aenv_to_denv s E'
  | (X, abind_var_typ A) :: E' => X ~ dbind_typ (tsubst_typ s A) ++ aenv_to_denv s E'
  end.

Fixpoint dropv (X : typvar) (s : list (typvar * typ)) : list (typvar * typ) :=
  match s with
  | nil => nil
  | (Y, T) :: s' => if eq_var Y X then dropv X s' else (Y, T) :: dropv X s' end.

Fixpoint names (s : list (typvar * typ)) : list typvar :=
  match s with nil => nil | (X,_)::s' => X :: names s' end.

Definition fresh_sigma (X : typvar) (s : list (typvar * typ)) : Prop :=
  ~ In X (names s).

Lemma aenv_to_denv_app : forall s E1 E2,
  aenv_to_denv s (E1 ++ E2) = aenv_to_denv s E1 ++ aenv_to_denv s E2.
Proof.
  intros s E1. induction E1 as [| [X b] E1 IH]; intros E2; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct b; simpl; rewrite IH; reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ---------- tsubst is a homomorphism on non-variable constructors ---------- *)
Lemma tsubst_unit : forall s, tsubst_typ s typ_unit = typ_unit.
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma tsubst_top : forall s, tsubst_typ s typ_top = typ_top.
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma tsubst_bot : forall s, tsubst_typ s typ_bot = typ_bot.
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma tsubst_varb : forall s n, tsubst_typ s (typ_var_b n) = typ_var_b n.
Proof. intros s n. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma tsubst_arrow : forall s A1 A2,
  tsubst_typ s (typ_arrow A1 A2) =
  typ_arrow (tsubst_typ s A1) (tsubst_typ s A2).
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; intros A1 A2; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma tsubst_all : forall s A,
  tsubst_typ s (typ_all A) = typ_all (tsubst_typ s A).
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; intros A; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma tsubst_union : forall s A1 A2,
  tsubst_typ s (typ_union A1 A2) =
  typ_union (tsubst_typ s A1) (tsubst_typ s A2).
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; intros A1 A2; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma tsubst_inter : forall s A1 A2,
  tsubst_typ s (typ_intersection A1 A2) =
  typ_intersection (tsubst_typ s A1) (tsubst_typ s A2).
Proof. intros s. induction s as [|[X T] s IH]; intros A1 A2; simpl; auto. Qed.

Lemma tsubst_var_fresh : forall s X,
  fresh_sigma X s -> tsubst_typ s (typ_var_f X) = typ_var_f X.
Proof.
  intros s X H. induction s as [|[Y T] s IH]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - simpl in H. assert (Hne : Y <> X) by (intro; subst; apply H; simpl; auto).
    destruct (eq_var X Y) as [e|e]; simpl.
    + exfalso; apply Hne; auto.
    + rewrite IH.
      * reflexivity.
      * intros Hin. apply H. simpl; auto.
Qed.

(* ---------- types with no de Bruijn variables ---------- *)
Fixpoint no_bvar (A : typ) : Prop :=
  match A with
  | typ_unit => True
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_bot => True
  | typ_var_b _ => False
  | typ_var_f _ => True
  | typ_arrow A1 A2 => no_bvar A1 /\ no_bvar A2
  | typ_all A => no_bvar A
  | typ_union A1 A2 => no_bvar A1 /\ no_bvar A2
  | typ_intersection A1 A2 => no_bvar A1 /\ no_bvar A2
  end.

Lemma no_bvar_open_rec : forall A k R, no_bvar A -> open_typ_wrt_typ_rec k R A = A.
Proof.
  intros A. induction A as [| | | n | X | A1 IH1 A2 IH2 | A0 IH0 | A1 IH1 A2 IH2 | A1 IH1 A2 IH2];
    intros k R H; simpl in *.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct H.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. rewrite IH1; auto. rewrite IH2; auto.
  - rewrite IH0; auto.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. rewrite IH1; auto. rewrite IH2; auto.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. rewrite IH1; auto. rewrite IH2; auto.
Qed.

Lemma no_bvar_subst : forall T Y A,
  no_bvar T -> no_bvar A -> no_bvar (subst_typ_in_typ T Y A).
Proof.
  intros T Y A HT. induction A as [| | | n | X | A1 IH1 A2 IH2 | A0 IH0 | A1 IH1 A2 IH2 | A1 IH1 A2 IH2];
    intros HA; simpl in *.
  - constructor.
  - constructor.
  - constructor.
  - destruct HA.
  - destruct (eq_var X Y); simpl; auto.
  - destruct HA as [H1 H2]. constructor.
    + apply IH1; auto.
    + apply IH2; auto.
  - apply IH0; auto.
  - destruct HA as [H1 H2]. constructor.
    + apply IH1; auto.
    + apply IH2; auto.
  - destruct HA as [H1 H2]. constructor.
    + apply IH1; auto.

(* ---------- types with no de Bruijn variables ---------- *)
Fixpoint no_bvar (A : typ) : Prop :=
  match A with
  | typ_unit => True
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_bot => True
  | typ_var_b _ => False
  | typ_var_f _ => True
  | typ_arrow A1 A2 => no_bvar A1 /\ no_bvar A2
  | typ_all A => no_bvar A
  | typ_union A1 A2 => no_bvar A1 /\ no_bvar A2
  | typ_intersection A1 A2 => no_bvar A1 /\ no_bvar A2
  end.

  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. rewrite IH1; auto. rewrite IH2; auto.
  - rewrite IH0; auto.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. rewrite IH1; auto. rewrite IH2; auto.

Inductive d_sub : denv -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
  | d_sub__top : forall (Ψ:denv) (A:typ),
      d_wf_env Ψ ->
      d_wf_typ Ψ A ->
      d_sub Ψ A typ_top
  | d_sub__bot : forall (Ψ:denv) (B:typ),
      d_wf_env Ψ ->
      d_wf_typ Ψ B ->
      d_sub Ψ typ_bot B
  | d_sub__unit : forall (Ψ:denv),
      d_wf_env Ψ ->
      d_sub Ψ typ_unit typ_unit
  | d_sub__tvar : forall (Ψ:denv) (X:typvar),
      d_wf_env Ψ ->
      d_wf_typ Ψ (typ_var_f X) ->
      d_sub Ψ (typ_var_f X) (typ_var_f X)
  | d_sub__arrow : forall (Ψ:denv) (A1 A2 B1 B2:typ),
      d_sub Ψ B1 A1 ->
      d_sub Ψ A2 B2 ->
      d_sub Ψ (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
  | d_sub__all : forall (L:vars) (Ψ:denv) (A B:typ),
      ( forall X , X \notin  L  -> s_in X  ( open_typ_wrt_typ A (typ_var_f X) )  )  ->
      ( forall X , X \notin  L  -> s_in X  ( open_typ_wrt_typ B (typ_var_f X) )  )  ->
      ( forall X , X \notin  L  -> d_sub  ( X ~ dbind_stvar_empty  ++  Ψ )   ( open_typ_wrt_typ A (typ_var_f X) )   ( open_typ_wrt_typ B (typ_var_f X) )  )  ->
      d_sub Ψ (typ_all A) (typ_all B)
  | d_sub__alll : forall (L:vars) (Ψ:denv) (A B T:typ),
      d_wneq_all Ψ B ->
      ( forall X , X \notin  L  -> s_in X  ( open_typ_wrt_typ A (typ_var_f X) )  )  ->
      d_mono_typ Ψ T ->
      d_sub Ψ  (open_typ_wrt_typ  A   T )  B ->
      d_sub Ψ (typ_all A) B
  | d_sub__intersection1 : forall (Ψ:denv) (A B1 B2:typ),
      d_sub Ψ A B1 ->
      d_sub Ψ A B2 ->
      d_sub Ψ A (typ_intersection B1 B2)
  | d_sub__intersection2 : forall (Ψ:denv) (A1 A2 B:typ),
      d_sub Ψ A1 B ->
      d_wf_typ Ψ A2 ->
      d_sub Ψ (typ_intersection A1 A2) B
  | d_sub__intersection3 : forall (Ψ:denv) (A1 A2 B:typ),
      d_sub Ψ A2 B ->
      d_wf_typ Ψ A1 ->
      d_sub Ψ (typ_intersection A1 A2) B
  | d_sub__union1 : forall (Ψ:denv) (A B1 B2:typ),
      d_sub Ψ A B1 ->
      d_wf_typ Ψ B2 ->
      d_sub Ψ A (typ_union B1 B2)
  | d_sub__union2 : forall (Ψ:denv) (A B1 B2:typ),
      d_sub Ψ A B2 ->
      d_wf_typ Ψ B1 ->
      d_sub Ψ A (typ_union B1 B2)
  | d_sub__union3 : forall (Ψ:denv) (A1 A2 B:typ),
      d_sub Ψ A1 B ->
      d_sub Ψ A2 B ->
      d_sub Ψ (typ_union A1 A2) B.

Definition stvar_free (Ψ : denv) : Prop :=
  forall X, binds X (dbind_stvar_empty) Ψ -> False.

Lemma d_wf_env_tenv : forall Ψ, d_wf_env Ψ -> stvar_free Ψ -> d_wf_tenv Ψ.
Proof.
  intros Ψ H. induction H as [Ψ Htenv | Ψ X Hwf Hfresh IH].
  - intros _. exact Htenv.
  - intros Hfree. exfalso. apply (Hfree X). constructor. reflexivity.
Qed.

Require Import Bool.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import List.

Require Import uni.prop_ln.

Require Export uni.def_ott.

Require Export uni.decl_worklist.def.

Fixpoint awl_app (Γ1 Γ2 : aworklist) :=
  match Γ1 with
    | aworklist_empty => Γ2
    | aworklist_cons_var Γ1' X b => aworklist_cons_var (awl_app Γ1' Γ2) X b
    | aworklist_cons_work Γ1' w => aworklist_cons_work (awl_app Γ1' Γ2) w
  end.

Inductive aworklist_subst : aworklist -> typvar -> typ -> aworklist -> aworklist -> Prop :=
  | a_ws__stop : forall Γ X A ,
      aworklist_subst (aworklist_cons_var Γ X (abind_etvar_empty)) X A Γ aworklist_empty
  | a_ws__var_stay : forall Γ X Y A B Γ1 Γ2,
      aworklist_subst Γ X A Γ1 Γ2 ->
      aworklist_subst (aworklist_cons_var Γ Y (abind_var_typ B)) X A Γ1 (aworklist_cons_var Γ2 Y (abind_var_typ B))
  | a_ws__tvar_stay : forall Γ X Y A Γ1 Γ2,
      aworklist_subst Γ X A Γ1 Γ2 ->
      Y <> X ->
      Y `notin` ftvar_in_typ A ->
      aworklist_subst (aworklist_cons_var Γ Y (abind_tvar_empty)) X A Γ1 (aworklist_cons_var Γ2 Y (abind_tvar_empty))
  | a_ws__stvar_stay : forall Γ X Y A Γ1 Γ2,
      aworklist_subst Γ X A Γ1 Γ2 ->
      Y <> X ->
      Y `notin` ftvar_in_typ A ->
      aworklist_subst (aworklist_cons_var Γ Y (abind_stvar_empty)) X A Γ1 (aworklist_cons_var Γ2 Y (abind_stvar_empty))
  | a_ws__work_stay : forall Γ X A w Γ1 Γ2,
      aworklist_subst Γ X A Γ1 Γ2 ->
      aworklist_subst (aworklist_cons_work Γ w) X A  Γ1 (aworklist_cons_work Γ2 w)
  | a_ws__etvar_stay : forall Γ X Y A Γ1 Γ2,
      aworklist_subst Γ X A Γ1 Γ2 ->
      Y <> X ->
      Y `notin` ftvar_in_typ A ->
      aworklist_subst (aworklist_cons_var Γ Y (abind_etvar_empty)) X A Γ1 (aworklist_cons_var Γ2 Y (abind_etvar_empty))
  | a_ws__etvar_move : forall Γ1 Γ2 X Y A  Γ'1 Γ'2,
      aworklist_subst (awl_app Γ2 (aworklist_cons_var (aworklist_cons_var Γ1 Y abind_etvar_empty) X abind_etvar_empty)) X A Γ'1 Γ'2 ->
      Y <> X ->
      Y `in` ftvar_in_typ A ->
      aworklist_subst (aworklist_cons_var (awl_app Γ2 (aworklist_cons_var Γ1 X abind_etvar_empty)) Y (abind_etvar_empty)) X A Γ'1 Γ'2.

Inductive a_wl_red : aworklist -> Prop :=
  | a_wl_red__empty : a_wl_red aworklist_empty
  | a_wl_red__gc_var : forall (Γ:aworklist) (X:typvar) (b:abind),
      a_wl_red Γ ->
      a_wl_red (aworklist_cons_var Γ X b)
  | a_wl_red__sub_top : forall (Γ:aworklist) (B1:typ),
      a_wl_red Γ ->
      a_wl_red (aworklist_cons_work Γ (work_sub B1 typ_top))
  | a_wl_red__sub_bot : forall (Γ:aworklist) (A:typ),
      a_wl_red Γ ->
      a_wl_red (aworklist_cons_work Γ (work_sub typ_bot A))
  | a_wl_red__sub_unit : forall (Γ:aworklist),
      a_wl_red Γ ->
      a_wl_red (aworklist_cons_work Γ (work_sub typ_unit typ_unit))
  | a_wl_red__sub_tvar : forall (Γ:aworklist) (X:typvar),
      a_wl_red Γ ->
      a_wl_red (aworklist_cons_work Γ (work_sub (typ_var_f X) (typ_var_f X)))
  | a_wl_red__subarrow : forall (Γ:aworklist) (B1 B2 A1 A2:typ),
      a_wl_red (aworklist_cons_work (aworklist_cons_work Γ (work_sub A1 B1)) (work_sub B2 A2)) ->
      a_wl_red (aworklist_cons_work Γ (work_sub (typ_arrow B1 B2) (typ_arrow A1 A2)))
  | a_wl_red__sub_alll : forall (L:vars) (Γ:aworklist) (B1 A1:typ),
      a_wneq_all (awl_to_aenv Γ) A1 ->
      ( forall X , X \notin  L  -> a_wl_red (aworklist_cons_work (aworklist_cons_var Γ X abind_etvar_empty) (work_sub  ( open_typ_wrt_typ B1 (typ_var_f X) )  A1)) )  ->
      a_wl_red (aworklist_cons_work Γ (work_sub (typ_all B1) A1))
  | a_wl_red__sub_all : forall (L:vars) (Γ:aworklist) (B1 A1:typ),
      ( forall X , X \notin  L  -> a_wl_red (aworklist_cons_work (aworklist_cons_var Γ X abind_stvar_empty) (work_sub  ( open_typ_wrt_typ B1 (typ_var_f X) )   ( open_typ_wrt_typ A1 (typ_var_f X) ) )) )  ->
      a_wl_red (aworklist_cons_work Γ (work_sub (typ_all B1) (typ_all A1)))
  | a_wl_red__sub_arrow1 : forall (L:vars) (Γ:aworklist) (X:typvar) (A1 A2:typ),
      binds ( X )  ( abind_etvar_empty ) (  ( awl_to_aenv  Γ  )  )  ->
      ( a_mono_typ   ( awl_to_aenv  Γ  )     ( (typ_arrow A1 A2) )   -> False )  ->
      (forall X1, X1 `notin` L -> forall X2, X2 `notin` (L `union` singleton X1) -> forall Γ1 Γ2,
      (aworklist_subst (aworklist_cons_work (aworklist_cons_var (aworklist_cons_var Γ X1 abind_etvar_empty) X2 abind_etvar_empty) (work_sub (typ_var_f X) (typ_arrow A1 A2))) X (typ_arrow (typ_var_f X1) (typ_var_f X2)) Γ1 Γ2) ->
      (a_wl_red  (awl_app (subst_typ_in_aworklist (typ_arrow (typ_var_f X1) (typ_var_f X2)) X Γ2) Γ1 )   ) ) ->
      a_wl_red (aworklist_cons_work Γ (work_sub (typ_var_f X) (typ_arrow A1 A2)))
  | a_wl_red__sub_arrow2 : forall (L:vars) (Γ:aworklist) (A1 A2:typ) (X:typvar),
      binds ( X )  ( abind_etvar_empty ) (  ( awl_to_aenv  Γ  )  )  ->
      ( a_mono_typ   ( awl_to_aenv  Γ  )     ( (typ_arrow A1 A2) )   -> False )  ->
      (forall X1, X1 `notin` L -> forall X2, X2 `notin` (L `union` singleton X1) -> forall Γ1 Γ2,
      (aworklist_subst (aworklist_cons_work (aworklist_cons_var (aworklist_cons_var Γ X1 abind_etvar_empty) X2 abind_etvar_empty) (work_sub (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_var_f X))) X (typ_arrow (typ_var_f X1) (typ_var_f X2)) Γ1 Γ2) ->

      a_wl_red (aworklist_cons_work Γ (work_sub (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_var_f X)))
  | a_wl_red__sub_etvarmono1 : forall (Γ Γ1 Γ2:aworklist) (X:typvar) (A:typ),
      binds ( X )  abind_etvar_empty (  ( awl_to_aenv  Γ  )  )  ->
      a_mono_typ  ( awl_to_aenv  Γ  )  A ->
      X `notin` ftvar_in_typ A ->
      (aworklist_subst  Γ  X A Γ1 Γ2) ->
      a_wl_red   (awl_app (subst_typ_in_aworklist A X Γ2) Γ1 ) ->

  | a_wl_red__sub_etvarmono2 : forall (Γ Γ1 Γ2:aworklist) (X:typvar) (B:typ),

      a_mono_typ  ( awl_to_aenv  Γ  )  B ->
      X `notin` ftvar_in_typ B ->
      (aworklist_subst  Γ  X B Γ1 Γ2) ->
      a_wl_red   (awl_app (subst_typ_in_aworklist B X Γ2) Γ1 ) ->
      a_wl_red (aworklist_cons_work Γ (work_sub (typ_var_f X) B))
  | a_wl_red__sub_intersection1 : forall (Γ:aworklist) (A1 B1 B2:typ),
      a_wl_red (aworklist_cons_work (aworklist_cons_work Γ (work_sub A1 B1)) (work_sub A1 B2)) ->
      a_wl_red (aworklist_cons_work Γ (work_sub A1 (typ_intersection B1 B2)))
  | a_wl_red__sub_intersection2 : forall (Γ:aworklist) (B1 B2 A1:typ),

  | a_wl_red__sub_union1 : forall (Γ:aworklist) (B1 A1 A2:typ),

  | a_wl_red__sub_union2 : forall (Γ:aworklist) (B1 A1 A2:typ),

  | a_wl_red__sub_union3 : forall (Γ:aworklist) (B1 B2 A1:typ),

  | a_wl_red__chk_inter : forall (Γ:aworklist) (e:exp) (A1 A2:typ),

  | a_wl_red__chk_union1 : forall (Γ:aworklist) (e:exp) (A1 A2:typ),

    | aworklist_cons_work Γ1' w => aworklist_cons_work (awl_app Γ1' Γ2) w

Fixpoint unit_sigma (Σ : aenv) : list (typvar * typ) :=
  match Σ with

  T = typ_unit /\ binds X (abind_etvar_empty) Σ.
Proof.
  intros Σ. induction Σ as [|[Y b] Σ IH]; intros X T Hin; simpl in *.

      * inversion Heq; subst. split; auto.
      * destruct (IH X T Hin) as [HT Hb]. split; auto.
    + destruct (IH X T Hin) as [HT Hb]. split; auto.
Qed.

  sigma_keys_in_env (unit_sigma Σ) Σ.
Proof.
  intros Σ. unfold sigma_keys_in_env. intros X T Hin.
  apply In_unit_sigma in Hin. apply Hin.
Qed.

Lemma unit_sigma_nb : forall Σ, nb_sigma (unit_sigma Σ).
Proof.
  intros Σ. unfold nb_sigma. intros X T Hin.

(* ---------- extending the sigma for a fresh leading etvar ---------- *)
Lemma a_wf_env_ftvar_notin : forall Σ X,
  a_wf_env Σ -> X `notin` dom Σ ->
  forall Y T, binds Y (abind_var_typ T) Σ -> X `notin` ftvar_in_typ T.
Proof.
  intros Σ X Hwf. induction Hwf as
    [| Σ Y Hwf IH HY | Σ Y Hwf IH HY | Σ Y Hwf IH HY
     | Σ y A Hwf IH HA Hy]; intros HX Z T Hb.
  - apply binds_nil_iff in Hb. contradiction.
  - simpl in HX.
    assert (Htail : X `notin` dom Σ)
      by (apply (notin_dom_cons abind X Y abind_tvar_empty Σ); exact HX).
    apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. discriminate e2.
    + apply IH; auto.
  - simpl in HX.
    assert (Htail : X `notin` dom Σ)
      by (apply (notin_dom_cons abind X Y abind_stvar_empty Σ); exact HX).
    apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. discriminate e2.
    + apply IH; auto.
  - simpl in HX.
    assert (Htail : X `notin` dom Σ)
      by (apply (notin_dom_cons abind X Y abind_etvar_empty Σ); exact HX).
    apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. discriminate e2.
    + apply IH; auto.
  - simpl in HX.
    assert (Htail : X `notin` dom Σ)
      by (apply (notin_dom_cons abind X y (abind_var_typ A) Σ); exact HX).
    apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. injection e2 as eT. subst T.
      apply (a_wf_typ_ftvar_notin Σ A X); auto.
    + apply IH; auto.
Qed.

Lemma tsubst_typ_cons_notin_typ : forall s X U A,
  X `notin` ftvar_in_typ A ->
  tsubst_typ ((X,U)::s) A = tsubst_typ s A.
Proof.
  intros. simpl. rewrite (subst_typ_in_typ_fresh U X A); auto.
Qed.

Lemma aenv_to_denv_sigma_cons_irrel : forall Σ s X U,
  (forall Y T, binds Y (abind_var_typ T) Σ -> X `notin` ftvar_in_typ T) ->
  aenv_to_denv ((X,U)::s) Σ = aenv_to_denv s Σ.
Proof.
  intros Σ. induction Σ as [|[Y b] Σ IH]; intros s X U Hnotin; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct b; simpl.
    + rewrite IH; auto.
    + rewrite IH; auto.
    + rewrite IH; auto.
    + f_equal. apply tsubst_typ_cons_notin_typ.
      apply Hnotin. apply binds_cons_2; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma nb_sigma_cons_unit : forall s X,
  nb_sigma s -> nb_sigma ((X,typ_unit)::s).
Proof.
  intros s X Hnb. unfold nb_sigma in *. intros Y T Hin.
  destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
  - inversion Heq; subst. constructor.
  - apply Hnb; auto.
Qed.

Lemma fresh_sigma_cons_other : forall X Y U s,
  Y <> X -> fresh_sigma Y s -> fresh_sigma Y ((X,U)::s).
Proof.
  intros X Y U s Hne Hf. unfold fresh_sigma in *. simpl. intros [e|Hin].
  - apply Hne. symmetry. exact e.
  - apply Hf. exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma Arel_etvar_unit_ext : forall s Σ X,
  Arel s Σ (aenv_to_denv s Σ) ->
  a_wf_env Σ ->
  X `notin` dom Σ ->
  Arel ((X,typ_unit)::s) (X ~ abind_etvar_empty ++ Σ)
        (aenv_to_denv ((X,typ_unit)::s)
           (X ~ abind_etvar_empty ++ Σ)).
Proof.
  intros s Σ X [Hnb [Ht [Hs [He [Hin [Hft [Hfs Hv]]]]]]] Hwf Hdom.
  assert (Hnotin : forall Y T, binds Y (abind_var_typ T) Σ -> X `notin` ftvar_in_typ T)
    by (apply a_wf_env_ftvar_notin with (Σ := Σ); auto).
  assert (Hdenv : aenv_to_denv ((X,typ_unit)::s) (X ~ abind_etvar_empty ++ Σ)
                  = aenv_to_denv s Σ).
  { simpl. apply aenv_to_denv_sigma_cons_irrel; auto. }
  rewrite Hdenv.
  unfold Arel. repeat split.
  - apply nb_sigma_cons_unit; auto.
  - intros Y Hb. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. discriminate e2.
    + apply Ht in Hb. exact Hb.
  - intros Y Hb. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. discriminate e2.
    + apply Hs in Hb. exact Hb.
  - intros Y Hb. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. simpl. rewrite tsubst_unit. constructor.
    + apply He in Hb.
      replace (tsubst_typ ((X,typ_unit)::s) (typ_var_f Y))
        with (tsubst_typ s (typ_var_f Y)); auto.
      simpl. destruct (eq_var Y X) as [e|e].
      * exfalso. apply Hdom. subst Y.
        apply binds_in_dom with (a := abind_etvar_empty); auto.
      * reflexivity.
  - intros Y Hb. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. simpl. left. reflexivity.
    + apply Hin in Hb. simpl. right. exact Hb.
  - intros Y Hb. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. discriminate e2.
    + apply Hft in Hb.
      apply fresh_sigma_cons_other; auto.
      intro e. subst Y. apply Hdom.
      apply binds_in_dom with (a := abind_tvar_empty); auto.
  - intros Y Hb. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. discriminate e2.
    + apply Hfs in Hb.
      apply fresh_sigma_cons_other; auto.
      intro e. subst Y. apply Hdom.
      apply binds_in_dom with (a := abind_stvar_empty); auto.
  - intros y A Hb. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[e1 e2]|Hb].
    + subst. discriminate e2.
    + apply Hv in Hb.
      assert (Hty : tsubst_typ ((X,typ_unit)::s) A = tsubst_typ s A)
        by (apply tsubst_typ_cons_notin_typ; apply Hnotin; auto).
      rewrite Hty. exact Hb.
Qed.
EOF

  a_wf_wwl Γ ->
  X `notin` dom (awl_to_aenv Γ) ->
  ENVINV s Γ -> ENVINV ((X,U)::s) Γ.
Proof.
  intros s Γ. induction Γ as [| Γ' IH Y ab | Γ' IH w]; intros X U Hwf Hfresh HE; simpl in *.
  - auto.
  - destruct ab.
    + assert (Hwf' : a_wf_wwl Γ') by (inversion Hwf; subst; assumption).
      assert (Hfresh' : X `notin` dom (awl_to_aenv Γ'))
        by (apply (notin_dom_cons abind X Y (abind_var_typ A) (awl_to_aenv Γ')); exact Hfresh).
      apply IH; auto.
    + assert (Hwf' : a_wf_wwl Γ') by (inversion Hwf; subst; assumption).
      assert (Hfresh' : X `notin` dom (awl_to_aenv Γ'))
        by (apply (notin_dom_cons abind X Y abind_tvar_empty (awl_to_aenv Γ')); exact Hfresh).
      apply IH; auto.
    + assert (Hwf' : a_wf_wwl Γ') by (inversion Hwf; subst; assumption).
      assert (Hfresh' : X `notin` dom (awl_to_aenv Γ'))
        by (apply (notin_dom_cons abind X Y abind_stvar_empty (awl_to_aenv Γ')); exact Hfresh).
      apply IH; auto.
    + assert (Hwf' : a_wf_wwl Γ') by (inversion Hwf; subst; assumption).
      assert (Hfresh' : X `notin` dom (awl_to_aenv Γ'))
        by (apply (notin_dom_cons abind X Y abind_etvar_empty (awl_to_aenv Γ')); exact Hfresh).

  - destruct HE as [Henv HEtail]. split.

Lemma norm_denv_stvar_free : forall Ψ,
  stvar_free Ψ -> norm_denv Ψ = Ψ.
Proof.
  intros Ψ H. unfold norm_denv.
  rewrite denv_stvars_nil_stvar_free; auto.
  rewrite denv_nonstvars_id_stvar_free; auto.
Qed.

Lemma d_chk_inf_to_tc : forall Ψ e m A,
  stvar_free Ψ -> d_chk_inf Ψ e m A -> d_chk_inf_tc Ψ e m A.
Proof.
  intros Ψ e m A Hsf H.
  revert Hsf. induction H as
    [ Ψ0 x0 A0 Htenv Hbind
    | Ψ0 e0 A0 HA Hchk IHchk
    | Ψ0 Htenv
    | Ψ0 e1 e2 A0 B0 C0 Hinf IHinf Hinfabs Hchk2 IHchk2
    | L Ψ0 e0 A0 B0 Hmono Hbody IHbody
    | L Ψ0 e0 A0 Hs Hbody IHbody
    | Ψ0 e1 A0 B0 C0 HB Hinf IHinf Hinftapp
    | L Ψ0 e0 Hbody IHbody
    | L Ψ0 e0 A1 A2 HA Hbody IHbody
    | Ψ0 e0 A0 B0 Hinf IHinf Hsub
    | Ψ0 e0 A1 A2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
    | Ψ0 e0 A1 A2 H1 IH1 HA2
    | Ψ0 e0 A1 A2 H2 IH2 HA1 ];
    intros Hsf.
  all: try (eauto using d_chk_inf_tc__inf_var, d_chk_inf_tc__inf_anno,
            d_chk_inf_tc__inf_unit, d_chk_inf_tc__inf_app,
            d_chk_inf_tc__inf_tapp, d_chk_inf_tc__chk_inter,
            d_chk_inf_tc__chk_union1, d_chk_inf_tc__chk_union2).
  - (* inf_abs_mono *) apply d_chk_inf_tc__inf_abs_mono with (L := L).
    + exact Hmono.
    + intros x Hx. apply IHbody; auto. apply stvar_free_cons_typ; auto.
  - (* inf_tabs *) apply d_chk_inf_tc__inf_tabs with (L := L).
    + exact Hs.
    + intros X HX. apply IHbody; auto. apply stvar_free_cons_tvar; auto.
  - (* chk_abstop *) apply d_chk_inf_tc__chk_abstop with (L := L).
    intros x Hx. apply IHbody; auto. apply stvar_free_cons_typ; auto.
  - (* chk_abs *) apply d_chk_inf_tc__chk_abs with (L := L).
    + exact HA.
    + intros x Hx. apply IHbody; auto. apply stvar_free_cons_typ; auto.
  - (* chk_sub *) apply d_chk_inf_tc__chk_sub with (B := B0).
    + apply IHinf; auto.
    + unfold d_sub_tc_env. rewrite norm_denv_stvar_free; auto.
      apply d_sub_typeonly. exact Hsub.
Qed.


Inductive dwl_tc : dworklist -> Prop :=
  | dwl_tc__empty : dwl_tc dworklist_empty
  | dwl_tc__var : forall Ω x b,
      dwl_tc Ω -> dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_var Ω x b)
  | dwl_tc__chk : forall Ω e A,
      d_chk_inf_tc (dwl_to_denv Ω) e typingmode__chk A ->
      dwl_tc Ω -> dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_check e A))
  | dwl_tc__inf : forall Ω e A cs,
      d_chk_inf_tc (dwl_to_denv Ω) e typingmode__inf A ->
      dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_applys cs A)) ->
      dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_infer e cs))
  | dwl_tc__infabs : forall Ω A B C cd,
      d_infabs (dwl_to_denv Ω) A B C ->
      dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_applyd cd B C)) ->
      dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_infabs A cd))
  | dwl_tc__infabsunion : forall Ω A2 B1 B2 C1 C2 cd,
      d_infabs (dwl_to_denv Ω) A2 B2 C2 ->
      dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_applyd cd (typ_intersection B1 B2) (typ_union C1 C2))) ->
      dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_infabsunion B1 C1 A2 cd))
  | dwl_tc__unioninfabs : forall Ω B1 B2 C1 C2 cd,
      dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_applyd cd (typ_intersection B1 B2) (typ_union C1 C2))) ->
      dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_unioninfabs B1 C1 B2 C2 cd))
  | dwl_tc__infapp : forall Ω e A B cs,
      dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_applys cs B)) (work_check e A)) ->
      dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_infapp A B e cs))
  | dwl_tc__inftapp : forall Ω A B C cs,
      d_inftapp (dwl_to_denv Ω) A B C ->
      dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_applys cs C)) ->
      dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_inftapp A B cs))
  | dwl_tc__inftappunion : forall Ω A2 B2 C1 C2 cs,
      d_inftapp (dwl_to_denv Ω) A2 B2 C2 ->
      dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_applys cs (typ_union C1 C2))) ->
      dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_inftappunion C1 A2 B2 cs))
  | dwl_tc__unioninftapp : forall Ω A1 A2 cs,
      dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_applys cs (typ_union A1 A2))) ->
      dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_unioninftapp A1 A2 cs))
  | dwl_tc__sub : forall Ω A B,
      d_sub_tc_env (dwl_to_denv Ω) A B ->
      dwl_tc Ω -> dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_sub A B))
  | dwl_tc__applys : forall Ω cs A w,
      apply_conts cs A w ->
      dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω w) ->
      dwl_tc (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_applys cs A))
  | dwl_tc__applyd : forall Ω cd A B w,

Lemma d_work_sem_tc_sub_tvar : forall s Γ X,
  a_wf_wwl Γ ->

  full_base_keys s Γ ->
  a_wf_typ (awl_to_aenv Γ) (typ_var_f X) ->

    (work_sub (tsubst_typ s (typ_var_f X)) (tsubst_typ s (typ_var_f X))).
Proof.
  intros s Γ X HΓ Harel Hkeys Hwf.
  assert (HA : Arel s (awl_to_aenv Γ) (aenv_to_denv s (awl_to_aenv Γ)))
    by (unfold full_base_arel, full_base_env in Harel; exact Harel).
  unfold d_work_sem_tc.
  apply dwl_tc__sub with (A := tsubst_typ s (typ_var_f X))
                          (B := tsubst_typ s (typ_var_f X)).
  - rewrite dwl_to_denv_denv_to_dwl. unfold d_sub_tc_env.
    rewrite norm_denv_idem.

                    (aenv_to_denv s (awl_to_aenv Γ)) X HA H) as Hfresh.
      rewrite (tsubst_var_fresh s X Hfresh).

    + (* stvar *)

Fixpoint dwl_app (Ω1 Ω2 : dworklist) :=
  match Ω1 with
    | dworklist_empty => Ω2
    | dworklist_cons_var Ω1' X b => dworklist_cons_var (dwl_app Ω1' Ω2) X b
    | dworklist_cons_work Ω1' w => dworklist_cons_work (dwl_app Ω1' Ω2) w
  end.

Inductive d_wl_del_red : dworklist -> Prop :=
  | d_wl_del_red__empty : d_wl_del_red dworklist_empty

      d_wl_del_red Ω ->

  | d_wl_del_red__chk : forall Ω e A,
      d_chk_inf (dwl_to_denv Ω) e typingmode__chk A ->
      d_wl_del_red Ω ->
      d_wl_del_red (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_check e A))
  | d_wl_del_red__inf : forall Ω e A cs,
      d_chk_inf (dwl_to_denv Ω) e typingmode__inf A ->
      d_wl_del_red (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_applys cs A)) ->
      d_wl_del_red (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_infer e cs))
  | d_wl_del_red__infabs : forall Ω A B C cd,
      d_infabs (dwl_to_denv Ω) A B C ->
      d_wl_del_red (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_applyd cd B C)) ->
      d_wl_del_red (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_infabs A cd))
  | d_wl_del_red__infabsunion : forall Ω A2 B1 B2 C1 C2 cd,

  | d_wl_del_red__unioninfabs : forall Ω B1 B2 C1 C2 cd,

  | d_wl_del_red__unioninftapp : forall Ω A1 A2 cs,

      d_wl_del_red (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_sub A B))

      d_wl_del_red (dworklist_cons_work Ω w) ->
      d_wl_del_red (dworklist_cons_work Ω (work_applyd cd A B)).

Lemma d_wf_typ_binds_ts_eq_aux : forall n A,
  size_typ A <= n ->
  forall Ψ, d_wf_typ Ψ A ->
  forall Ψ', binds_ts_eq Ψ Ψ' ->
  d_wf_typ Ψ' A.
Proof.
  induction n as [| n IH]; intros A Hn.
  - destruct A; simpl in Hn; exfalso; lia.
  - destruct A as [| | | nb | X | A1 A2 | A0 | A1 A2 | A1 A2]; simpl in Hn;
      intros Ψ Hwf Ψ' Heq.
    + constructor.
    + constructor.
    + constructor.
    + inversion Hwf.
    + inversion Hwf; subst.
      * apply d_wf_typ__tvar.
        match goal with Ht : binds X dbind_tvar_empty Ψ |- _ =>
          exact (proj1 (Heq X dbind_tvar_empty (or_introl eq_refl)) Ht) end.
      * apply d_wf_typ__stvar.
        match goal with Ht : binds X dbind_stvar_empty Ψ |- _ =>
          exact (proj1 (Heq X dbind_stvar_empty (or_intror eq_refl)) Ht) end.
    + inversion Hwf; subst.
      constructor.
      * eapply IH; [simpl in Hn; lia | eassumption | exact Heq].
      * eapply IH; [simpl in Hn; lia | eassumption | exact Heq].
    + inversion Hwf; subst.
      apply d_wf_typ__all with (L := L).
      * exact H0.
      * intros X HX.
        assert (Hsz : size_typ (open_typ_wrt_typ A0 (typ_var_f X)) <= n).
        { change (size_typ (open_typ_wrt_typ_rec 0 (typ_var_f X) A0) <= n).
          rewrite (size_open_rec 0 A0 (typ_var_f X) ltac:(simpl; reflexivity)). lia. }
        apply (IH (open_typ_wrt_typ A0 (typ_var_f X)) Hsz
                 (X ~ dbind_tvar_empty ++ Ψ) (H2 X HX)
                 (X ~ dbind_tvar_empty ++ Ψ')).
        apply binds_ts_eq_cons. exact Heq.
    + inversion Hwf; subst.
      constructor.
      * eapply IH; [simpl in Hn; lia | eassumption | exact Heq].
      * eapply IH; [simpl in Hn; lia | eassumption | exact Heq].
    + inversion Hwf; subst.
      constructor.
      * eapply IH; [simpl in Hn; lia | eassumption | exact Heq].
      * eapply IH; [simpl in Hn; lia | eassumption | exact Heq].

  match e_5 with
  | exp_unit => exp_unit
  | (exp_var_b nat) => exp_var_b nat
  | (exp_var_f x) => exp_var_f x
  | (exp_abs e) => exp_abs (subst_typ_in_exp A_5 X5 e)
  | (exp_app e1 e2) => exp_app (subst_typ_in_exp A_5 X5 e1) (subst_typ_in_exp A_5 X5 e2)
  | (exp_tabs e) => exp_tabs (subst_typ_in_exp A_5 X5 e)
  | (exp_tapp e A) => exp_tapp (subst_typ_in_exp A_5 X5 e) (subst_typ_in_typ A_5 X5 A)
  | (exp_anno e A) => exp_anno (subst_typ_in_exp A_5 X5 e) (subst_typ_in_typ A_5 X5 A)

Fixpoint subst_exp_in_exp (e_5:exp) (x5:expvar) (e__6:exp) {struct e__6} : exp :=

  | (exp_var_b nat) => exp_var_b nat
